// ===== kit/shell.jsx (verbatim from the design system UI kit) =====
// App shell: drawer + page frame. Consumes the compiled design-system bundle.
const DS = window.NebulaRMPlatformDesignSystem_5dfab2;
const { AppLayout, PageBody, PagePanel, PageHeader, NavigationDrawer, NavigationDrawerHeader, NavigationDrawerTabsRow, NavigationDrawerSection, NavigationDrawerSectionTitle, NavigationDrawerItem, IconButton, Button } = DS;

// Header drawer = người đang đăng nhập (cùng khung NavigationDrawerHeader, chữ cỡ md).
function MvpDrawerHeader({ name, role, notifications, onSearch }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = React.useState(false);
  const [menu, setMenu] = React.useState(false);
  // Menu người dùng (flows_00 §2): Hồ sơ · Trợ lý của tôi · Uỷ quyền duyệt của tôi
  const userItems = [['Hồ sơ', 'user'], ['Trợ lý của tôi', 'robot', ['broker', 'supervisor']], ['Uỷ quyền duyệt của tôi', 'user-check', ['supervisor', 'compliance']]].filter((x) => isFull() && (!x[2] || x[2].indexOf(VIEWER_ROLE) >= 0));
  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', minHeight: 'var(--t-page-bar-min-height)', paddingRight: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
      {menu ? <React.Fragment><span onClick={() => setMenu(false)} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 60 }} /><span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 'calc(var(--t-page-bar-min-height) - 4px)', left: 8, zIndex: 61 }}><DdSurface width={220}><DdGroup>{userItems.map(([t, ic]) => <DdItem key={t} text={t} Icon={ic} onClick={() => { setMenu(false); if (t === 'Uỷ quyền duyệt của tôi' && window.__goAp) window.__goAp('ap-delegation'); else mvpToast('Mở ' + t); }} />)}</DdGroup></DdSurface></span></React.Fragment> : null}
      <button type="button" onClick={() => userItems.length && setMenu((m) => !m)} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
        style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 32, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', border: 'none', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', background: hover ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: 'inherit', flex: '1 1 auto', minWidth: 0, color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }}>
        <DS.Avatar placeholder={name} type="rounded" size="lg" style={{ width: 20, height: 20, fontSize: 12 }} />
        <span title={name + (role ? ' · ' + role : '')} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', minWidth: 0 }}>
          <span style={{ flexShrink: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{name}</span>
          {role ? <span style={{ minWidth: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{role}</span> : null}
        </span>
        <Icon name="chevron-down" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
      </button>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2, marginLeft: 'auto', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex' }}>
          <IconButton Icon="bell" variant="light" accent="secondary" size="small" ariaLabel="Notifications" />
          {notifications > 0 ? <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 4, right: 4, width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', background: 'var(--t-color-red)' }} /> : null}
        </span>
        <IconButton Icon="search" variant="light" accent="secondary" size="small" ariaLabel="Search" onClick={onSearch} />
        <IconButton Icon="layout-sidebar-left-collapse" variant="light" accent="secondary" size="small" ariaLabel="Collapse" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Drawer({ active, onNavigate, onSearch, aiTab, onTabChange, onNewChat, onOpenThread }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState({});
  return (
    <NavigationDrawer header={<MvpDrawerHeader name={({ supervisor: 'Châu', compliance: 'Thảo', ops: 'Minh' })[VIEWER_ROLE] || 'Hùng'} role={(ROLES[VIEWER_ROLE] || ROLES.broker).label} notifications={1} onSearch={onSearch} />}>
      <NavigationDrawerTabsRow activeTab={aiTab ? 'ai-chat' : 'navigation'} onTabChange={onTabChange} onNewChat={onNewChat} />
      {aiTab ? <AiHistory onOpen={onOpenThread} /> : RM_APP_DATA.nav.filter((sec) => !(isFull() && sec.section === 'Yêu thích')).map((sec) => {
        const vr = VIEWER_ROLE;
        const allow = (x) => !x.hidden && (!x.roles || x.roles.indexOf(vr) >= 0) && (!x.full || isFull()) && (isFull() || x.mvp); // MVP+ §4A.2–4A.3: Dashboard · Customers · Tasks (+ My Attention, Team cho Supervisor)
        let items = sec.items.filter(allow).map((it) => Object.assign({}, it, { children: it.children ? it.children.filter(allow) : null }));
        // MVP+ §4A.2: Dashboard · Customers · Tasks là 3 mục ngang hàng — bỏ nhóm "Customer".
        if (!isFull()) items = items.flatMap((it) => it.id === 'customers' ? it.children.map((c) => Object.assign({}, c, { icon: c.id === 'contacts' ? 'users' : c.icon, tile: c.id === 'contacts' ? it.tile : 'var(--t-object-tile-orange)', tileBorder: c.id === 'contacts' ? it.tileBorder : 'var(--t-object-tile-border-orange)', color: c.id === 'contacts' ? it.color : 'var(--t-tag-text-orange)', children: null })) : [it]);
        if (!items.length) return null;
        return (
        <NavigationDrawerSection key={sec.section}>
          <NavigationDrawerSectionTitle label={sec.section} isOpen />
          {items.map((it) => {
            const isOpen = it.children ? (open[it.id] !== undefined ? open[it.id] : !it.collapsed) : undefined;
            return (
              <React.Fragment key={it.id}>
                <NavigationDrawerItem label={it.label} Icon={it.icon} iconTile={it.tile} iconTileBorder={it.tileBorder} iconColor={it.color} isOpen={it.children ? !!isOpen : undefined} active={active === it.id} onClick={() => it.children && it.children.length ? setOpen({ ...open, [it.id]: !isOpen }) : onNavigate(it.id)} />
                {isOpen && it.children ? it.children.map((c, i) => <NavigationDrawerItem key={c.id} label={c.label} Icon={c.icon} indentationLevel={2} subItemState={i === it.children.length - 1 ? 'last' : 'intermediate-after'} active={active === c.id} onClick={() => onNavigate(c.id)} rightOptions={<IconButton Icon="dots" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="More" />} />) : null}
              </React.Fragment>
            );
          })}
        </NavigationDrawerSection>
        );
      })}
    </NavigationDrawer>
  );
}

function AiHistory({ onOpen }) {
  const threads = [['Today', ['Summarise VIP segment activity', 'Draft follow-up for Trần Thị Bình']], ['Yesterday', ['Which deals slipped this week?', 'Explain margin ratio rule']]];
  return threads.map(([day, list]) => (
    <NavigationDrawerSection key={day}>
      <NavigationDrawerSectionTitle label={day} />
      {list.map((t) => <NavigationDrawerItem key={t} label={t} onClick={onOpen} />)}
    </NavigationDrawerSection>
  ));
}

// Page frame = PagePanel > [ PageHeader + content | side panel ]. The record side panel is a bordered column
// inside the same white panel, its header sharing the 48px header row (as deployed).
function Page({ title, icon, iconColor, actions, children, rightPanel, onExpandDrawer, drawerHidden }) {
  return (
    <PageBody>
      <PagePanel style={{ borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-lg) 0 0 0' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }}>
          <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <PageHeader title={title} Icon={typeof icon === 'string' ? icon : undefined} icon={typeof icon === 'string' ? undefined : icon} iconColor={iconColor} showCollapseButton={drawerHidden} onExpandDrawer={onExpandDrawer}>{actions}</PageHeader>
            {children}
          </div>
          {rightPanel}
        </div>
      </PagePanel>
    </PageBody>
  );
}

Object.assign(window, { DS, Drawer, Page });


// ===== kit/screens-records.jsx (verbatim from the design system UI kit) =====
// Records: table view (Customer segments), kanban view (Opportunities), show page with side panel.
const { RecordTable, RecordBoard, RecordBoardColumn, RecordCard, RecordGroupChip, FieldRow, FieldGroup, Chip, Tag, Avatar, Icon, ViewBar, ViewPicker, ViewBarButton, Tabs, Button: DSButton, IconButton: DSIconButton, LightButton, TextInput, Checkbox, Modal: DSModal } = DS;

const SEGMENT_STATUS_COLOR = { Active: 'green', Paused: 'yellow', Draft: 'gray' };

function SegmentsScreen({ onOpen, record, onCloseRecord, sidePanel, drawerHidden, onExpandDrawer }) {
  const [segErrOff, setSegErrOff] = React.useState(false);
  const [sel, setSel] = React.useState([]);
  const [store, setStore] = React.useState({});
  const [vals, setVals] = React.useState({});
  const [cellMenu, setCellMenu] = React.useState(null);
  const [cellQ, setCellQ] = React.useState('');
  const menuRef = React.useRef(null);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!cellMenu) return;
    const h = (e) => { if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(e.target)) { setCellMenu(null); setCellQ(''); } };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', h);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h);
  }, [cellMenu]);
  const { columns, rows: rowsAll } = RM_APP_DATA.segments;
  const [rows, sFilter] = useColFilter(columns.filter((c) => c.id !== 'condition' && c.id !== 'sync'), rowsAll, ['name']);
  const ruleState = (r) => store[r.id] || { rules: r.rules || [], match: 'và' };
  const val = (r, k) => (vals[r.id] || {})[k] !== undefined ? vals[r.id][k] : r[k];
  const setVal = (r, k, v) => setVals((s2) => ({ ...s2, [r.id]: { ...(s2[r.id] || {}), [k]: v } }));
  const active = (r) => record && record.id === r.id;
  const OWNERS = ['Nguyễn Văn Hùng', 'Trần Quốc Huy', 'Lê Minh Châu', 'Trần Thị Lan', 'Phạm Minh Quân'];
  const cell = (r, c) => {
    if (c.id === 'condition') { const v = ruleState(r); return ruleText(v.rules, v.match) || '—'; }
    if (c.id === 'name') return <Tag text={r.name} color={r.color || 'gray'} />;
    if (c.id === 'status') return <Tag text={val(r, 'status')} color={SEGMENT_STATUS_COLOR[val(r, 'status')] || 'gray'} />;
    if (c.id === 'owner') { const o = val(r, 'owner'); return o ? <Chip label={o} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" /> : <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Owner</span>; }
    if (c.id === 'members') return r.members;
    return r[c.id];
  };
  const cellOptions = () => {
    if (!cellMenu) return null;
    const row = rows.find((x) => x.id === cellMenu.id);
    if (!row) return null;
    const isStatus = cellMenu.col === 'status';
    const opts = isStatus ? ['Active', 'Paused', 'Draft'] : OWNERS;
    const hit = opts.filter((o) => !cellQ || o.toLowerCase().includes(cellQ.toLowerCase()));
    const current = val(row, cellMenu.col);
    const pick = (o) => { setVal(row, cellMenu.col, o); setCellMenu(null); setCellQ(''); };
    return (
      <span ref={menuRef} style={{ position: 'fixed', top: cellMenu.y, left: Math.max(8, cellMenu.x - 200), zIndex: 200 }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <DdSurface width={200}>
          <DdSearch value={cellQ} onChange={setCellQ} placeholder="Search" />
          <DdSep />
          <DdScroll><DdGroup>
            {isStatus ? null : <DdItem text="No Owner" Icon="circle-off" selected={!current} tickOnly onClick={() => pick('')} />}
            {hit.map((o) => <DdItem key={o} tickOnly selected={o === current} onClick={() => pick(o)}
              text={isStatus ? <Tag text={o} color={SEGMENT_STATUS_COLOR[o] || 'gray'} preventShrink /> : <Chip label={o} avatarType="rounded" variant="transparent" />} />)}
          </DdGroup></DdScroll>
        </DdSurface>
      </span>
    );
  };
  const editBehaviour = (r, c) => {
    if (c.id === 'status' || c.id === 'owner') return { onEditClick: (e) => { const b = e && e.currentTarget ? e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect() : { right: 300, bottom: 200 }; setCellMenu({ id: r.id, col: c.id, x: b.right, y: b.bottom + 4 }); } };
    if (c.id === 'condition') return { onEditClick: () => onOpen(r) };
    return {};
  };
  return (
    <Page title="Segments" icon={<span style={{ width: 16, height: 16, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: 'var(--t-object-tile-pink)', border: '1px solid var(--t-object-tile-border-pink)', boxSizing: 'border-box', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}><Icon name="chart-pie" size={14} color="var(--t-tag-text-pink)" /></span>} iconColor="var(--t-tag-text-pink)" drawerHidden={drawerHidden} onExpandDrawer={onExpandDrawer} rightPanel={sidePanel ? sidePanel : record && record.code ? <SegmentSidePanel record={record} value={ruleState(record)} onSave={(v) => setStore((st) => ({ ...st, [record.id]: v }))} onClose={onCloseRecord} /> : null}
      actions={<React.Fragment><DSButton title="New segment" accent="blue" size="small" Icon="plus" /><DSIconButton Icon="dots-vertical" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="More" /></React.Fragment>}>
      <RmViewBar viewName="All segments" viewIcon="list" views={[{ id: 'all', name: 'All segments', icon: 'list' }]} noAddView count={rows.length} fields={columns} filterSpec={sFilter} actions={['Filter']} />
      {cellOptions()}
      {DEMO_BLOCK_STATE === 'loading' ? <div>{[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-6)', height: 32, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-3) 0 40px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>{[200, 90, 260, 80, 150].map((w, j) => <span key={j} style={{ height: 10, width: w - ((i * 17 + j * 11) % 40), borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-xs)', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' }} />)}</div>)}</div>
      : DEMO_BLOCK_STATE === 'error' && !segErrOff ? <div style={{ padding: '96px var(--t-spacing-4)' }}><DS.EmptyState Icon="alert-triangle" title="Không tải được danh sách segment." subtitle="Bộ lọc hiện tại vẫn được giữ." actionLabel="Thử lại" onAction={() => setSegErrOff(true)} /></div>
      : <div className="no-agg" style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'auto', paddingLeft: 'var(--t-spacing-3)' }}>
        <RecordTable columns={columns} rows={rows} selectedIds={sel} onSelectionChange={setSel} onRowClick={(r) => onOpen(r)}
          renderCell={(r, c) => <CellShell isFirst={c.id === columns[0].id} isActive={active(r)} noAction={c.id === 'members' || c.id === 'sync'}
            text={c.id === 'name' ? r.name : ''} render={(v) => cell(Object.assign({}, r, { name: v }), c)} onOpen={() => onOpen(r)} {...editBehaviour(r, c)}
            >{cell(r, c)}</CellShell>} />
      </div>}
    </Page>
  );
}

// Cell hover as seen in the live app: the whole cell gets a 1px border-strong
// frame (radius sm, 2px inset, transparent fill so the text never moves), with
// the edit/open button sitting inside it at the right edge.
function CellShell({ children, isFirst, onOpen, hasCopy, isActive, text, render, format, noAction, onEditClick, editIcon, overlay, extraAction }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = React.useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = React.useState(false);
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState(text || '');
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState(text || '');
  const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false);
  React.useEffect(() => { setValue(text || ''); }, [text]);
  const commit = () => { setValue(format === 'phone' ? formatPhone(draft) : draft.trim()); setEditing(false); };
  return (
    <div onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
      style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flex: 1, minWidth: 0, height: '100%', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>
      {overlay}
      {copied ? <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: -22, left: 0, zIndex: 5, padding: '2px var(--t-spacing-2)', background: 'var(--t-background-primary-inverted)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-inverted, #fff)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', pointerEvents: 'none' }}>Đã copy</span> : null}
      {isActive ? <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, bottom: 0, left: -8, right: -8, background: 'var(--t-accent-quaternary)', pointerEvents: 'none' }} /> : null}
      {hover ? <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, bottom: 0, left: -8, right: -8, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', backgroundColor: isActive ? 'var(--t-accent-quaternary)' : 'var(--t-background-primary)', outline: isActive ? 'none' : '1px solid var(--t-font-color-extra-light)', outlineOffset: -1, pointerEvents: 'none' }} /> : null}
      {editing ? (
        <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2, flex: 1, minWidth: 0, height: 24, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: '0 2px 0 var(--t-spacing-1)', border: '1px solid var(--t-color-blue)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-light)' }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          onBlur={(e) => { if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget)) commit(); }}>
          <input autoFocus value={draft} onChange={(e) => setDraft(format === 'phone' ? formatPhone(e.target.value) : e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') commit(); if (e.key === 'Escape') { setDraft(value); setEditing(false); } }}
            style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, height: 20, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: 0, border: 'none', outline: 'none', background: 'transparent', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }} />
          <DSIconButton icon={<Icon name="check" size={13} />} variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Xác nhận" onClick={commit} />
        </span>
      ) : (
      <span style={{ position: 'relative', flex: 1, minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>{value !== text && render ? render(value) : children}</span>
      )}
      {hover && !editing && !noAction ? (
        <span style={{ position: 'relative', flexShrink: 0, display: 'flex', marginRight: -4 }}>
          {extraAction ? <DSIconButton icon={<Icon name={extraAction.icon} size={13} />} variant="secondary" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel={extraAction.label} style={{ borderColor: 'var(--t-border-color-strong)', borderRightWidth: 0, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm) 0 0 var(--t-border-radius-sm)' }} onClick={(e) => { if (e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation(); extraAction.onClick(); }} /> : null}
          {hasCopy ? <DSIconButton icon={<Icon name="copy" size={13} />} variant="secondary" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Copy" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--t-border-color-strong)', borderRightWidth: 0, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm) 0 0 var(--t-border-radius-sm)' }} onClick={(e) => { if (e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation(); if (navigator.clipboard && value) navigator.clipboard.writeText(value); setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1200); }} /> : null}
          <DSIconButton icon={<Icon name={isFirst ? 'arrow-up-right' : (editIcon || 'pencil')} size={13} />} variant="secondary" accent="tertiary" size="small"
            style={{ borderColor: 'var(--t-border-color-strong)', borderLeftWidth: hasCopy || extraAction ? 0 : 1, borderRadius: hasCopy || extraAction ? '0 var(--t-border-radius-sm) var(--t-border-radius-sm) 0' : 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)' }}
            ariaLabel={isFirst ? 'Open record' : 'Edit field'} onClick={(e) => { if (e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation(); if (isFirst) { if (onOpen) onOpen(); } else if (onEditClick) { onEditClick(e); } else { setDraft(value || ''); setEditing(true); } }} />
        </span>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function SelectionActionBar({ count, onClear }) {
  if (!count) return null;
  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: '50%', bottom: 56, transform: 'translateX(-50%)', zIndex: 20, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 40, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)' }}>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{count} selected</span>
      <span style={{ width: 1, height: 20, background: 'var(--t-border-color-light)' }} />
      <DSButton title="Export" Icon="upload" variant="secondary" size="small" />
      <DSButton title="Delete" Icon="trash" variant="secondary" accent="danger" size="small" />
      <DSIconButton Icon="x" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Clear selection" onClick={onClear} />
    </div>
  );
}

const LIFECYCLE_COLOR = { New: 'blue', Active: 'green', 'At Risk': 'orange' };
// Lifecycle 9 trạng thái (BR-12, D-11). Dữ liệu mẫu cũ (New/Active) quy về trạng thái chuẩn.
const LC9 = ['Prospect', 'Opening', 'Opened', 'Funded', 'Activated', 'Active Investor', 'At Risk', 'Dormant', 'Lost'];
const LC9_COLOR = { 'At Risk': 'red', Lost: 'red', Dormant: 'gray', 'Active Investor': 'green', Activated: 'green', Funded: 'blue', Opened: 'blue', Opening: 'yellow', Prospect: 'gray' };
function lc9(r) { if (!r) return ''; if (r.id === 'c15' || r.id === 'c16') return 'Opened'; if (r.id === 'c1') return 'Active Investor'; return ({ Active: 'Active Investor', New: 'Funded' })[r.lifecycle] || r.lifecycle || ''; }

// twenty-ui navigation/RoundedLink/RoundedLink.module.scss, verbatim.
function ValuePill({ text }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = React.useState(false);
  const [active, setActive] = React.useState(false);
  if (!text) return null;
  return <a onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => { setHover(false); setActive(false); }} onMouseDown={() => setActive(true)} onMouseUp={() => setActive(false)}
    style={{ alignItems: 'center', backgroundColor: active ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-medium)' : hover ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'var(--t-background-transparent-lighter)',
      border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-strong)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-pill)', boxSizing: 'content-box', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', cursor: 'pointer',
      display: 'inline-flex', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', height: 10, justifyContent: 'center', maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 8px)', minWidth: 'fit-content',
      overflow: 'hidden', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1) var(--t-spacing-2)', textDecoration: 'none', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', userSelect: 'none', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{text}</a>;
}

const TASK_TYPE_COLOR = { Meeting: 'purple', Call: 'blue', Email: 'pink', 'Follow-up': 'green', Task: null };
const TASK_SOURCE_COLOR = { Service: 'orange', Inbox: 'blue', Automation: 'purple', Sales: 'gray', Manual: null };
const TASK_PRIORITY_COLOR = { High: 'yellow', Low: 'gray', Normal: null };

function TasksScreen({ onOpen, record, onCloseRecord, sidePanel, drawerHidden, onExpandDrawer }) {
  const [sel, setSel] = React.useState([]);
  const [tab, setTab] = React.useState('open');
  const { columns, rows: rowsAll } = RM_APP_DATA.tasks;
  const [rows, tFilter] = useColFilter(columns, rowsAll, ['task', 'note']);
  const cell = (r, c) => {
    if (c.id === 'related' || c.id === 'assignee' || c.id === 'createdBy') return <Chip label={r[c.id]} avatarType={c.id === 'related' ? 'squared' : 'rounded'} />;
    if (c.id === 'priority') { const col = TASK_PRIORITY_COLOR[r.priority]; return col ? <Tag text={r.priority} color={col} /> : r.priority; }
    if (c.id === 'status') return <Tag text={r.status} color="green" />;
    if (c.id === 'type') { const col = TASK_TYPE_COLOR[r.type]; return col ? <Tag text={r.type} color={col} /> : r.type; }
    if (c.id === 'source') { const col = TASK_SOURCE_COLOR[r.source]; return col ? <Tag text={r.source} color={col} /> : r.source; }
    return r[c.id];
  };
  const cellShell = (r, c) => <CellShell isFirst={c.id === columns[0].id} isActive={record && record.id === r.id} onOpen={() => onOpen && onOpen(r)}>{cell(r, c)}</CellShell>;
  return (
    <Page title="Tasks" icon="checkbox" iconColor="var(--t-color-green)" drawerHidden={drawerHidden} onExpandDrawer={onExpandDrawer} rightPanel={sidePanel ? sidePanel : record ? <RecordSidePanel record={record} onClose={onCloseRecord} /> : null}
      actions={<React.Fragment><DSButton title="New" accent="blue" Icon="plus" /><DSIconButton Icon="dots-vertical" variant="light" accent="tertiary" ariaLabel="More" /></React.Fragment>}>
      <RmViewBar viewName="My Tasks" viewIcon="list" views={[{ id: 'mine', name: 'My Tasks', icon: 'list' }]} noAddView count={rows.length} fields={columns} filterSpec={tFilter} actions={['Filter']} />
      <Tabs activeId={tab} onChange={setTab} tabs={[{ id: 'open', label: 'Open' }, { id: 'completed', label: 'Completed' }]} style={{ flexShrink: 0, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-3)' }} />
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', flex: 1, minHeight: 0, display: 'flex' }}>
        <div style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'auto', paddingLeft: 'var(--t-spacing-3)' }}>
          <RecordTable columns={columns} rows={tab === 'open' ? rows : []} selectedIds={sel} onSelectionChange={setSel} onRowClick={(r) => onOpen && onOpen(r)} renderCell={cellShell} onAddNew={() => {}} />
        </div>
        <SelectionActionBar count={sel.length} onClear={() => setSel([])} />
      </div>
    </Page>
  );
}

function PipelineScreen({ onOpen, record, onCloseRecord, sidePanel, drawerHidden, onExpandDrawer }) {
  const activeId = record ? record.id : null; const setActiveId = () => {};
  const PCOLS = [{ id: 'title', label: 'Name', Icon: 'typography' }, { id: 'stage', label: 'Stage', Icon: 'progress' }, { id: 'owner', label: 'Sales rep', Icon: 'user-circle' }, { id: 'company', label: 'Customer', Icon: 'user' }];
  const [opps, pFilter] = useColFilter(PCOLS, RM_APP_DATA.opportunities, ['title', 'company'], (k, v) => (k === 'stage' ? (RM_APP_DATA.stages.find((x) => x.id === v) || {}).label || v : String(v)));
  const byStage = (s) => opps.filter((o) => o.stage === s);
  const card = (o) => (
    <RecordCard key={o.id} title={o.title} titleAvatar={<Avatar placeholder={o.title} size="md" />} active={activeId === o.id} onClick={() => { setActiveId(o.id); onOpen(o); }}
      fields={[
        { Icon: 'progress', value: <Tag text={RM_APP_DATA.stages.find((s) => s.id === o.stage).label} color={RM_APP_DATA.stages.find((s) => s.id === o.stage).color} preventPadding /> },
        { Icon: 'user-circle', value: o.owner ? <Chip label={o.owner} avatarType="rounded" /> : null, placeholder: 'Sales rep' },
        { Icon: 'currency-dollar', value: <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}><Icon name="currency-dong" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" />{o.amount}</span> },
        { Icon: 'user', value: <Chip label={o.company} /> },
      ]} />
  );
  return (
    <Page title="Leads / Opportunities" icon="target" iconColor="var(--t-color-red)" drawerHidden={drawerHidden} onExpandDrawer={onExpandDrawer} rightPanel={sidePanel ? sidePanel : record ? <RecordSidePanel record={record} onClose={onCloseRecord} /> : null}
      actions={<React.Fragment><DSButton title="New Lead / Opportunity" accent="blue" Icon="plus" /><DSIconButton Icon="dots-vertical" variant="light" accent="tertiary" ariaLabel="More" /></React.Fragment>}>
      <RmViewBar viewName="Pipeline board" viewIcon="layout-kanban" views={[{ id: 'board', name: 'Pipeline board', icon: 'layout-kanban' }]} noAddView count={opps.length} fields={PCOLS} filterSpec={pFilter} actions={['Filter']} />
      <RecordBoard onAddGroup={() => {}}>
        {RM_APP_DATA.stages.map((s, i) => <RecordBoardColumn key={s.id} title={s.label} color={s.color} aggregate="-" isFirst={i === 0}>{byStage(s.id).map(card)}</RecordBoardColumn>)}
        <RecordBoardColumn title="No value" noValue aggregate="-" addLabel="New" width={220} />
      </RecordBoard>
    </Page>
  );
}

// Record side panel (show page opened from an index view) — a column inside the page panel, border-left,
// header row shares the 48px page header; tabs; "Fields" groups; ⋮ + favorite in the footer.
// Sections follow twenty's RecordDetailSectionContainer: border-top light,
// 12px vertical padding, 24px header (pad-left 12 / right 8), medium-weight
// title in font-color-primary, right-hand meta in font-color-light at size sm.
function PanelSection({ label, meta, metaColor, open, onToggle, children, first }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ flexShrink: 0, borderTop: first ? 'none' : '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', paddingTop: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', paddingBottom: 'var(--t-spacing-3)' }}>
      <div onClick={onToggle}
        style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 28, paddingLeft: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', paddingRight: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', marginBottom: open ? 'var(--t-spacing-3)' : 0, cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 'var(--t-font-weight-medium)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{label}</span>
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        {meta ? <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: metaColor || 'var(--t-font-color-light)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{meta}</span> : null}
        <Icon name={open ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'} size={16} color="var(--t-font-color-light)" />
      </div>
      {open && children ? <div style={{ padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-3)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>{children}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

// Row primitives shared by every section body: 24px rows, tertiary label /
// primary value, and twenty's section link (font-color-light, size sm).
function KVRow({ label, value, strongLabel, multiline, Icon: fieldIcon }) {
  if (multiline) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', height: 24, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
          {fieldIcon ? <Icon name={fieldIcon} size={16} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} /> : null}
          {label}
        </span>
        <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', lineHeight: 1.45, paddingLeft: 24, textWrap: 'pretty' }}>{value}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 24, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>
      <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', fontSize: strongLabel ? 'var(--t-font-size-md)' : 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', fontWeight: 400, color: strongLabel ? 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', overflow: 'hidden', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
        {fieldIcon ? <Icon name={fieldIcon} size={16} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} /> : null}
        <span style={{ minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>{label}</span>
      </span>
      <span style={{ flexShrink: 0, color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{value}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

// Content rows (case / task / interaction) are not field+value pairs, so they
// read as text: primary title, optional status on the right, and a smaller,
// lighter sub-line underneath — same treatment as the AI summary block.
// Empty fields are editable in place, like twenty's record-inline-cell:
// click the placeholder → DS TextInput (sm), Enter/blur commits, Esc cancels.
// Tag "quan tâm" do RM gắn: chọn nhiều, bỏ chọn được.
function InterestTags() {
  const all = [{ value: 'Ngân hàng', color: 'purple' }, { value: 'Trái phiếu', color: 'turquoise' }, { value: 'Bất động sản', color: 'orange' }, { value: 'Chứng chỉ quỹ', color: 'blue' }, { value: 'Cổ tức cao', color: 'green' }];
  const [sel, setSel] = React.useState(['Ngân hàng', 'Trái phiếu']);
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [up, setUp] = React.useState(false);
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  const ref = React.useRef(null);
  const toggle = () => {
    if (!open && ref.current) {
      const r = ref.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      setUp(window.innerHeight - r.bottom < 220);
    }
    setOpen((o) => !o);
  };
  const pick = (v) => setSel((cur) => cur.includes(v) ? cur.filter((x) => x !== v) : cur.concat(v));
  return (
    <span ref={ref} style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex' }}>
      <span onClick={toggle} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
        style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, maxWidth: 240, overflow: 'hidden', height: 24, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: 'pointer', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent' }}>
        {sel.length
          ? sel.slice(0, 2).map((v) => <Tag key={v} text={v} color={(all.find((o) => o.value === v) || {}).color} preventShrink />)
          : <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Chưa gắn</span>}
        {sel.length > 2 ? <Tag text={'+' + (sel.length - 2)} color="gray" preventShrink style={{ background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' }} /> : null}
      </span>
      {open ? (
        <React.Fragment>
          <span onClick={() => setOpen(false)} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 9 }} />
          <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: up ? 'auto' : 'calc(100% + 2px)', bottom: up ? 'calc(100% + 2px)' : 'auto', right: 0, zIndex: 10, minWidth: 180, maxHeight: 220, overflowY: 'auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)' }}>
            {all.map((o) => (
              <PanelOptionItem key={o.value} selected={sel.includes(o.value)} onPick={() => pick(o.value)}>
                <Tag text={o.value} color={o.color} preventShrink />
              </PanelOptionItem>
            ))}
          </span>
        </React.Fragment>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
}

function HorizonSelect() {
  const [v, setV] = React.useState('Chưa xác định');
  return <InlineSelect value={v} onChange={setV} options={[{ value: 'Chưa xác định', color: 'gray' }, { value: 'Dưới 1 năm', color: 'yellow' }, { value: '1–3 năm', color: 'turquoise' }, { value: '3–5 năm', color: 'blue' }, { value: 'Trên 5 năm', color: 'green' }]} />;
}

function EditableKVRow({ label, value, placeholder, Icon: fieldIcon, kind }) {
  const [val, setVal] = React.useState(value || '');
  const [editing, setEditing] = React.useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState('');
  const [hover, setHover] = React.useState(false);
  const start = () => { setDraft(val); setEditing(true); };
  if (kind === 'date') {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', minHeight: 24, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>
        <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', overflow: 'hidden', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
          {fieldIcon ? <Icon name={fieldIcon} size={16} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} /> : null}
          <span style={{ minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>{label}</span>
        </span>
        <span style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}><InlineDate placeholder={placeholder || label} value={val} onChange={setVal} align="right" /></span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const commit = () => { setVal(draft.trim()); setEditing(false); };
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', minHeight: 24, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>
      <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', overflow: 'hidden', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
        {fieldIcon ? <Icon name={fieldIcon} size={16} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} /> : null}
        <span style={{ minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>{label}</span>
      </span>
      {editing ? (
        // dùng chung format ô nhập với header tạo việc: viền xanh, hug nội dung
        <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', flexShrink: 0, maxWidth: 200 }}>
          <span aria-hidden style={{ visibility: 'hidden', whiteSpace: 'pre', height: 24, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', border: '1px solid transparent', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>{draft || placeholder || label}</span>
          <input autoFocus value={draft} placeholder={placeholder || label}
            onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
            onBlur={() => { commit(); setHover(false); }}
            onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') commit(); if (e.key === 'Escape') setEditing(false); }}
            style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', height: 24, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', border: '1px solid var(--t-color-blue)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', outline: 'none', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-light)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }} />
        </span>
      ) : (
        <span onClick={start} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
          style={{ flexShrink: 0, maxWidth: 200, minHeight: 24, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: hover ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', color: val ? 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-light)', cursor: 'pointer', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
          {val || placeholder || 'Chưa có'}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ItemRow({ dot, title, sub, right, onClick }) {
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <div onClick={onClick} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
      style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, padding: '2px var(--t-spacing-2)', margin: '0 calc(-1 * var(--t-spacing-2))', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: onClick ? 'pointer' : 'default', background: h && onClick ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }}>
        {dot ? <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', flexShrink: 0, background: dot }} /> : null}
        <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{title}</span>
        {right ? <span style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>{right}</span> : null}
      </div>
      {sub ? <span style={{ paddingLeft: dot ? 14 : 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{sub}</span> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

// "Việc cần làm": tick hoàn thành → mở ô ghi kết quả (wireframe C1 §O6).
function TaskRow({ title, sub, right, onClick, selected }) {
  const [done, setDone] = React.useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = React.useState('');
  const [hover, setHover] = React.useState(false);
  const bg = selected ? 'var(--t-accent-quaternary)' : hover && onClick ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent';
  return (
    <div onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
      style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', margin: '0 calc(var(--t-spacing-2) * -1)', padding: '2px var(--t-spacing-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: bg, transition: 'background 0.1s ease' }}>
      <span style={{ flexShrink: 0, paddingTop: 2 }}>
        <Checkbox checked={done} onChange={setDone} ariaLabel={'Hoàn thành ' + title} />
      </span>
      <div onClick={onClick} style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, cursor: onClick ? 'pointer' : 'default' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>
          <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, color: done ? 'var(--t-font-color-light)' : 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', textDecoration: done ? 'line-through' : 'none', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{title}</span>
          {right && !done ? <span style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>{right}</span> : null}
        </div>
        {sub ? <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', whiteSpace: 'normal', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>{sub}</span> : null}
        {done ? (
          <span style={{ paddingTop: 2 }}>
            <TextInput sizeVariant="sm" fullWidth autoFocus value={result} placeholder="Ghi kết quả" onChange={(e) => setResult(e && e.target ? e.target.value : e)} />
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Chip tín hiệu: hover đổi nền + viền, bấm mở tab Tổng quan của trang chi tiết.
function SignalChip({ text, border, onClick }) {
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <span onClick={onClick} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)} title="Mở Tổng quan" style={{ display: 'inline-flex', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
      <Tag text={text} color={border ? 'transparent' : 'gray'} variant={border ? 'border' : undefined}
        style={{ background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-medium)' : border ? 'transparent' : 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' }} />
    </span>
  );
}

function SectionFooter({ note, link, onClick }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', minHeight: 24, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
      <DSButton title={link} variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="arrow-up-right" onClick={onClick} />
      <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
      {note ? <span style={{ minWidth: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{note}</span> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

// Các khối "hoạt động" ở panel (KPI trở xuống): thu gọn mặc định, mở khi cần —
// chi tiết đầy đủ nằm ở cột phải trang Customer 360.
function CustomerPanelActivity({ onOpenTab, entry, record, onOpenCase }) {
  const openCases = record ? casesOf(record.id).filter((k) => !k.closed) : [];
  const inbox = entry === 'inbox';
  // Inbox: mở sẵn việc đang dở + tương tác gần đây (mỗi khối vài mục đầu); KPI, danh mục, hồ sơ thu gọn.
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(inbox ? { cases: true, tasks: true, inter: true } : {});
  const toggle = (k) => setOpen((o) => ({ ...o, [k]: !o[k] }));
  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <PanelSection first label="KPI tài sản" meta="EOD 13/09" open={!!open.kpi} onToggle={() => toggle('kpi')}>
        <KVRow label="NAV" Icon="chart-donut" value="2,41 tỷ · −3,2% 30 ngày" />
        <KVRow label="Tiền mặt" Icon="cash" value="820 tr · 34% NAV" />
        <KVRow label="Lãi/lỗ chưa thực hiện" Icon="trending-up" value={<span style={{ color: 'var(--t-tag-text-green)' }}>+186 tr · +9,4%</span>} />
        <KVRow label="Hiệu suất (TWR)" Icon="percentage" value="+12,8% YTD" />
        <SectionFooter link="Xem tất cả KPI" onClick={() => onOpenTab && onOpenTab('overview')} />
      </PanelSection>
      <PanelSection label="Case đang mở" meta={String(openCases.length)} open={!!open.cases} onToggle={() => toggle('cases')}>
        {openCases.length ? openCases.map((k) => <CaseItemRow key={k.id} k={k} onClick={() => (onOpenCase ? onOpenCase(k.id) : onOpenTab && onOpenTab('cases'))} />) : <span style={{ padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>Không có case đang mở.</span>}
        <SectionFooter link="Xem tất cả case" onClick={() => onOpenTab && onOpenTab('cases')} />
      </PanelSection>
      <PanelSection label="Việc cần làm" meta="2 · 1 quá hạn" open={!!open.tasks} onToggle={() => toggle('tasks')}>
        <ItemRow onClick={() => onOpenTab && onOpenTab('tasks')} title="Gọi xác nhận khẩu vị rủi ro" sub="Gọi · tạo bởi automation · T.Q.Huy" right={<Tag text="Quá hạn 1 ngày" color="red" />} />
        <ItemRow onClick={() => onOpenTab && onOpenTab('tasks')} title="Gửi khuyến nghị tái cơ cấu" sub="Email · hạn 16/09 · T.Q.Huy" />
        <SectionFooter link="Xem tất cả việc" onClick={() => onOpenTab && onOpenTab('tasks')} />
      </PanelSection>
      <PanelSection label="Tương tác gần đây" meta="Hôm qua · Zalo" open={!!open.inter} onToggle={() => toggle('inter')}>
        <ItemRow onClick={() => onOpenTab && onOpenTab('inter')} title="Khách hỏi về phí giao dịch" sub="Zalo · gửi đi · đã trả lời · hôm qua" />
        <ItemRow onClick={() => onOpenTab && onOpenTab('inter')} title="Gọi rà soát danh mục" sub="Gọi · gửi đi · không phản hồi · 11/09" />
        <SectionFooter link="Xem tất cả tương tác" onClick={() => onOpenTab && onOpenTab('inter')} />
      </PanelSection>
      <PanelSection label="Danh mục" meta="as-of 14/09 EOD" open={!!open.holdings} onToggle={() => toggle('holdings')}>
        <KVRow label={<Chip label="VCB" avatar={false} variant="highlighted" />} value="38% · 915.000.000 đ" />
        <KVRow label={<Chip label="FPT" avatar={false} variant="highlighted" />} value="22% · 530.000.000 đ" />
        <KVRow label={<Chip label="Tiền mặt" avatar={false} variant="highlighted" />} value="34% · 820.000.000 đ" />
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, height: 8, borderRadius: 4, overflow: 'hidden' }} title="Tỷ trọng danh mục theo giá trị">
          <span style={{ flex: 38, background: 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)' }} />
          <span style={{ flex: 22, background: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }} />
          <span style={{ flex: 6, background: 'var(--t-font-color-extra-light)' }} />
          <span style={{ flex: 34, background: 'var(--t-background-quaternary)' }} />
        </div>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>Cổ phiếu 45% · Trái phiếu 21% · Tiền mặt 34%</span>
        <SectionFooter link="Xem đầy đủ danh mục" onClick={() => onOpenTab && onOpenTab('holdings')} />
      </PanelSection>
      <PanelSection label="Nhu cầu & hồ sơ thiếu" meta="2 thiếu" open={!!open.profile} onToggle={() => toggle('profile')}>
        <KVRow label="Mục tiêu" Icon="target" value={<EditableValue kind="select" initial="Tăng trưởng dài hạn" options={[{ value: 'Tăng trưởng dài hạn', color: 'green' }, { value: 'Tăng trưởng ngắn hạn', color: 'turquoise' }, { value: 'Bảo toàn vốn', color: 'blue' }, { value: 'Thu nhập đều', color: 'yellow' }]} />} />
        {/* kết quả bài đánh giá rủi ro đã ký — chỉ đọc, đổi qua luồng đánh giá lại */}
        <KVRow label="Khẩu vị (khai báo)" Icon="scale" value={<span title="Từ bài đánh giá rủi ro đã ký — cập nhật qua luồng đánh giá lại"><HugValue><Tag text="Cân bằng" color="yellow" preventShrink /></HugValue></span>} />
        <KVRow label="Quan tâm" Icon="tag" value={<InterestTags />} />
        <KVRow label="Thời hạn đầu tư" Icon="clock" value={<HorizonSelect />} />
        <EditableKVRow kind="date" label="Ngày sinh" Icon="cake" placeholder="dd/mm/yyyy" />
        <SectionFooter link="Xem toàn bộ hồ sơ" onClick={() => onOpenTab && onOpenTab('kyc')} />
      </PanelSection>
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

function CustomerPanelBody({ record, onOpenTab, onOpenAtt, entry, onOpenCase }) {
  const inbox = entry === 'inbox';
  const nt = record ? RM_CUST_NOTICE[record.id] : null;
  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      {nt ? <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', margin: 'var(--t-spacing-3) var(--t-spacing-3) 0', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-3)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', background: 'var(--t-tag-background-' + nt.tone + ')', color: 'var(--t-tag-text-' + nt.tone + ')', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>
        <Icon name={nt.icon} size={16} color="currentColor" style={{ flexShrink: 0, marginTop: 1 }} /><span>{nt.text}</span>
      </div> : null}
      {isFull() && recordFlags(record).backfill ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-3)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
          <LifecycleConfirm record={record} current={lc9(resolveRecord(record))} align="start" />
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <MvpPanelAttention record={record} onOpenTab={onOpenTab} onOpenAtt={onOpenAtt} />
      <CustomerInfoSections record={record} hideQuickActions hideCounts collapsed={inbox} />
      <CustomerPanelActivity onOpenTab={onOpenTab} entry={entry} record={record} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} />
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

// "Hôm nay nên làm gì" trong panel = Attention ưu tiên cao nhất; các Attention khác một dòng.
function MvpPanelAttention({ record, onOpenTab, onOpenAtt }) {
  useMvp();
  const [openDlg, dlg] = useMvpDialog(record);
  const act = mvpActive(record.id);
  const top = act.filter((a) => a.status === 'OPEN')[0];
  const rest = act.filter((a) => !top || a.id !== top.id);
  const go = (id) => { if (onOpenAtt) { onOpenAtt(id); return; } mvpSet((x) => { x.focusAtt = id; }); onOpenTab && onOpenTab('overview'); };
  const card = { flexShrink: 0, margin: 'var(--t-spacing-3) var(--t-spacing-3) var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-3)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' };
  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      {dlg}
      {top ? (
        <div style={Object.assign({}, card, { border: '1px solid var(--t-accent-tertiary)', background: 'var(--t-accent-quaternary)' })}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
            <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontWeight: 'var(--t-font-weight-semi-bold)' }}>Hôm nay nên làm gì</span>
            {top.review ? <Tag text="Cần kiểm tra" color="orange" preventShrink /> : top.ai ? <MvpAiMark /> : null}
          </div>
          <div style={{ lineHeight: 1.5, textWrap: 'pretty' }}>{mvpSummary(top)}</div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>Gợi ý: {top.action}</span>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
            <DSButton title="Mở Attention" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="arrow-up-right" style={{ background: 'var(--t-background-primary)' }} onClick={() => go(top.id)} />
            <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
            {(() => { const others = act.filter((x) => x.status === 'OPEN' && x.id !== top.id); return others.length ? (
              <span onClick={() => go(others[0].id)} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2, height: 24, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
                {'+' + others.length + ' Attention khác'}<Icon name="chevron-right" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" />
              </span>
            ) : null; })()}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={Object.assign({}, card, { border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', background: 'var(--t-background-secondary)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' })}>
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 'var(--t-font-weight-semi-bold)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }}>Hôm nay nên làm gì</span>
          <span>{act.length ? 'Không còn mục đang mở.' : MVP_NO_ATT}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {!top && rest.length ? (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-3) var(--t-spacing-2) calc(var(--t-spacing-3) + var(--t-spacing-2))' }}>
          {rest.map((a) => <MvpAttLine key={a.id} a={a} onClick={() => go(a.id)} />)}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

function RecordTitle({ title }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <span style={{ maxWidth: 150, minWidth: 0, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 'var(--t-font-weight-semi-bold)' }}>
      <span onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
        style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', height: 24, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: '0 5px', border: 'none', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', background: hover ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{title}</span>
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

// Khi vào C360 không qua list (switcher / deep-link), record là null — giải về đúng
// một row thật để danh tính, cờ vận hành và cổng gửi tin cùng đọc một nguồn.
function resolveRecord(record) {
  if (record) return record;
  const rows = (RM_APP_DATA.contacts && RM_APP_DATA.contacts.rows) || [];
  return rows.filter((r) => r.id === 'c14')[0] || rows[0] || null;
}

// Identity dùng chung cho side panel và trang chi tiết: một data model
// (tên, mã khách, phụ trách, tag trạng thái, trạng thái xác minh), hai mật độ.
function identityOf(record) {
  const r = resolveRecord(record);
  const fp = r && (r.id === 'c15' || r.id === 'c16');
  return {
    name: r ? (r.name || r.title || '') : '',
    code: r && r.id ? 'KH-0001' + String(28 + (parseInt(String(r.id).replace(/\D/g, ''), 10) || 0)) : 'KH-000128',
    owner: r && r.owner ? r.owner : 'Lê Minh Châu',
    statusTags: fp ? [{ text: 'Opened', color: 'blue' }, { text: 'Chờ nạp tiền', color: 'yellow' }] : r && r.id !== 'c1' && r.lifecycle ? [{ text: lc9(r), color: LC9_COLOR[lc9(r)] || 'gray' }] : [{ text: 'Active Investor', color: 'green' }, { text: 'VIP', color: 'purple' }],
    verified: !fp,
    added: fp ? 'Mở tài khoản 9 ngày trước' : 'Added 7 months ago',
  };
}

// Lifecycle backfill (B1-D5): hệ thống suy từ dữ liệu lịch sử nên phải để broker
// xác nhận hoặc sửa; sửa sai trạng thái ghi nhận là WRONG_STATE.
function ReassignDialog({ record, onClose }) {
  const cur = record && record.owner;
  const [to, setTo] = React.useState(cur || null);
  const [done, setDone] = React.useState(false);
  const owners = (cur ? [cur] : []).concat(MVP_TEAM.concat(['Trần Quốc Huy']).filter((o) => o !== cur));
  const act = record ? mvpActive(record.id) : [];
  const nOpen = act.filter((a) => a.status === 'OPEN').length;
  const nSnz = act.filter((a) => a.status === 'SNOOZED').length;
  const moving = act.length ? [nOpen ? nOpen + ' Attention đang mở' : null, nSnz ? nSnz + ' đang hoãn' : null].filter(Boolean).join(', ') : 'Không có Attention đang mở hoặc đang hoãn';
  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <span onClick={onClose} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 80, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.28)' }} />
      <div style={{ position: 'fixed', top: '50%', left: '50%', transform: 'translate(-50%,-50%)', zIndex: 81, width: 440, maxWidth: 'calc(100vw - 32px)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
          <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500 }}>Chuyển khách {record ? record.name : ''} sang broker khác</span>
          <DSIconButton Icon="x" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Đóng" onClick={onClose} />
        </div>
        <div style={{ padding: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
          {done ? (
            <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
              <Icon name="check" size={14} color="var(--t-tag-text-green)" style={{ flexShrink: 0, marginTop: 3 }} />
              <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>Đã chuyển khách sang <b style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{to}</b>. Số liệu bảng team cập nhật ở lần tải sau.</span>
            </span>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>
              <EditFieldRow label="Broker mới" Icon="user-circle">
                <InlineSelect placeholder="Chọn broker" value={to || ''} onChange={setTo} options={owners.map((o) => ({ value: o }))} render={(o) => <Chip label={o.value} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" />} />
              </EditFieldRow>
              <EditFieldRow label="Sẽ chuyển theo" Icon="arrow-right"><HugValue><span>{moving}</span></HugValue></EditFieldRow>
              <EditFieldRow label="Không chuyển" Icon="circle-off"><HugValue><span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>Việc (task) hiện có, lịch sử phản hồi</span></HugValue></EditFieldRow>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-3)', borderTop: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
          <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
          <DSButton title={done ? 'Đóng' : 'Huỷ'} variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={onClose} />
          {done ? null : <DSButton title="Chuyển khách" accent="blue" size="small" disabled={!to || to === cur} onClick={() => setDone(true)} />}
        </div>
      </div>
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

function LifecycleConfirm({ record, current, onFixed, onConfirm, align }) {
  const roFlags = recordFlags(record);
  const bf = recordFlags(record).backfill;
  const [state, setState] = React.useState(null);
  const [dialog, setDialog] = React.useState(false);
  const OPTIONS = ['Prospect', 'Opening', 'Opened', 'Funded', 'Activated', 'Active Investor', 'At Risk', 'Dormant', 'Lost'];
  if (!bf) return null;
  if (state) {
    return (
      <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: state.ok ? 'var(--t-tag-text-green)' : 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
        <Icon name={state.ok ? 'check' : 'history'} size={14} color={state.ok ? 'var(--t-tag-text-green)' : 'var(--t-font-color-light)'} />{state.text}
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: align === 'start' ? 'flex-start' : 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
          <Icon name="alert-triangle" size={14} color="var(--t-tag-text-yellow)" />
          Suy từ dữ liệu cũ ({bf.at}) · còn {bf.daysLeft} ngày
        </span>
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }} title={roFlags.readOnly ? 'Vai trò ' + roFlags.role.label + ' chỉ đọc — chỉ người phụ trách khách xác nhận được trạng thái.' : undefined}>
          <DSButton title="Xác nhận" variant="secondary" size="small" disabled={roFlags.readOnly} onClick={() => { setState({ ok: true, text: 'Đã xác nhận trạng thái' }); onConfirm && onConfirm(); }} />
          <DSButton title="Sửa" variant="secondary" size="small" disabled={roFlags.readOnly} onClick={() => setDialog(true)} />
        </span>
      </div>
      {dialog ? <LifecycleFixDialog options={OPTIONS} current={current}
        onClose={() => setDialog(false)}
        onDone={(v) => { setDialog(false); setState({ ok: false, text: 'Đã sửa từ ' + current }); onFixed && onFixed(v); }} /> : null}
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

function LifecycleFixDialog({ options, current, onClose, onDone }) {
  const [pick, setPick] = React.useState(current || options[0]);
  const [note, setNote] = React.useState('');
  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <span onClick={onClose} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 80, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,.28)' }} />
      <div style={{ position: 'fixed', top: '50%', left: '50%', transform: 'translate(-50%,-50%)', zIndex: 81, width: 420, maxWidth: 'calc(100vw - 32px)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
          <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500 }}>Sửa trạng thái vòng đời</span>
          <DSIconButton Icon="x" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Đóng" onClick={onClose} />
        </div>
        <div style={{ padding: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>Hệ thống suy ra <b style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)' }}>{current}</b> từ dữ liệu lịch sử. Chọn trạng thái đúng:</span>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>
            {options.map((o) => (
              <span key={o} onClick={() => setPick(o)} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', height: 28, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: 'pointer', border: '1px solid ' + (pick === o ? 'var(--t-color-blue)' : 'var(--t-border-color-medium)'), background: pick === o ? 'var(--t-accent-quaternary)' : 'var(--t-background-primary)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>
                {o === current ? <Icon name="sparkles" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-light)" /> : null}{o}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
          <DS.TextInput value={note} onChange={setNote} placeholder="Vì sao trạng thái cũ chưa đúng" size="small" />
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', lineHeight: 1.4, color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>Trạng thái mới áp dụng ngay cho khách này; ghi chú giúp rà lại chất lượng dữ liệu backfill.</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-3)', borderTop: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
          <DSButton title="Huỷ" variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={onClose} />
          <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
          <DSButton title="Lưu trạng thái" accent="blue" size="small" disabled={pick === current || !note.trim()}
            style={pick === current || !note.trim() ? { opacity: 0.45 } : null} onClick={() => onDone(pick)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

function IdentityBlock({ record, density = 'compact', actions, onDetail, lifecycle: lcProp, onLifecycle, onLcConfirm }) {
  const id = identityOf(record);
  const [lcLocal, setLcLocal] = React.useState(null);
  const lifecycle = lcProp !== undefined ? lcProp : lcLocal;
  const setLifecycle = onLifecycle || setLcLocal;
  const LC_COLOR = { 'At Risk': 'red', Lost: 'red', Dormant: 'gray', 'Active Investor': 'green', Activated: 'green', Funded: 'blue', Opened: 'blue', Opening: 'yellow', Prospect: 'gray' };
  const tags = !isFull() ? id.statusTags.slice(1) : lifecycle ? [{ text: lifecycle, color: LC_COLOR[lifecycle] || 'gray' }].concat(id.statusTags.slice(1)) : id.statusTags;
  const [tip, setTip] = React.useState(null);
  const verifiedMark = id.verified ? (
    <span onMouseEnter={() => setTip(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setTip(false)} style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', flexShrink: 0 }}>
      <Icon name="rosette-discount-check" size={16} color="var(--t-tag-text-green)" />
      {tip ? (
        <span style={{ position: 'absolute', bottom: 'calc(100% + 6px)', left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)', zIndex: 5, padding: '2px var(--t-spacing-2)', background: 'var(--t-background-primary-inverted)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-inverted, #fff)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>Đã xác minh</span>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  ) : null;
  if (density === 'compact') {
    return (
      <div style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2, height: 48, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2) 0 var(--t-spacing-3)', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>
          <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0, padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' }}>
            <Avatar placeholder={id.name} type="rounded" size="md" />
          </span>
          <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flex: 1, gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', minWidth: 0 }}>
            <RecordTitle title={id.name} />
            {verifiedMark}
            {tags.map((t) => <Tag key={t.text} text={t.text} color={t.color} preventShrink />)}
          </span>
          {actions}
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', minWidth: 0, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-3) var(--t-spacing-2)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
          <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, flexShrink: 0 }}><Icon name="hash" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" />{id.code}</span>
          <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, flexShrink: 0 }}><Icon name="user-circle" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" />{id.owner}</span>
          {onDetail ? <span style={{ flexShrink: 0, marginLeft: 'auto' }}><DSButton title="Xem chi tiết" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="arrow-up-right" onClick={onDetail} /></span> : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  // Mật độ full (cột trái trang chi tiết) theo doc wire/c360.txt · C1: identity nằm
  // ngang (avatar 40 + tên + mã khách), tag row, rồi phụ trách / khẩu vị gộp thành
  // dòng text — gọn hơn card căn giữa + 4 KVRow.
  return (
    <C360LeftSection>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
        <Avatar placeholder={id.name} type="rounded" size="xl" style={{ width: 40, height: 40, fontSize: 16, flexShrink: 0 }} />
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', maxWidth: '100%', minWidth: 0 }}>
          <span style={{ minWidth: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-xl)', fontWeight: 'var(--t-font-weight-semi-bold)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{id.name}</span>
          {verifiedMark}
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>
          {tags.map((t) => <Tag key={t.text} text={t.text} color={t.color} />)}
        </div>
        {isFull() ? <LifecycleConfirm record={record} current={tags[0] ? tags[0].text : ''} onFixed={setLifecycle} onConfirm={onLcConfirm} /> : null}
      </div>
      <KVRow label="Master Customer ID" Icon="hash" value={<ValuePill text={id.code} />} />
      <KVRow label="Phụ trách" Icon="user-circle" value={<Chip label={id.owner} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" />} />
    </C360LeftSection>
  );
}

function PanelMenuItem({ item, onPick }) {
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  const off = !!item.disabled;
  return (
    <span onClick={off ? undefined : onPick} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)} title={off ? item.note : undefined}
      style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 32, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: off ? 'var(--t-font-color-light)' : 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)', cursor: off ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', background: h && !off ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent' }}>
      <Icon name={off ? 'lock' : item.icon} size={16} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" />{item.label}
    </span>
  );
}

function PanelMoreMenu({ onPick }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const items = [
    { id: 'task', label: 'Tạo việc', icon: 'checkbox' },
    { id: 'note', label: 'Ghi chú', icon: 'notes' },
    { id: 'meeting', label: 'Ghi cuộc gặp', icon: 'users' },
    { id: 'review', label: 'Ghi rà soát danh mục', icon: 'chart-pie' },
    { id: 'case', label: 'Tạo case', icon: 'briefcase' },
    { id: 'ai', label: 'Hỏi Trợ lý', icon: 'sparkles' },
  ];
  return (
    <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex' }}>
      <DSButton title="Hành động" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="chevron-up" onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)} />
      {open ? (
        <React.Fragment>
          <span onClick={() => setOpen(false)} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 9 }} />
          <span style={{ position: 'absolute', bottom: 'calc(100% + 4px)', left: 0, zIndex: 10, minWidth: 180, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)' }}>
            {items.map((it) => <PanelMenuItem key={it.id} item={it} onPick={() => { setOpen(false); onPick(it.id); }} />)}
          </span>
        </React.Fragment>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
}

function RecordMoreMenu({ onBack, onPick, extra, more }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [q, setQ] = React.useState('');
  const role = viewerRole();
  const items = (extra || []).concat([
    { id: 'panel', label: 'Mở dạng panel', icon: 'layout-sidebar-right' },
    { id: 'copy', label: 'Sao chép liên kết', icon: 'link' },
    { id: 'export', label: 'Xuất dữ liệu khách', icon: 'download' },
    // S4 là việc của Supervisor/Admin; broker phụ trách đề nghị, vai chỉ đọc không đụng.
  ].concat(mvpIsSup() ? [{ id: 'assign', label: 'Chuyển khách', icon: 'arrows-exchange' }] : []).concat(more || []).concat([
    { id: 'archive', label: 'Lưu trữ khách', icon: 'archive', disabled: !role.canWrite, note: 'Vai trò ' + role.label + ' chỉ đọc.' },
  ]));
  const list = items.filter((it) => it.label.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.trim().toLowerCase()) >= 0);
  const pick = (id) => { setOpen(false); setQ(''); if (id === 'panel' && onBack) onBack(); else if (onPick) onPick(id); };
  // Menu neo theo toạ độ nút (fixed) để không bị cắt khi vùng hành động ở header overflow hidden.
  const btnRef = React.useRef(null);
  const [at, setAt] = React.useState(null);
  const toggle = () => {
    if (open) { setOpen(false); setQ(''); return; }
    const r = btnRef.current && btnRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r) setAt({ top: r.bottom + 4, right: window.innerWidth - r.right });
    setOpen(true);
  };
  return (
    <span ref={btnRef} style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex' }}>
      <DSIconButton Icon="dots-vertical" variant="secondary" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Thêm" onClick={toggle} />
      {open ? (
        <React.Fragment>
          <span onClick={() => { setOpen(false); setQ(''); }} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 40 }} />
          <span style={{ position: 'fixed', top: at ? at.top : 52, right: at ? at.right : 12, zIndex: 41, minWidth: 220, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', height: 32, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
              <Icon name="search" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-light)" />
              <input autoFocus value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} placeholder="Tìm kiếm"
                style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, border: 'none', outline: 'none', background: 'transparent', font: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }} />
            </span>
            <span style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', maxHeight: 260, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
              {list.length
                ? list.map((it) => <PanelMenuItem key={it.id} item={it} onPick={() => pick(it.id)} />)
                : <span style={{ padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Không có kết quả</span>}
            </span>
          </span>
        </React.Fragment>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
}

// Segment record panel: cùng khuôn PanelSection + KVRow của panel khách.
// Sửa điều kiện là một trang con của panel (pattern compose của Twenty), không
// dùng thanh "Save changes" thường trực vì list này không phải master-detail (P02).
function SegmentRulesPage({ record, onClose }) {
  const [rules, setRules] = React.useState((record.rules || []).map((r) => r.slice()));
  const set = (i, j) => (v) => setRules((rs) => rs.map((r, k) => k === i ? r.map((c, m) => m === j ? v : c) : r));
  const fields = ['Lifecycle', 'Care status', 'NAV', 'Priority score', 'Last activity', 'Created at', 'Margin ratio'];
  const ops = ['là', 'không phải', 'lớn hơn', 'nhỏ hơn', 'lớn hơn hoặc bằng', 'cũ hơn', 'trong vòng'];
  return (
    <div style={{ width: 400, minWidth: 400, flexShrink: 0, height: '100%', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', borderLeft: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 48, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2) 0 var(--t-spacing-1)', boxSizing: 'border-box', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <DSIconButton Icon="chevron-left" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Quay lại" onClick={onClose} />
        <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>Điều kiện · {record.name}</span>
      </div>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Khách thoả <b style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)' }}>tất cả</b> điều kiện dưới đây.</span>
        {rules.map((r, i) => (
          <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>
              <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}><InlineSelect value={r[0]} onChange={set(i, 0)} options={fields.map((f) => ({ value: f, color: 'gray' }))} /></span>
              <DSIconButton Icon="trash" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Xoá điều kiện" onClick={() => setRules((rs) => rs.filter((_, k) => k !== i))} />
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>
              <span style={{ flex: '0 0 40%' }}><InlineSelect value={r[1]} onChange={set(i, 1)} options={ops.map((o) => ({ value: o, color: 'gray' }))} /></span>
              <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}><InlineText value={r[2]} onChange={set(i, 2)} placeholder="Giá trị" /></span>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        <span style={{ display: 'flex' }}>
          <LightButton title="Thêm điều kiện" Icon="plus" accent="tertiary" onClick={() => setRules((rs) => rs.concat([['Lifecycle', 'là', '']]))} />
        </span>
        <span style={{ marginTop: 'auto', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
          <Icon name="info-circle" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" />Thành viên được tính lại sau khi lưu, mỗi 6 giờ.
        </span>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 40, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1) var(--t-spacing-2)', borderTop: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <DSButton title="Hủy" variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={onClose} />
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        <DSButton title="Lưu điều kiện" accent="blue" size="small" onClick={onClose} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Danh mục field / toán tử / giá trị lấy theo customer_segments_conditions.md:
// §2 (nhóm điều kiện ứng viên + thứ tự ưu tiên bản đầu), §3 (toán tử theo kiểu
// dữ liệu), §4 (ghép AND/OR một cấp). Nhóm tài chính để cuối vì cần quyền.
const RULE_SCHEMA = [
  { group: 'Hồ sơ khách hàng', fields: [
    { label: 'Lifecycle', type: 'enum', options: ['Prospect', 'Opening', 'Opened', 'Funded', 'Activated', 'Active Investor', 'At Risk', 'Dormant', 'Lost'] },
    { label: 'Trạng thái KYC', type: 'enum', options: ['Hoàn tất', 'Chưa hoàn tất', 'Chờ duyệt'] },
    { label: 'Ngày mở tài khoản', type: 'date' },
  ] },
  { group: 'Phân công & tổ chức', fields: [
    { label: 'Phụ trách', type: 'enum', options: ['Nguyễn Văn Hùng', 'Trần Quốc Huy', 'Lê Minh Châu', 'Trần Thị Lan', 'Phạm Minh Quân'] },
    { label: 'Team', type: 'enum', options: ['Team Môi giới 1', 'Team Môi giới 2', 'Team Môi giới 3'] },
    { label: 'Chi nhánh', type: 'enum', options: ['Chi nhánh Hà Nội', 'Chi nhánh HCM', 'Chi nhánh Đà Nẵng', 'Chi nhánh Cần Thơ'] },
    { label: 'Phòng ban', type: 'enum', options: ['Phòng ban A', 'Phòng ban B', 'Phòng ban C', 'Phòng ban D'] },
  ] },
  { group: 'Chăm sóc', fields: [
