    { label: 'Care status', type: 'enum', options: ['Cần phản hồi', 'Đang chăm sóc', 'Có lịch hẹn'] },
    { label: 'Tags', type: 'text' },
    { label: 'Ngày cần follow-up', type: 'date' },
  ] },
  { group: 'Hoạt động', fields: [
    { label: 'Last activity', type: 'date' },
    { label: 'Last trade', type: 'date' },
    { label: 'Số lần giao dịch trong kỳ', type: 'number' },
  ] },
  { group: 'Case & Task', fields: [
    { label: 'Case đang mở', type: 'relation' },
    { label: 'Task quá hạn', type: 'relation' },
  ] },
  { group: 'Signal', fields: [
    { label: 'Signal', type: 'signal', options: ['idle_cash', 'no_trade', 'large_withdrawal', 'concentration_high', 'nav_decline', 'funding_pending', 'bond_maturity'] },
  ] },
  { group: 'Chất lượng dữ liệu', fields: [
    { label: 'Thiếu field bắt buộc', type: 'boolean' },
    { label: 'Domain quá hạn đồng bộ', type: 'boolean' },
  ] },
  { group: 'Danh mục & tài sản (cần quyền)', fields: [
    { label: 'NAV', type: 'number' },
    { label: 'Tiền mặt nhàn rỗi', type: 'number' },
    { label: 'Tỷ lệ tiền mặt/NAV', type: 'number' },
  ] },
];
const RULE_FIELD = {};
RULE_SCHEMA.forEach((g) => g.fields.forEach((f) => { RULE_FIELD[f.label] = f; }));
const OPS_BY_TYPE = {
  enum: ['là', 'không là', 'là một trong', 'không thuộc danh sách'],
  text: ['chứa', 'không chứa', 'có giá trị', 'trống'],
  number: ['bằng', 'khác', 'lớn hơn', 'lớn hơn hoặc bằng', 'nhỏ hơn', 'có giá trị', 'không có giá trị'],
  date: ['trước', 'sau', 'trong N ngày gần nhất', 'ngoài N ngày gần nhất', 'chưa từng'],
  boolean: ['đúng', 'sai'],
  relation: ['có liên kết', 'không có', 'số lượng ít nhất', 'số lượng nhiều nhất'],
  signal: ['đang hiệu lực', 'đã phát sinh trong N ngày', 'chưa từng phát sinh'],
};
const NO_VALUE_OPS = ['có giá trị', 'trống', 'không có giá trị', 'chưa từng', 'đúng', 'sai', 'có liên kết', 'không có'];
const DAYS_OPS = ['trong N ngày gần nhất', 'ngoài N ngày gần nhất', 'đã phát sinh trong N ngày'];
const COUNT_OPS = ['số lượng ít nhất', 'số lượng nhiều nhất'];
const ruleText = (rules, match) => (rules || []).map((r) => {
  if (DAYS_OPS.includes(r[1])) return r[0] + ' ' + r[1].replace('N ngày', (r[2] || 'N') + ' ngày');
  return [r[0], r[1], r[2]].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
}).join(match === 'hoặc' ? ' hoặc ' : ' · ');
const opsFor = (label) => OPS_BY_TYPE[(RULE_FIELD[label] || {}).type] || OPS_BY_TYPE.text;
const fmtNum = (v) => String(v).replace(/\D/g, '').replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
const toISO = (v) => { const m = /^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/.exec(String(v || '')); return m ? m[3] + '-' + m[2] + '-' + m[1] : ''; };
const fromISO = (v) => { const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(String(v || '')); return m ? m[3] + '/' + m[2] + '/' + m[1] : ''; };

// Sửa tại chỗ như mọi field khác của panel: bấm vào từng mảnh của luật để đổi
// field / toán tử / giá trị, không chuyển sang trang riêng.
function RulePart({ children, onClick, muted, strong, open }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = React.useState(false);
  return <span onClick={onClick} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
    style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, height: 20, maxWidth: '100%', minWidth: 0, padding: '0 4px', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: hover || open ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', color: muted ? 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', fontWeight: strong ? 500 : 400, cursor: 'pointer', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>{children}</span>;
}

function RuleRows({ rules, onChange, match, onMatchChange }) {
  const [menu, setMenu] = React.useState(null);
  const [editing, setEditing] = React.useState(null);
  const [hoverRow, setHoverRow] = React.useState(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState('');
  const ref = React.useRef(null);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!menu) return;
    const h = (e) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) setMenu(null); };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', h);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h);
  }, [menu]);
  const set = (i, j, v) => onChange(rules.map((r, k) => k === i ? r.map((c, m) => m === j ? v : c) : r));
  const setField = (i, label) => onChange(rules.map((r, k) => k === i ? [label, opsFor(label)[0], ''] : r));
  const setOp = (i, op) => onChange(rules.map((r, k) => k === i ? [r[0], op, NO_VALUE_OPS.includes(op) ? '' : r[2]] : r));
  const remove = (i) => onChange(rules.filter((_, k) => k !== i));
  const numeric = (r) => DAYS_OPS.includes(r[1]) || COUNT_OPS.includes(r[1]) || (RULE_FIELD[r[0]] || {}).type === 'number';
  const placeholder = (t) => <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>{t}</span>;

  const optionMenu = (i, opts, isOn, onPick, keepOpen) => menu === i + '-val' ? <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 24, right: 0, zIndex: 60 }}>
    <DdSurface width={220}><DdScroll><DdGroup>{opts.map((v) => <DdItem key={v} text={v} selected={isOn(v)} tickOnly onClick={() => { onPick(v); if (!keepOpen) setMenu(null); }} />)}</DdGroup></DdScroll></DdSurface>
  </span> : null;

  const valueEditor = (r, i) => {
    const f = RULE_FIELD[r[0]] || { type: 'text' };
    if (NO_VALUE_OPS.includes(r[1])) return null;
    if (f.type === 'signal') {
      return <React.Fragment>
        <RulePart strong open={menu === i + '-val'} onClick={() => setMenu(menu === i + '-val' ? null : i + '-val')}>{r[2] || placeholder('Chọn signal')}</RulePart>
        {optionMenu(i, f.options, (v) => v === r[2], (v) => set(i, 2, v))}
      </React.Fragment>;
    }
    if (f.type === 'enum') {
      return <React.Fragment>
        <RulePart strong open={menu === i + '-val'} onClick={() => setMenu(menu === i + '-val' ? null : i + '-val')}>{r[2] || placeholder('Chọn giá trị')}</RulePart>
        {(() => {
          const multi = ['là một trong', 'không thuộc danh sách'].includes(r[1]);
          const picked = String(r[2] || '').split(',').map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
          return optionMenu(i, f.options, (v) => multi ? picked.includes(v) : v === r[2], (v) => {
            if (multi) set(i, 2, (picked.includes(v) ? picked.filter((x) => x !== v) : picked.concat(v)).join(', '));
            else set(i, 2, v);
          }, multi);
        })()}
      </React.Fragment>;
    }
    if (f.type === 'date' && !DAYS_OPS.includes(r[1])) {
      return editing === i
        ? <input type="date" autoFocus value={toISO(draft)} onChange={(e) => { const v = fromISO(e.target.value); setDraft(v); set(i, 2, v); }} onBlur={() => setEditing(null)}
            style={{ height: 20, boxSizing: 'content-box', padding: '0 4px', border: '1px solid var(--t-color-blue)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', outline: 'none', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }} />
        : <RulePart strong onClick={() => { setDraft(r[2]); setEditing(i); }}>{r[2] ? <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}><Icon name="calendar" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" />{r[2]}</span> : placeholder('Chọn ngày')}</RulePart>;
    }
    const suffix = DAYS_OPS.includes(r[1]) ? ' ngày' : '';
    return editing === i
      ? <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
          <input autoFocus value={draft} inputMode={numeric(r) ? 'numeric' : undefined}
            onChange={(e) => setDraft(numeric(r) ? fmtNum(e.target.value) : e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { set(i, 2, draft); setEditing(null); } if (e.key === 'Escape') setEditing(null); }}
            onBlur={() => { set(i, 2, draft); setEditing(null); }}
            style={{ height: 20, width: Math.max(String(draft).length, 3) + 'ch', boxSizing: 'content-box', padding: '0 4px', border: '1px solid var(--t-color-blue)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', outline: 'none', textAlign: 'right', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }} />
          {suffix ? <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>ngày</span> : null}
        </span>
      : <RulePart strong onClick={() => { setDraft(numeric(r) ? fmtNum(r[2]) : r[2]); setEditing(i); }}>{r[2] ? r[2] + suffix : placeholder(numeric(r) ? 'Đặt số' : 'Đặt giá trị')}</RulePart>;
  };

  return (
    <div ref={ref} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
      {rules.length > 1 ? <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', minHeight: 24, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
          <Icon name="filter" size={16} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" />Khớp điều kiện
        </span>
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', marginRight: -4 }}>
          <RulePart strong open={menu === 'match'} onClick={() => setMenu(menu === 'match' ? null : 'match')}>{match === 'hoặc' ? 'Bất kỳ' : 'Tất cả'}</RulePart>
          {menu === 'match' ? <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 24, right: 0, zIndex: 60 }}>
            <DdSurface width={240}><DdGroup>
              <DdItem text="Khớp tất cả điều kiện" selected={match !== 'hoặc'} tickOnly onClick={() => { onMatchChange('và'); setMenu(null); }} />
              <DdItem text="Khớp bất kỳ điều kiện" selected={match === 'hoặc'} tickOnly onClick={() => { onMatchChange('hoặc'); setMenu(null); }} />
            </DdGroup></DdSurface>
          </span> : null}
        </span>
      </div> : null}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', margin: 'var(--t-spacing-1) 0', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-lighter)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)' }}>
      {!rules.length ? <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Chưa có điều kiện — segment sẽ khớp mọi khách.</span> : null}
      {rules.map((r, i) => (
        <React.Fragment key={i}>
          {i ? <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', height: 18, color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>{match === 'hoặc' ? 'hoặc' : 'và'}</span> : null}
          <div onMouseEnter={() => setHoverRow(i)} onMouseLeave={() => setHoverRow(null)}
            style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr auto 1fr', alignItems: 'center', minHeight: 28, margin: '0 -4px', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>
            <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <RulePart open={menu === i + '-field'} onClick={() => setMenu(menu === i + '-field' ? null : i + '-field')}>
                <Chip label={r[0]} avatar={false} variant="highlighted" />
              </RulePart>
              {menu === i + '-field' ? <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 24, left: 0, zIndex: 60 }}>
                <DdSurface width={240}><DdScroll>
                  {RULE_SCHEMA.map((g) => <React.Fragment key={g.group}>
                    <DdLabel label={g.group} />
                    <DdGroup>{g.fields.map((f) => <DdItem key={f.label} text={f.label} selected={f.label === r[0]} tickOnly onClick={() => { setField(i, f.label); setMenu(null); }} />)}</DdGroup>
                  </React.Fragment>)}
                </DdScroll></DdSurface>
              </span> : null}
            </span>
            <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              <RulePart muted open={menu === i + '-op'} onClick={() => setMenu(menu === i + '-op' ? null : i + '-op')}>{r[1]}</RulePart>
              {menu === i + '-op' ? <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 24, left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)', zIndex: 60 }}>
                <DdSurface width={240}><DdGroup>{opsFor(r[0]).map((o) => <DdItem key={o} text={o} selected={o === r[1]} tickOnly onClick={() => { setOp(i, o); setMenu(null); }} />)}</DdGroup></DdSurface>
              </span> : null}
            </span>
            <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', minWidth: 0, paddingRight: hoverRow === i ? 20 : 0, transition: 'padding 0.1s ease' }}>{valueEditor(r, i)}</span>
            <span style={{ position: 'absolute', right: -4, top: 4, display: 'flex', opacity: hoverRow === i ? 1 : 0, transition: 'opacity 0.1s ease', pointerEvents: hoverRow === i ? 'auto' : 'none' }}>
              <DSIconButton Icon="x" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Xoá điều kiện" onClick={() => remove(i)} />
            </span>
          </div>
        </React.Fragment>
      ))}
      </div>
      <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', paddingTop: 4 }}>
        <DSButton title="Thêm điều kiện" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="plus" onClick={() => onChange(rules.concat([['Lifecycle', 'là', '']]))} />
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        {rules.length ? <DSButton title="Xoá tất cả" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="trash" onClick={() => onChange([])} /> : null}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

function SegmentSidePanel({ record, value, onSave, onClose }) {
  const base = value || { rules: record.rules || [], match: 'và' };
  const [rules, setRules] = React.useState(() => base.rules.map((r) => r.slice()));
  const [match, setMatch] = React.useState(base.match);
  React.useEffect(() => { setRules(base.rules.map((r) => r.slice())); setMatch(base.match); }, [record.id, JSON.stringify(base)]);
  const dirty = JSON.stringify([rules, match]) !== JSON.stringify([base.rules, base.match]);
  const preview = RM_APP_DATA.contacts.rows.slice(0, 4);
  return (
    <div style={{ width: 400, minWidth: 400, flexShrink: 0, height: '100%', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', borderLeft: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', flexShrink: 0, borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 48, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2) 0 var(--t-spacing-3)', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>
          <span style={{ minWidth: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{record.name}</span>
          <span style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}><Tag text={record.status} color={SEGMENT_STATUS_COLOR[record.status] || 'gray'} preventShrink /></span>
          <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
          <DSIconButton Icon="x" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Đóng" onClick={onClose} />
        </div>
        {record.desc ? <div style={{ padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-3) var(--t-spacing-2)', marginTop: -10, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', lineHeight: 1.4, color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', textWrap: 'pretty' }}>{record.desc}</div> : null}
      </div>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', padding: '0 0 var(--t-spacing-6)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
        <PanelSectionList sections={[
          { title: 'Thông tin', content: <React.Fragment>
            <KVRow label="Mã" Icon="hash" value={record.code} />
            <KVRow label="Phụ trách" Icon="user-circle" value={<Chip label={record.owner} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" />} />
            <KVRow label="Đồng bộ" Icon="refresh" value={record.sync} />
            <KVRow label="Nhịp tính lại" Icon="repeat" value="Mỗi 6 giờ" />
          </React.Fragment> },
          { title: 'Thành viên', meta: record.members + ' khách', content: <React.Fragment>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
              {preview.map((c) => <Chip key={c.id} label={c.name} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" />)}
              {Number(record.members) > preview.length ? <Chip label={'+' + (Number(record.members) - preview.length)} avatar={false} variant="highlighted" /> : null}
            </div>
            <span style={{ display: 'flex', paddingTop: 2 }}>
              <DSButton title="Xem trong Customers" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="arrow-up-right" />
            </span>
          </React.Fragment> },
          { title: 'Điều kiện', meta: rules.length ? rules.length + ' điều kiện' : null, content: <RuleRows rules={rules} onChange={setRules} match={match} onMatchChange={setMatch} /> },
        ]} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 40, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1) var(--t-spacing-2)', borderTop: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        {dirty ? <React.Fragment>
          <DSButton title="Huỷ" variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => { setRules(base.rules.map((r) => r.slice())); setMatch(base.match); }} />
          <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
          <DSButton title="Lưu" accent="blue" size="small" onClick={() => onSave && onSave({ rules: rules.map((r) => r.slice()), match })} />
        </React.Fragment> : <React.Fragment>
          <DSIconButton Icon="dots-vertical" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Thêm" style={{ marginRight: 'auto' }} />
          <DSButton title="Nhân bản" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="copy" />
        </React.Fragment>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// entry="inbox" = biến thể Compact của P05: cùng header/thứ tự khối, chỉ mở sẵn khối cần khi đang chat.
function RecordSidePanel({ record, onClose, onExpand, entry, context, onBack, backLabel, extraBody }) {
  const inbox = entry === 'inbox';
  const [tab, setTab] = React.useState('home');
  const [action, setAction] = React.useState(null);
  const rFlags = recordFlags(record);
  // Bấm Attention trong panel khách → mở Attention panel ngay tại chỗ (4C), không rời list
  const [att, setAtt] = React.useState(null);
  const [attDone, setAttDone] = React.useState(false);
  const [callPrompt, setCallPrompt] = React.useState(false);
  // Bấm case trong panel khách / Attention → Case panel ngay tại chỗ, ← về panel trước (§4E.3).
  const [caseV, setCaseV] = React.useState(null);
  React.useEffect(() => { setAtt(null); setAttDone(false); setCaseV(null); }, [record && record.id]);
  const advance = (fromId) => { setCallPrompt(false); const n = mvpNextOpen(record.id, fromId); if (n) { setAttDone(false); setAtt(n.id); } else setAttDone(true); };
  const [openDlg, dlg, dlgPanel] = useMvpDialog(record, advance, setCallPrompt);
  if (action) return <PanelActionPage kind={action} record={record} onClose={() => setAction(null)} readOnly={rFlags.noAccess} />;
  if (dlgPanel) return dlgPanel;
  if (caseV && isFull()) { const cur = caseV.stack[caseV.stack.length - 1]; return <CasePanel key={'rc' + cur} caseId={caseRef(cur)} onClose={onClose}
    onOpenCust={(cid) => { if (record && cid === record.id) setCaseV(null); }}
    onOpenCase={(id) => setCaseV((v) => ({ stack: v.stack.concat([id]) }))}
    onBack={() => setCaseV((v) => (v.stack.length > 1 ? { stack: v.stack.slice(0, -1) } : null))} />; }
  if (att && record) return (
    <React.Fragment>
      {dlg}
      <MvpAttentionPanel record={record} attId={att} caughtUp={attDone} callPrompt={callPrompt} onCallPrompt={setCallPrompt}
        onClose={() => { setAtt(null); setAttDone(false); setCallPrompt(false); }} onSelect={(id) => { setAttDone(false); setAtt(id); }} openDlg={openDlg} onFull={setAction} onOpenCustomer={() => onExpand && onExpand(record)} onOpenCase={(id) => (isFull() ? setCaseV({ stack: [id] }) : onExpand && onExpand(record, 'cases'))} />
    </React.Fragment>
  );

  const isTask = record && record.task !== undefined;
  const isOpp = !isTask && record && record.title !== undefined;
  const isContact = !isTask && record && record.email !== undefined;
  const title = isTask ? record.task : isOpp ? record.title : record ? record.name : '';
  const stage = isOpp ? RM_APP_DATA.stages.find((s) => s.id === record.stage) : null;
  return (
    <div style={{ width: 400, flexShrink: 0, height: '100%', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', borderLeft: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', boxSizing: 'border-box', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {isContact ? (
        <React.Fragment>
        <IdentityBlock record={record} density="compact" onDetail={() => onExpand && onExpand(record)} actions={<React.Fragment>
          {onBack ? <span title={backLabel || 'Quay lại'} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', order: -1 }}><DSIconButton Icon="arrow-left" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel={backLabel || 'Quay lại'} onClick={onBack} /></span> : null}
          <DSIconButton Icon="x" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Close" onClick={onClose} />
        </React.Fragment>} />
        {context ? <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-3)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
          <Icon name="messages" size={14} color="currentColor" /><span style={{ minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{context}</span>
        </div> : null}
        </React.Fragment>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 48, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2) 0 var(--t-spacing-3)', boxSizing: 'border-box', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
          <Avatar placeholder={title} size="lg" style={{ width: 20, height: 20, fontSize: 12 }} />
          <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{title}</span>
          {isTask ? <span style={{ flexShrink: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>Created 7 months ago</span> : null}
          <DSIconButton Icon="layout-sidebar-right-expand" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Expand" />
          <DSIconButton Icon="x" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Close" onClick={onClose} />
        </div>
      )}
      {isTask
        ? <Tabs activeId={tab} onChange={setTab} tabs={[{ id: 'home', label: 'Home', Icon: 'home' }, { id: 'timeline', label: 'Timeline', Icon: 'device-desktop' }, { id: 'files', label: 'Files', Icon: 'paperclip' }]} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
        : isContact
          ? null
          : <Tabs activeId={tab} onChange={setTab} tabs={[{ id: 'home', label: 'Home', Icon: 'target' }, { id: 'timeline', label: 'Activities', Icon: 'message-circle' }]} overflowLabel="+5 More" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />}
      <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', padding: isContact ? '0 0 var(--t-spacing-6)' : 'var(--t-spacing-4) var(--t-spacing-3) var(--t-spacing-6) var(--t-spacing-3)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: isContact ? 0 : 'var(--t-spacing-3)' }}>
        {isContact ? null : <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500, height: 24, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>Fields</div>}
        {isTask ? <React.Fragment>
          <FieldGroup title="Details">
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Due Date" Icon="calendar-event" value={record.due} placeholder="Due Date" />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Status" Icon="check" value={<Tag text={record.status} color="green" />} />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Priority" Icon="flag" value={TASK_PRIORITY_COLOR[record.priority] ? <Tag text={record.priority} color={TASK_PRIORITY_COLOR[record.priority]} /> : record.priority} />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Task Type" Icon="list-details" value={TASK_TYPE_COLOR[record.type] ? <Tag text={record.type} color={TASK_TYPE_COLOR[record.type]} /> : record.type} />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Created From" Icon="transform" value={TASK_SOURCE_COLOR[record.source] ? <Tag text={record.source} color={TASK_SOURCE_COLOR[record.source]} /> : record.source} />
          </FieldGroup>
          <FieldGroup title="Assignment">
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Assignee" Icon="user-circle" value={<Chip label={record.assignee} avatarType="rounded" />} placeholder="Assignee" />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Relations" Icon="arrow-up-right" value={<Chip label={record.related} />} placeholder="Relations" />
          </FieldGroup>
          <FieldGroup title="System">
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Created At" Icon="calendar-event" value="7 months ago" />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Created By" Icon="user-circle" value={<Chip label={record.createdBy} avatarType="rounded" />} />
          </FieldGroup>
          <FieldGroup title="Completion">
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Completed At" Icon="check" placeholder="Completed At" />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Completed By" Icon="user-circle" placeholder="Completed By" />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Completion Note" Icon="file-text" placeholder="Completion Note" />
          </FieldGroup>
          <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', margin: 'var(--t-spacing-2) 0 0', paddingTop: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-3)' }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500 }}>Note</div>
            <div style={{ padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-4)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>{record.note}</div>
          </div>
        </React.Fragment> : isOpp ? <React.Fragment>
          <FieldGroup title="Lead / Opportunity">
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Name" Icon="typography" value={record.title} />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Stage" Icon="progress" value={<Tag text={stage.label} color={stage.color} />} />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Status" Icon="tag" value={<Tag text="Open" color="red" />} />
          </FieldGroup>
          <FieldGroup title="Revenue">
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Expected revenue" Icon="currency-dollar" value={record.amount} />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Expected close" Icon="calendar-event" placeholder="Expected close" />
          </FieldGroup>
          <FieldGroup title="Customer">
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Customer" Icon="user" value={<Chip label={record.company} />} />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Sales rep" Icon="user-circle" value={record.owner ? <Chip label={record.owner} avatarType="rounded" /> : null} placeholder="Sales rep" />
          </FieldGroup>
        </React.Fragment> : isContact ? (isFull() ? <React.Fragment>{extraBody || null}<CustomerPanelBody record={record} entry={entry} onOpenTab={(t) => onExpand && onExpand(record, t)} onOpenAtt={setAtt} onOpenCase={(id) => setCaseV({ stack: [id] })} /></React.Fragment> : <MvpCustomerPanelBody record={record} onOpenAtt={setAtt} onClose={onClose} />) : <React.Fragment>
          <FieldGroup title="Customer segment">
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Name" Icon="typography" value={record.name} />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Code" Icon="hash" value={record.code} />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Condition" Icon="filter" value={record.condition} />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Members" Icon="list-numbers" value={record.members} />
            <FieldRow labelWidth={110} label="Last sync" Icon="calendar-event" value={record.sync} />
          </FieldGroup>
        </React.Fragment>}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 2, height: 40, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1) var(--t-spacing-2)', borderTop: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        {isContact ? <React.Fragment>
          {rFlags.noAccess ? <React.Fragment>
            <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
              <Icon name="lock" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-light)" />
              <span style={{ minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>Ngoài phạm vi phụ trách · chỉ đọc</span>
            </span>
            <DSButton title="Soạn tin" accent="blue" size="small" Icon="mail" disabled />
          </React.Fragment> : !isFull() ? <React.Fragment>{dlg}<MvpPanelFooter record={record} openDlg={openDlg} /></React.Fragment> : <React.Fragment>
            <PanelMoreMenu onPick={setAction} />
            <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
            {inbox ? <React.Fragment>
              {/* Đang chat: gửi tin bằng composer của thread → không lặp Gọi/Soạn tin; Hỏi Trợ lý thay chỗ panel (§9.2) */}
              <DSButton title="Hỏi Trợ lý" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="sparkles" onClick={() => setAction('ai')} />
              <DSButton title="Tạo việc" accent="blue" size="small" Icon="checkbox" onClick={() => setAction('task')} />
            </React.Fragment> : <React.Fragment>
            <DSButton title="Gọi" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="phone" onClick={() => setAction('call')} />
            <DSButton title="Soạn tin" accent="blue" size="small" Icon="mail" onClick={() => setAction('message')} />
            </React.Fragment>}
          </React.Fragment>}
        </React.Fragment> : <React.Fragment>
          <DSIconButton Icon="dots-vertical" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="More" style={{ marginRight: 'auto' }} />
          <DSIconButton Icon="heart" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Favorite" />
          {isTask ? <DSButton title="Delete" Icon="trash" variant="secondary" size="small" /> : null}
        </React.Fragment>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Tên record ở header panel: hiện placeholder "Untitled", bấm vào thành ô nhập
// viền xanh như record show page của Twenty.
function InlineTitle({ placeholder, value, onChange }) {
  const [edit, setEdit] = React.useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState(value || '');
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  const box = { height: 28, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 'var(--t-font-weight-medium)' };
  if (edit) {
    // sizer vô hình cùng font giữ đúng bề rộng nội dung → khung hug chính xác
    return (
      <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', maxWidth: '100%', minWidth: 0 }}>
        <span aria-hidden style={{ ...box, visibility: 'hidden', whiteSpace: 'pre', border: '1px solid transparent' }}>{draft || placeholder}</span>
        <input autoFocus value={draft} placeholder={placeholder}
          onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
          onBlur={() => { onChange(draft); setEdit(false); setH(false); }}
          onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { onChange(draft); setEdit(false); } if (e.key === 'Escape') { setDraft(value || ''); setEdit(false); } }}
          style={{ ...box, position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', border: '1px solid var(--t-color-blue)', outline: 'none', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-light)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }} />
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span onClick={() => { setDraft(value || ''); setEdit(true); }} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
      style={{ ...box, flexShrink: 0, maxWidth: '100%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', cursor: 'pointer', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', color: value ? 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-light)', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
      {value || placeholder}
    </span>
  );
}

// Date picker: Twenty bọc react-datepicker (DatePicker.tsx) — dựng lại cùng cấu
// trúc dropdown (header tháng/năm + nav, grid 7 cột, ngày chọn nền xanh, Clear).
const DP_DOW = ['T2', 'T3', 'T4', 'T5', 'T6', 'T7', 'CN'];
const DP_MONTH = ['Tháng 1', 'Tháng 2', 'Tháng 3', 'Tháng 4', 'Tháng 5', 'Tháng 6', 'Tháng 7', 'Tháng 8', 'Tháng 9', 'Tháng 10', 'Tháng 11', 'Tháng 12'];
const DP_MON_SHORT = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
const dpFmt = (d, time) => d.getDate() + ' ' + DP_MON_SHORT[d.getMonth()] + ', ' + d.getFullYear() + (time ? ' ' + time : '');
const dpParse = (v) => {
  if (!v) return null;
  const m = String(v).match(/^(\d{1,2}) (\w{3}), (\d{4})(?: (\d{2}:\d{2}))?$/);
  if (!m) return null;
  const mi = DP_MON_SHORT.indexOf(m[2]);
  return { date: new Date(Number(m[3]), mi < 0 ? 0 : mi, Number(m[1])), time: m[4] || '' };
};

function DatePickerDropdown({ value, onPick, onClear, onClose, align, up, at }) {
  const parsed = dpParse(value);
  const init = parsed ? parsed.date : new Date();
  const [view, setView] = React.useState(new Date(init.getFullYear(), init.getMonth(), 1));
  const [time, setTime] = React.useState(parsed && parsed.time ? parsed.time : '09:00');
  const first = new Date(view.getFullYear(), view.getMonth(), 1);
  const lead = (first.getDay() + 6) % 7;
  const days = new Date(view.getFullYear(), view.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();
  const cells = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < lead; i++) cells.push(null);
  for (let d = 1; d <= days; d++) cells.push(new Date(view.getFullYear(), view.getMonth(), d));
  const shift = (n) => setView(new Date(view.getFullYear(), view.getMonth() + n, 1));
  const today = new Date();
  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <span onClick={onClose} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 40 }} />
      <span style={{ position: at ? 'fixed' : 'absolute', top: at ? at.top : up ? 'auto' : 'calc(100% + 4px)', bottom: at ? at.bottom : up ? 'calc(100% + 4px)' : 'auto', left: at ? at.left : align === 'right' ? 'auto' : 0, right: at ? at.right : align === 'right' ? 0 : 'auto', zIndex: 41, width: 240, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
          <DSIconButton Icon="chevron-left" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Tháng trước" onClick={() => shift(-1)} />
          <span style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 'var(--t-font-weight-medium)' }}>{DP_MONTH[view.getMonth()]} {view.getFullYear()}</span>
          <DSIconButton Icon="chevron-right" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Tháng sau" onClick={() => shift(1)} />
        </span>
        <span style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(7, 1fr)', gap: 2, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
          {DP_DOW.map((d) => <span key={d} style={{ height: 24, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>{d}</span>)}
          {cells.map((d, i) => d ? (
            <DayCell key={i} date={d} selected={parsed ? dpFmt(d) === dpFmt(parsed.date) : false} isToday={dpFmt(d) === dpFmt(today)} onPick={() => onPick(dpFmt(d, time))} />
          ) : <span key={i} />)}
        </span>
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1) var(--t-spacing-2)', borderTop: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
          <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
            <Icon name="clock" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" />
            <input type="time" value={time} onChange={(e) => setTime(e.target.value || '09:00')}
              style={{ width: 74, height: 24, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', outline: 'none', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }} />
          </span>
          <LightButton title="Hôm nay" accent="tertiary" onClick={() => onPick(dpFmt(today, time))} />
          <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
          <LightButton title="Clear" accent="tertiary" onClick={onClear} />
        </span>
      </span>
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

function DayCell({ date, selected, isToday, onPick }) {
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <span onClick={onPick} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
      style={{ height: 24, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: isToday ? 'var(--t-font-weight-semi-bold)' : 'var(--t-font-weight-regular)', background: selected ? 'var(--t-color-blue)' : h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', color: selected ? 'var(--t-gray-scale-gray1)' : 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }}>
      {date.getDate()}
    </span>
  );
}

function InlineDate({ placeholder, value, onChange, align }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [up, setUp] = React.useState(false);
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  const ref = React.useRef(null);
  const [flip, setFlip] = React.useState(false);
  const [at, setAt] = React.useState(null);
  const toggle = () => {
    if (!open && ref.current) {
      const r = ref.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const u = window.innerHeight - r.bottom < 300;
      const f = window.innerWidth - r.left < 248;
      setUp(u);
      // lịch rộng 240 — neo phải nếu bên phải không đủ chỗ
      setFlip(f);
      setAt({ top: u ? 'auto' : r.bottom + 4, bottom: u ? window.innerHeight - r.top + 4 : 'auto', left: f ? 'auto' : r.left, right: f ? window.innerWidth - r.right : 'auto' });
    }
    setOpen((o) => !o);
  };
  return (
    <span ref={ref} style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex' }}>
      <span onClick={toggle} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
        style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', height: 24, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: 'pointer', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', color: value ? 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>
        {value || placeholder}
      </span>
      {open ? <DatePickerDropdown align={align || (flip ? 'right' : undefined)} up={up} at={at} value={value} onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        onPick={(v) => { onChange(v); setOpen(false); setH(false); }}
        onClear={() => { onChange(''); setOpen(false); setH(false); }} /> : null}
    </span>
  );
}

// FieldRow của DS clip nội dung (overflow hidden) nên dropdown bị cắt — hàng
// sửa được dùng lại đúng layout đó nhưng để overflow visible.
// Hàng field trong panel: label trái, giá trị căn phải — cùng format với KVRow
// ở panel khách (Liên hệ gần đây / Key facts).
function EditFieldRow({ label, Icon: ic, children }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', minHeight: 24, width: '100%', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>
      <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', overflow: 'hidden', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
        {ic ? <Icon name={ic} size={16} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} /> : null}
        <span style={{ minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>{label}</span>
      </span>
      <span style={{ flexShrink: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'flex-end', minHeight: 24 }}>{children}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

// Giá trị sửa được ở panel: pill (text), select (tag), date (picker).
function EditableValue({ kind, initial, placeholder, options, format, onCommit }) {
  const [v, setV] = React.useState(initial || '');
  const set = (nv) => { setV(nv); if (onCommit) onCommit(nv); };
  if (kind === 'select') return <InlineSelect value={v} onChange={set} options={options} />;
  if (kind === 'date') return <InlineDate align="right" value={v} placeholder={placeholder} onChange={set} />;
  return <InlinePill value={v} placeholder={placeholder} onChange={set} format={format} />;
}

// Dữ liệu nhạy cảm che mặc định (layout §2 · P31.masked-field): giá trị thật chỉ
// hiện khi bấm "Hiện", mỗi lần hiện ghi một dòng nhật ký truy cập; rời record thì che lại.
function maskText(kind, v) {
  const s = String(v || '');
  if (!s) return '';
  if (kind === 'email') { const p = s.split('@'); return (p[0] || '').slice(0, 1) + '•••@' + (p[1] || ''); }
  if (kind === 'account') return s.slice(0, 4) + '••••' + s.slice(-2);
  if (kind === 'id') return '••• ••• ' + s.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-3);
  if (kind === 'address') return '••• ' + (s.split(',').pop() || '').trim();
  const d = s.replace(/\D/g, '');
  const head = d.length > 3 ? d.slice(0, d.length - 3).replace(/\d/g, '•') : '';
  return ((head.match(/.{1,3}/g) || []).join(' ') + ' ' + d.slice(-3)).trim();
}

function MaskedValue({ kind = 'phone', value, children }) {
  const [shown, setShown] = React.useState(false);
  const [at, setAt] = React.useState(null);
  if (viewerRole().redacted) {
    return (
      <span title="Vai trò Ops không được xem trường này" style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>
        <Icon name="lock" size={13} color="var(--t-font-color-light)" />
        <span>Ẩn theo vai trò</span>
      </span>
    );
  }
  const [tip, setTip] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2, minWidth: 0 }}>
      {shown
        ? (children || <HugValue>{value}</HugValue>)
        : <HugValue><span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)' }}>{maskText(kind, value)}</span></HugValue>}
      <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', flexShrink: 0 }} onMouseEnter={(e) => { const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(); setTip({ top: r.top - 4, right: Math.max(8, window.innerWidth - r.right) }); }} onMouseLeave={() => setTip(false)}>
        <DSIconButton Icon={shown ? 'eye-off' : 'eye'} variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel={shown ? 'Ẩn giá trị' : 'Hiện giá trị'}
          onClick={() => { if (shown) { setShown(false); } else { setShown(true); setAt(new Date().toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })); } }} />
        {tip ? (
          <span style={{ position: 'fixed', top: tip.top, right: tip.right, transform: 'translateY(-100%)', zIndex: 2000, width: 200, whiteSpace: 'normal', lineHeight: 1.4, padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1) var(--t-spacing-2)', background: 'rgba(48,48,48,.92)', color: '#fff', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', lineHeight: 1.4, pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
            {shown ? 'Đã ghi nhật ký truy cập lúc ' + (at || '') : 'Hiện giá trị đầy đủ — thao tác được ghi nhật ký'}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

// Số điện thoại luôn về chuẩn "+84 xxx xxx xxx" — user không phải tự đánh dấu cách.
function formatPhone(v) {
  let d = String(v || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (d.startsWith('84')) d = d.slice(2);
  else if (d.startsWith('0')) d = d.slice(1);
  if (!d) return '';
  const g = d.match(/.{1,3}/g) || [];
  return '+84 ' + g.join(' ');
}

// Text sửa được nhưng hiển thị dạng pill (điện thoại, email) như trong bảng.
function InlinePill({ value, placeholder, onChange, format }) {
  const [edit, setEdit] = React.useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState(value || '');
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  if (edit) {
    return (
      <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', maxWidth: 220 }}>
        <span aria-hidden style={{ visibility: 'hidden', whiteSpace: 'pre', height: 24, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', border: '1px solid transparent', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>{draft || placeholder}</span>
        <input autoFocus value={draft} placeholder={placeholder}
          onChange={(e) => setDraft(format === 'phone' ? formatPhone(e.target.value) : e.target.value)}
          onBlur={() => { onChange(format === 'phone' ? formatPhone(draft) : draft.trim()); setEdit(false); setH(false); }}
          onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { onChange(format === 'phone' ? formatPhone(draft) : draft.trim()); setEdit(false); } if (e.key === 'Escape') setEdit(false); }}
          style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', height: 24, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', border: '1px solid var(--t-color-blue)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', outline: 'none', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-light)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }} />
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span onClick={() => { setDraft(value || ''); setEdit(true); }} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
      style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', height: 24, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: 'pointer', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent' }}>
      {value ? <ValuePill text={value} /> : <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>{placeholder}</span>}
    </span>
  );
}

// Giá trị tĩnh: hover bám sát nội dung (hug) như các ô sửa được, không full width
function HugValue({ children }) {
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <span onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
      style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', height: 24, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent' }}>
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

// Ô nhập / chọn option trong panel tạo việc — bấm vào value để sửa như Twenty.
function InlineText({ placeholder, value, onChange }) {
  const [edit, setEdit] = React.useState(false);
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  if (edit) {
    return (
      <input autoFocus defaultValue={value} placeholder={placeholder} onBlur={(e) => { onChange(e.target.value); setEdit(false); }}
        onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { onChange(e.target.value); setEdit(false); } if (e.key === 'Escape') setEdit(false); }}
        style={{ width: '100%', height: 24, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', border: '1px solid var(--t-color-blue)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', outline: 'none', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }} />
    );
  }
  return (
    <span onClick={() => { setDraft(value || ''); setEdit(true); }} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
      style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', height: 24, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: 'pointer', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', color: value ? 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>
      {value || placeholder}
    </span>
  );
}

function InlineSelect({ options, value, onChange, render, caret, placeholder }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [up, setUp] = React.useState(false);
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  const ref = React.useRef(null);
  const hit = options.find((o) => o.value === value);
  const cur = hit || options[0];
  const [at, setAt] = React.useState(null);
  const toggle = () => {
    if (!open && ref.current) {
      const r = ref.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      // lật lên khi phía dưới không đủ chỗ cho cả list
      const flip = window.innerHeight - r.bottom < Math.min(options.length * 32 + 16, 220);
      setUp(flip);
      setAt({ top: flip ? 'auto' : r.bottom + 2, bottom: flip ? window.innerHeight - r.top + 2 : 'auto', right: window.innerWidth - r.right });
    }
    setOpen((o) => !o);
  };
  return (
    <span ref={ref} style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex' }}>
      <span onClick={toggle} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
        style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', height: caret ? 28 : 24, padding: caret ? '0 var(--t-spacing-1) 0 var(--t-spacing-2)' : '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', border: caret ? '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)' : 'none', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: 'pointer', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : caret ? 'var(--t-background-primary)' : 'transparent' }}>
        {!hit && placeholder ? <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>{placeholder}</span> : render ? render(cur) : <Tag text={cur.value} color={cur.color} preventShrink />}
        {caret ? <Icon name="chevron-down" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-light)" /> : null}
      </span>
      {open ? ((n) => window.ReactDOM && window.ReactDOM.createPortal ? window.ReactDOM.createPortal(n, document.body) : n)(
        <React.Fragment>
          <span onClick={() => setOpen(false)} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 2000 }} />
          <span style={{ position: 'fixed', top: at ? at.top : 'auto', bottom: at ? at.bottom : 'auto', right: at ? at.right : 12, zIndex: 2001, fontFamily: 'var(--t-font-family)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', minWidth: 160, maxHeight: 220, overflowY: 'auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)' }}>
            {options.map((o) => (
              <PanelOptionItem key={o.value} selected={!!hit && o.value === cur.value} onPick={() => { setOpen(false); onChange(o.value); }}>
                {render ? render(o) : <Tag text={o.value} color={o.color} preventShrink />}
              </PanelOptionItem>
            ))}
          </span>
        </React.Fragment>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
}

function PanelOptionItem({ children, selected, onPick }) {
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <span onClick={onPick} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
      style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 32, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: 'pointer', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent' }}>
      <span style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex' }}>{children}</span>
      {selected ? <Icon name="check" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" /> : null}
    </span>
  );
}

// Khung nhập nội dung theo AdvancedTextEditor của Twenty: vùng rich text +
// bubble menu hiện khi bôi đen (bold/italic/underline/strike/list), container
// inline-flex radius md, padding 2, gap 2 như StyledBubbleMenuContainer.
function RichTextArea({ placeholder, minHeight = 120, initialHtml, fill }) {
  const ref = React.useRef(null);
  const [empty, setEmpty] = React.useState(!!initialHtml === false);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (initialHtml && ref.current && !ref.current.textContent.trim()) {
      ref.current.innerHTML = initialHtml;
      setEmpty(false);
    }
  }, [initialHtml]);
  const [bubble, setBubble] = React.useState(null);
  const [handle, setHandle] = React.useState(false);
  const [hTop, setHTop] = React.useState(0);
  const [hH, setHH] = React.useState(null);
  const [phTop, setPhTop] = React.useState(null);
  const [phText, setPhText] = React.useState('');
  const [phStyle, setPhStyle] = React.useState({});
  const blockRef = React.useRef(null);
  const bubbleRef = React.useRef(null);
  const [menu, setMenu] = React.useState(false);
  const [sub, setSub] = React.useState(null);
  const [turn, setTurn] = React.useState(false);
  const [turnLabel, setTurnLabel] = React.useState('Paragraph');
  const [pal, setPal] = React.useState(false);
  React.useEffect(() => { try { document.execCommand('defaultParagraphSeparator', false, 'div'); } catch (e) {} }, []);
  // bám mọi thay đổi selection (kể cả kéo chuột ngoài editor) để bubble luôn đúng
  const dragRef = React.useRef(false);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const onSel = () => { if (ref.current && !dragRef.current) syncRef.current(); };
    document.addEventListener('selectionchange', onSel);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('selectionchange', onSel);
  }, []);
  // 2. bấm ra ngoài thì đóng dropdown của thanh format
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!turn && !pal) return;
    const onDown = (e) => { if (!bubbleRef.current || !bubbleRef.current.contains(e.target)) { setTurn(false); setPal(false); } };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown, true);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDown, true);
  }, [turn, pal]);
  const syncRef = React.useRef(() => {});
  const [marks, setMarks] = React.useState({});
  // mọi dòng phải là block riêng: text node trần ở gốc được bọc vào <div>
  // (nếu không, dòng đầu không có handle, Delete/căn lề/indent không áp được)
  const normalize = () => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    // heading/paragraph trong editor không mang margin mặc định của browser,
    // nếu không đổi sang heading sẽ trông như chèn thêm một dòng trống
    Array.from(el.children).forEach((c) => {
      if (/^(H1|H2|H3|P|UL|OL|DIV)$/.test(c.tagName)) { c.style.margin = '0'; c.style.padding = c.tagName === 'UL' || c.tagName === 'OL' ? '0 0 0 1.2em' : '0'; }
    });
    const strays = Array.from(el.childNodes).filter((n) => n.nodeType === 3 && n.textContent.trim());
    if (!strays.length) return;
    const sel = window.getSelection();
    const off = sel && sel.anchorNode && el.contains(sel.anchorNode) ? sel.anchorOffset : null;
    const anchor = sel ? sel.anchorNode : null;
    strays.forEach((n) => {
      const d = document.createElement('div');
      n.parentNode.insertBefore(d, n);
      d.appendChild(n);
      if (anchor === n && off !== null) {
        const r = document.createRange();
        r.setStart(n, Math.min(off, n.textContent.length));
        r.collapse(true);
        sel.removeAllRanges();
        sel.addRange(r);
      }
    });
  };
  const sync = () => {
    normalize();
    const el = ref.current;
    if (el) setEmpty(!el.textContent.trim());
    if (el) {
      const sel0 = window.getSelection();
      let top = null;
      if (sel0 && sel0.anchorNode && el.contains(sel0.anchorNode) && sel0.isCollapsed) {
        let blk = sel0.anchorNode;
        while (blk && blk !== el && blk.parentNode !== el) blk = blk.parentNode;
        if (blk && blk !== el && blk.nodeType === 1 && !blk.textContent.trim()) {
          const host = (el.offsetParent || el).getBoundingClientRect();
          const br = blk.getBoundingClientRect();
          top = br.top - host.top;
          const tag = blk.tagName;
          const ph = tag === 'H1' ? 'Heading 1' : tag === 'H2' ? 'Heading 2' : tag === 'H3' ? 'Heading 3'
            : tag === 'UL' || tag === 'OL' ? 'List' : placeholder;
          setPhText(ph);
          setPhStyle({
            fontSize: tag === 'H1' ? '2em' : tag === 'H2' ? '1.5em' : tag === 'H3' ? '1.17em' : 'var(--t-font-size-md)',
            fontWeight: /^H[123]$/.test(tag) ? 'var(--t-font-weight-semi-bold)' : 'var(--t-font-weight-regular)',
            paddingLeft: tag === 'UL' || tag === 'OL' ? '1.2em' : 0,
          });
        }
      }
      setPhTop(top);
    }
    const sel = window.getSelection();
    if (!sel || sel.isCollapsed || !el || !sel.anchorNode || !el.contains(sel.anchorNode)) { setBubble(null); return; }
    const r = sel.getRangeAt(0).getBoundingClientRect();
    const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const bw = bubbleRef.current ? bubbleRef.current.offsetWidth : 460;
    const maxLeft = Math.max(0, box.width - bw - 4);
    setBubble({ top: r.top - box.top - 34, left: Math.min(Math.max(0, r.left - box.left), maxLeft) });
    setMarks({
      bold: document.queryCommandState('bold'), italic: document.queryCommandState('italic'),
      underline: document.queryCommandState('underline'), strike: document.queryCommandState('strikeThrough'),
      ul: document.queryCommandState('insertUnorderedList'), ol: document.queryCommandState('insertOrderedList'),
    });
  };
  // mỗi block (dòng sau khi Enter) có handle riêng, bám theo block đang hover
  const trackBlock = (e) => {
    if (menu) return;
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    // chỉ nhận khi con trỏ nằm trong đúng chiều cao của một dòng/block
    if (e.clientX < box.left - 24 || e.clientX > box.right || e.clientY < box.top || e.clientY > box.bottom) { setHandle(false); return; }
    const kids = Array.from(el.children);
    const host = (el.offsetParent || el).getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!kids.length) {
      const lineH = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).lineHeight) || 21;
      if (e.clientY > box.top + lineH) { setHandle(false); return; }
      blockRef.current = null;
      setHTop(box.top - host.top);
      setHH(lineH);
      setHandle(true);
      return;
    }
    const hit = kids.find((k) => { const r = k.getBoundingClientRect(); return e.clientY >= r.top && e.clientY <= r.bottom; });
    if (!hit) {
      // dòng đầu có thể là text node thuần (không phải element) → nhận theo dải dòng đầu
      const firstTop = kids[0].getBoundingClientRect().top;
      if (e.clientY >= box.top && e.clientY < firstTop) {
        blockRef.current = null;
        setHTop(box.top - host.top);
        setHH(parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).lineHeight) || 21);
        setHandle(true);
        return;
      }
      setHandle(false);
      return;
    }
    blockRef.current = hit;
    const hr = hit.getBoundingClientRect();
    setHTop(hr.top - host.top);
    setHH(parseFloat(getComputedStyle(hit).lineHeight) || hr.height);
    setHandle(true);
  };

  const blocks = [
    { id: 'paragraph', text: 'Paragraph', icon: 'pilcrow', tag: 'div', cmd: () => document.execCommand('formatBlock', false, 'p') },
    { id: 'h1', text: 'Heading 1', icon: 'h-1', tag: 'h1', cmd: () => document.execCommand('formatBlock', false, 'h1') },
    { id: 'h2', text: 'Heading 2', icon: 'h-2', tag: 'h2', cmd: () => document.execCommand('formatBlock', false, 'h2') },
    { id: 'h3', text: 'Heading 3', icon: 'h-3', tag: 'h3', cmd: () => document.execCommand('formatBlock', false, 'h3') },
    { id: 'ul', text: 'Bullet List', icon: 'list', tag: 'ul', cmd: () => document.execCommand('insertUnorderedList') },
    { id: 'ol', text: 'Ordered List', icon: 'list-numbers', tag: 'ol', cmd: () => document.execCommand('insertOrderedList') },
  ];
  const colors = [
    { id: 'default', text: 'Default', value: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', hex: '#141414' },
    { id: 'gray', text: 'Gray', value: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', hex: '#818181' },
    { id: 'blue', text: 'Blue', value: 'var(--t-color-blue)', hex: '#3b82f6' },
    { id: 'green', text: 'Green', value: 'var(--t-tag-text-green)', hex: '#199a5d' },
    { id: 'yellow', text: 'Yellow', value: 'var(--t-tag-text-yellow)', hex: '#b78108' },
    { id: 'red', text: 'Red', value: 'var(--t-font-color-danger)', hex: '#e13e3b' },
  ];
  const apply = (fn) => { if (ref.current) ref.current.focus(); fn(); setMenu(false); setSub(null); sync(); };
  // Add Block ≠ bôi đen sửa: tạo hẳn một dòng mới bên dưới với format đã chọn
  const addBlock = (tag) => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const node = document.createElement(tag === 'ul' || tag === 'ol' ? tag : tag);
    if (tag === 'ul' || tag === 'ol') node.appendChild(document.createElement('li'));
    else node.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));
    node.style.margin = '0';
    const after = blockRef.current && blockRef.current.parentNode === el ? blockRef.current : el.lastElementChild;
    if (after) after.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', node);
    else el.appendChild(node);
    const target = node.firstElementChild && node.tagName !== 'UL' && node.tagName !== 'OL' ? node : (node.firstElementChild || node);
    const r = document.createRange();
    r.setStart(target, 0);
    r.collapse(true);
    const sel = window.getSelection();
    sel.removeAllRanges();
    sel.addRange(r);
    el.focus();
    setMenu(false);
    setSub(null);
    sync();
  };
  syncRef.current = sync;
  const run = (cmd) => { if (ref.current) ref.current.focus(); document.execCommand(cmd, false); sync(); };
  const actions = [
    { id: 'bold', icon: 'bold', cmd: 'bold' }, { id: 'italic', icon: 'italic', cmd: 'italic' },
    { id: 'underline', icon: 'underline', cmd: 'underline' }, { id: 'strike', icon: 'strikethrough', cmd: 'strikeThrough' },
    { id: 'ul', icon: 'list', cmd: 'insertUnorderedList' }, { id: 'ol', icon: 'list-numbers', cmd: 'insertOrderedList' },
  ];
  return (
    <div style={fill ? { position: 'relative', flex: '1 1 auto', minHeight: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' } : { position: 'relative' }} onMouseMove={trackBlock} onMouseLeave={() => { if (!menu) setHandle(false); }}>
      {handle || menu ? (
        <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: hTop, left: -8, height: hH || 'calc(1.6 * var(--t-font-size-md))', zIndex: 15, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DSIconButton icon={<Icon name="grip-vertical" size={14} />} variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Tùy chọn block" onClick={() => { setSub(null); setMenu((m) => !m); }} />
          {menu ? (
            <React.Fragment>
              <span onClick={() => { setMenu(false); setSub(null); }} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 15 }} />
              <span onMouseMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 24, left: 16, zIndex: 16 }}>
                <DS.DropdownMenu width={210}>
                  {sub === 'block' ? (
                    <React.Fragment>
                      <DS.MenuItem text="Add Block" LeftIcon="chevron-left" onClick={() => setSub(null)} />
                      <DS.MenuItemSeparator />
                      {blocks.map((b) => <DS.MenuItem key={b.id} text={b.text} LeftIcon={b.icon} onClick={() => addBlock(b.tag)} />)}
                    </React.Fragment>
                  ) : sub === 'color' ? (
                    <React.Fragment>
                      <DS.MenuItem text="Change Color" LeftIcon="chevron-left" onClick={() => setSub(null)} />
                      <DS.MenuItemSeparator />
                      {colors.map((c) => (
                        <DS.MenuItem key={c.id} text={c.text} onClick={() => apply(() => document.execCommand('foreColor', false, c.hex))}
                          LeftComponent={<span style={{ width: 14, height: 14, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-xs)', background: c.value, border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)' }} />} />
                      ))}
                    </React.Fragment>
                  ) : (
                    <React.Fragment>
                      <DS.MenuItem text="Add Block" LeftIcon="plus" hasSubMenu onClick={() => setSub('block')} />
                      <DS.MenuItem text="Change Color" LeftIcon="color-swatch" hasSubMenu onClick={() => setSub('color')} />
                      <DS.MenuItemSeparator />
                      <DS.MenuItem text="Delete" LeftIcon="trash" iconColor="var(--t-font-color-danger)" accent="danger" onClick={() => { const b = blockRef.current; if (b && b.parentNode === ref.current) b.remove(); else if (ref.current) ref.current.innerHTML = ''; if (ref.current) setEmpty(!ref.current.textContent.trim()); setMenu(false); setSub(null); }} />
                    </React.Fragment>
                  )}
                </DS.DropdownMenu>
              </span>
            </React.Fragment>
          ) : null}
        </span>
      ) : null}
      {bubble ? (
        <span ref={bubbleRef} style={{ position: 'absolute', top: bubble.top, left: bubble.left, maxWidth: '100%', zIndex: 20, display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'nowrap', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2, padding: 2, backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', boxShadow: '0 2px 4px 0 var(--t-background-transparent-light), 0 0 4px 0 var(--t-background-transparent-medium)' }}
          onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()} onMouseMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
          <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex' }}>
            <span onClick={() => { setPal(false); setTurn((t) => !t); }} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', flexShrink: 0, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', gap: 4, height: 24, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
              <Icon name="pilcrow" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} /><span style={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{turnLabel}</span><Icon name="chevron-down" size={12} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
            </span>
            {turn ? (
              <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 26, left: 0, zIndex: 21 }}>
                <DS.DropdownMenu width={180}>
                  {blocks.map((bl) => <DS.MenuItem key={bl.id} text={bl.text} LeftIcon={bl.icon} onClick={() => { setTurnLabel(bl.text); setTurn(false); apply(bl.cmd); }} />)}
                </DS.DropdownMenu>
              </span>
            ) : null}
          </span>
          {actions.map((x) => (
            <DSIconButton key={x.id} icon={<Icon name={x.icon} size={14} />} variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" active={!!marks[x.id]} ariaLabel={x.id} onClick={() => run(x.cmd)} />
          ))}
          <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex' }}>
            <DSIconButton icon={<Icon name="dots" size={14} />} variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Thêm" onClick={() => { setTurn(false); setPal((p) => !p); }} />
            {pal ? (
              <span onMouseMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 26, right: 0, zIndex: 21 }}>
                <DS.DropdownMenu width={190}>
                  <DS.MenuItem text="Căn trái" LeftIcon="align-left" onClick={() => { setPal(false); run('justifyLeft'); }} />
                  <DS.MenuItem text="Căn giữa" LeftIcon="align-center" onClick={() => { setPal(false); run('justifyCenter'); }} />
                  <DS.MenuItem text="Căn phải" LeftIcon="align-right" onClick={() => { setPal(false); run('justifyRight'); }} />
                  <DS.MenuItemSeparator />
                  <DS.MenuItem text="Giảm thụt lề" LeftIcon="indent-decrease" onClick={() => { setPal(false); run('outdent'); }} />
                  <DS.MenuItem text="Tăng thụt lề" LeftIcon="indent-increase" onClick={() => { setPal(false); run('indent'); }} />
                  <DS.MenuItemSeparator />
                  {colors.map((c) => (
                    <DS.MenuItem key={c.id} text={c.text} onClick={() => { setPal(false); apply(() => document.execCommand('foreColor', false, c.hex)); }}
                      LeftComponent={<span style={{ width: 14, height: 14, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-xs)', background: c.value, border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)' }} />} />
                  ))}
                </DS.DropdownMenu>
              </span>
            ) : null}
          </span>
          <DSIconButton icon={<Icon name="link" size={14} />} variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="link"
            onClick={() => { const u = window.prompt('Liên kết'); if (u) document.execCommand('createLink', false, u); sync(); }} />
        </span>
      ) : null}
      <div ref={ref} contentEditable suppressContentEditableWarning onInput={sync} onKeyUp={sync}
        onMouseDown={() => { dragRef.current = true; setBubble(null); }}
        onMouseUp={() => { dragRef.current = false; setTimeout(() => syncRef.current(), 0); }} onBlur={() => setBubble(null)}
        style={{ minHeight, ...(fill ? { flex: '1 1 auto' } : null), padding: '0 0 0 var(--t-spacing-5)', display: 'flow-root', outline: 'none', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', lineHeight: 1.6, color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }} />
      {!empty && phTop !== null ? <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: phTop, left: 'var(--t-spacing-5)', fontStyle: 'italic', color: 'var(--t-font-color-extra-light)', lineHeight: 1.6, pointerEvents: 'none', ...phStyle }}>{phText || placeholder}</span> : null}
      {empty ? <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, left: 'var(--t-spacing-5)', fontStyle: 'italic', color: 'var(--t-font-color-extra-light)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', lineHeight: 1.6, pointerEvents: 'none' }}>{placeholder}</span> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

// Hành động ở footer panel tái sử dụng component có sẵn: "Hỏi Trợ lý" là chính
// AiChatPanel (New chat) nhưng seed trước context khách; "Tạo việc" dùng khung
// field của record panel (giống form tạo task ở trang Tasks); "Soạn tin" là
// trang con của side panel theo pattern compose của Twenty.
// Dismiss dropdown bằng listener mousedown thay vì backdrop phủ toàn màn hình:
// backdrop nuốt mất cú click đầu tiên, khiến mọi nút khác "bấm không ăn".
function useDismiss(open, close) {
  const ref = React.useRef(null);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDown = (e) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) close(); };
    const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(); };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => { document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDown, true); document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); };
  }, [open, close]);
  return ref;
}

// Vai trò người đang xem (flows_00 §7.3). Broker là mặc định; các vai khác
// xem cùng một trang nhưng khác quyền ghi và khác phạm vi trường được thấy.
let VIEWER_ROLE = 'broker';
const ROLES = {
  broker: { label: 'Broker', canWrite: true },
  supervisor: { label: 'Supervisor', canWrite: true, isSupervisor: true },
  compliance: { label: 'Compliance', canWrite: false, seeApprovals: true },
  ops: { label: 'Ops', canWrite: false, redacted: true, noAdvisory: true },
};
function viewerRole() { return ROLES[VIEWER_ROLE] || ROLES.broker; }

// Ép trạng thái block để demo (không phải hành vi thật của hệ thống).
let DEMO_BLOCK_STATE = null;
const DEMO_STATE_NOTE = {
  loading: 'Đang lấy dữ liệu từ hệ thống nguồn.',
  empty: 'Chưa có dữ liệu cho khách này.',
  error: 'Không lấy được dữ liệu từ hệ thống nguồn. Số liệu trong trang có thể cũ hơn thực tế.',
  denied: 'Bạn không có quyền xem nội dung này.',
};

// Cờ vận hành của một khách — mọi nơi (trang C360, side panel ở list) phải đọc
// cùng một nguồn, không tự suy luận quyền riêng. Mockup: gán theo id.
function recordFlags(record) {
  const r = resolveRecord(record);
  const rid = r && r.id;
  const role = viewerRole();
  return {
    role: role,
    readOnly: !role.canWrite,
    redacted: !!role.redacted,
    noAdvisory: !!role.noAdvisory,
    killSwitch: rid === 'c4',
    noAccess: rid === 'c13' || !role.canWrite,
    shadow: rid === 'c6',
    logOnly: rid === 'c6', // pipeline P3 của khách đang Log-only (D-02)
    staleData: mvpCust({ id: rid }).health === 'stale',
    // Đợt backfill 05/09 — cửa xác nhận 2 tuần, hết hạn thì thôi hỏi.
    backfill: rid === 'c1' || rid === 'c5' || rid === 'c9' ? { at: '05/09', daysLeft: 6 } : null,
    // Độ tin cậy thấp / dữ liệu cũ → không sinh đề xuất, thay bằng việc rà soát tay (B2).
    lowConfidence: rid === 'c5',
    // Khách P2 chưa nạp tiền lần đầu: KPI và danh mục chưa có dữ liệu.
    fundingPending: rid === 'c15' || rid === 'c16',
    outOfScope: rid === 'c13',
    noOwner: !!(r && r.noOwner),
    leftPilot: r && r.leftPilot ? r.leftPilot : null,
    hold: !!(r && r.lifecycle === 'At Risk'),
  };
}
