const ROW_ACTION_LABEL = { task: 'Tạo việc', message: 'Soạn tin', call: 'Ghi nhận cuộc gọi', callprep: 'Chuẩn bị cuộc gọi', note: 'Ghi chú', email: 'Soạn email' };

function TaskLifecycle({ onAction }) {
  const [mode, setMode] = React.useState(null);
  const [state, setState] = React.useState(null);
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = React.useState('Đã kết nối');
  const [note, setNote] = React.useState('');
  const [due, setDue] = React.useState('');
  const [reason, setReason] = React.useState('Không còn cần');
  const [next, setNext] = React.useState(false);
  if (state) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>
          <Tag text={state.tag} color={state.color} preventShrink />
          <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>{state.text}</span>
        </span>
        {state.kind === 'done' ? (
          <React.Fragment>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>Đã ghi vào lịch sử liên hệ của khách (chiều gửi đi · kênh Gọi).</span>
            {next ? <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}><Icon name="arrow-right" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-light)" />Đã tạo việc kế: Gửi phương án sau cuộc gọi · hạn 18/09</span>
              : <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}><DSButton title="Tạo việc kế tiếp" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="plus" onClick={() => setNext(true)} /></span>}
          </React.Fragment>
        ) : null}
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
          {state.kind === 'cancelled' || state.kind === 'done' ? <DSButton title="Mở lại việc" variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => { setState(null); setNext(false); }} /> : null}
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (mode === 'done') {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
        <SignalRow label="Kết quả" value={<InlineSelect value={outcome} onChange={setOutcome} options={[{ value: 'Đã kết nối', color: 'green' }, { value: 'Không bắt máy', color: 'yellow' }, { value: 'Hẹn gọi lại', color: 'blue' }]} />} />
        <SignalRow label="Ghi chú" value={<EditableValue kind="text" initial={note} placeholder="Thêm ghi chú" onCommit={setNote} />} />
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
          <DSButton title="Lưu kết quả" accent="blue" size="small" onClick={() => { setMode(null); setState({ kind: 'done', tag: 'Đã xong', color: 'green', text: outcome + (note ? ' · ' + note : '') }); }} />
          <DSButton title="Huỷ" variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => setMode(null)} />
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (mode === 'postpone') {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
        <SignalRow label="Hạn mới" value={<InlineDate placeholder="Chọn hạn mới" value={due} onChange={setDue} />} />
        <SignalRow label="Lý do" value={<EditableValue kind="text" initial={note} placeholder="Vì sao dời hạn" onCommit={setNote} />} />
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
          <DSButton title="Dời hạn" accent="blue" size="small" disabled={!due || !note.trim()} onClick={() => { setMode(null); setState({ kind: 'postponed', tag: 'Đã dời hạn', color: 'yellow', text: due + ' · ' + note }); }} />
          <DSButton title="Huỷ" variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => setMode(null)} />
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (mode === 'cancel') {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
        <SignalRow label="Lý do huỷ" value={<InlineSelect value={reason} onChange={setReason} options={[{ value: 'Không còn cần', color: 'gray' }, { value: 'Trùng việc khác', color: 'gray' }, { value: 'Lý do khác', color: 'gray' }]} />} />
        {reason === 'Lý do khác' ? <SignalRow label="Ghi rõ" value={<EditableValue kind="text" initial={note} placeholder="Nhập lý do" onCommit={setNote} />} /> : null}
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
          <DSButton title="Huỷ việc" accent="blue" size="small" disabled={reason === 'Lý do khác' && !note.trim()} onClick={() => { setMode(null); setState({ kind: 'cancelled', tag: 'Đã huỷ', color: 'gray', text: reason === 'Lý do khác' ? note : reason }); }} />
          <DSButton title="Quay lại" variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => setMode(null)} />
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
      <DSButton title="Đánh dấu xong" accent="blue" size="small" Icon="check" onClick={() => setMode('done')} />
      <DSButton title="Dời hạn" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="calendar-event" onClick={() => setMode('postpone')} />
      <DSButton title="Huỷ việc" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="circle-off" onClick={() => setMode('cancel')} />
    </span>
  );
}

function C360RowPanel({ detail, record, onClose, onAction }) {
  const group = C360_ROWS[detail.kind];
  const d = group && group.items[detail.id];
  if (!d) return null;
  const name = record ? record.name : '';
  const owner = (record && record.owner) || '';
  const resolve = (v) => v === 'record' ? <Chip label={name} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" />
    : v === 'owner' ? <Chip label={owner} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" /> : v;
  return (
    <div style={{ width: 400, minWidth: 400, flexShrink: 0, height: '100%', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', borderLeft: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 48, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2) 0 var(--t-spacing-3)', boxSizing: 'border-box', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <Icon name={group.icon} size={16} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" />
        <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{d.title}</span>
        <span style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}><Tag text={d.status} color={d.statusColor} preventShrink /></span>
        <DSIconButton Icon="x" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Đóng" onClick={onClose} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', padding: '0 0 var(--t-spacing-6)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
        <PanelSectionList sections={[].concat(
          d.summary ? [{ title: d.summaryLabel, content: <PanelProse>{d.summary}</PanelProse> }] : [],
          d.groups.map(([title, rows]) => ({ title, content: rows.map(([label, value], ri) => <SignalRow key={ri} label={label} value={resolve(value)} />) })),
          detail.kind === 'task' ? [{ title: 'Xử lý việc', content: <TaskLifecycle onAction={onAction} /> }] : [],
          d.timeline && d.timeline.length ? [{ title: d.timelineTitle || 'Dòng thời gian', meta: d.timeline.length + ' mốc', content: <PanelTimeline rows={d.timeline} /> }] : []
        )} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 40, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1) var(--t-spacing-2)', borderTop: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        {(d.actions || []).map((a, i) => (
          <DSButton key={a} title={ROW_ACTION_LABEL[a]} accent={i === 0 ? 'blue' : undefined} variant={i === 0 ? undefined : 'secondary'} size="small" onClick={() => onAction && onAction(a)} />
        ))}
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        <DSButton title="Đóng" variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={onClose} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Customer 360 full page (panel → expand). Layout per customer_360_layout.md §3-§5
// and wireframe C1: left panel (L1-L6) + tabbed right area with the O1-O10 blocks.
function BlockState({ state, note, onRetry }) {
  if (state === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1) 0' }}>
        {[88, 72, 60].map((w, i) => (
          <span key={i} style={{ height: 12, width: w + '%', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-xs)', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' }} />
        ))}
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Đang tải…</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const cfg = state === 'error'
    ? { icon: 'alert-triangle', color: 'var(--t-tag-text-red)', text: note || 'Không tải được dữ liệu. Số liệu hiển thị có thể không đầy đủ.' }
    : state === 'denied'
      ? { icon: 'lock', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', text: note || 'Bạn không có quyền xem phần này.' }
      : { icon: 'circle-dashed', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', text: note || 'Chưa có dữ liệu.' };
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-3) 0', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
      <Icon name={cfg.icon} size={14} color={cfg.color} style={{ flexShrink: 0, marginTop: 3 }} />
      <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>{cfg.text}</span>
      {state === 'error' && onRetry ? <LightButton title="Thử lại" Icon="refresh" accent="tertiary" onClick={onRetry} /> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function C360Block({ title, tool, meta, right, span = 8, cols, children, highlight, dim, hidden, state, stateNote, onRetry }) {
  const basis = span >= 8 ? '100%' : span >= 5 ? '460px' : '300px';
  const [bErr, bLoad, bRetry] = useRetry(DEMO_BLOCK_STATE === 'error');
  const demoSt = DEMO_BLOCK_STATE === 'error' ? (bLoad ? 'loading' : bErr ? 'error' : null) : DEMO_BLOCK_STATE;
  if (demoSt) {
    state = demoSt;
    stateNote = DEMO_STATE_NOTE[demoSt];
    right = null;
    title = title || 'Khối dữ liệu';
    if (demoSt === 'error') onRetry = bRetry;
  }
  return (
    <div style={{ flex: cols ? cols + ' 1 ' + (cols * 56) + 'px' : '1 1 ' + basis, minWidth: 0, opacity: dim ? 0.55 : 1, display: hidden ? 'none' : 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', boxSizing: 'border-box', border: '1px solid ' + (highlight ? 'var(--t-accent-tertiary)' : 'var(--t-border-color-medium)'), borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', background: highlight ? 'var(--t-accent-quaternary)' : 'var(--t-background-primary)' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: highlight ? 'var(--t-font-weight-semi-bold)' : 'var(--t-font-weight-medium)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }}>{title}</span>
        {tool ? <span style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}><Tag text={tool} color="purple" preventShrink style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)' }} /></span> : null}
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        {meta ? <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{meta}</span> : null}
        {right}
      </div>
      {state ? <BlockState state={state} note={stateNote} onRetry={onRetry} /> : children}
    </div>
  );
}

function C360TableRow({ row: r, head, last }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = React.useState(false);
  const bg = r.selected ? 'var(--t-accent-quaternary)' : hover ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent';
  return (
    <div onClick={r.onClick} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
      style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', minHeight: 32, padding: '4px var(--t-spacing-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', boxSizing: 'border-box', alignItems: 'center', borderBottom: last ? 'none' : '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', background: bg, cursor: 'pointer', transition: 'background 0.1s ease' }}>
      {r.cells.map((c, ci) => {
        const h = (head && head[ci]) || {};
        return <span key={ci} style={{ flex: (h.w || 1) + ' 1 0', minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4, whiteSpace: 'normal', overflowWrap: 'anywhere', lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{c}</span>;
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

function C360Table({ head, rows, hideHead }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      {head && !hideHead ? (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 24, alignItems: 'center', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
          {head.map((h, i) => <span key={i} style={{ flex: (h.w || 1) + ' 1 0', minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{h.label}</span>)}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {rows.map((r, ri) => <C360TableRow key={ri} row={r} head={head} last={ri === rows.length - 1} />)}
    </div>
  );
}

function IdentityAccounts({ record }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const r = resolveRecord(record);
  const n = parseInt(String((r && r.id) || '1').replace(/\D/g, ''), 10) || 1;
  const tail = String(80 + n).slice(-2);
  const fp = r && (r.id === 'c15' || r.id === 'c16');
  const accts = fp ? [['Cash', '058C3106' + tail]] : [['Cash', '058C3106' + tail], ['Margin', '058M3106' + tail], ['Trái phiếu', '058B3106' + tail]];
  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <KVRow label="Tài khoản" Icon="credit-card" value={<span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, minWidth: 0 }}><MaskedValue kind="account" value={accts[0][1]}><ValuePill text={accts[0][1]} /></MaskedValue>{accts.length > 1 ? <LightButton title={'+' + (accts.length - 1) + ' tài khoản'} accent="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)} /> : null}</span>} />
      {open ? (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-light)' }}>
          {accts.map(([t, v]) => <span key={t} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}><span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>{t}</span><MaskedValue kind="account" value={v}><ValuePill text={v} /></MaskedValue></span>)}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}
// Stepper 6 bước tuyến tính; At Risk / Dormant / Lost là nhánh → badge bên phải (customer_360_layout §O4).
function LifecycleStepper({ stage, onBadge }) {
  const STEPS = ['Prospect', 'Opening', 'Opened', 'Funded', 'Activated', 'Active Investor'];
  const branch = { 'At Risk': ['At Risk · case P5 mở', 'red'], Dormant: ['Dormant · từ 02/08', 'gray'], Lost: ['Lost · 12/08', 'red'] }[stage];
  const idx = branch ? STEPS.length - 1 : Math.max(0, STEPS.indexOf(stage));
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', paddingBottom: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
        {STEPS.map((st, i) => (
          <div key={st} title={st === 'Activated' ? 'Đã có first trade ✓ · NAV ≥ 20 tr ✓ · giao dịch trong 30 ngày ✓' : undefined} style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
            <span style={{ height: 4, borderRadius: 2, background: i < idx ? 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' : i === idx ? 'var(--t-color-blue)' : 'var(--t-background-transparent-medium)' }} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: i === idx ? 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-light)', fontWeight: i === idx ? 500 : 400, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{st}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {branch ? <span onClick={stage === 'At Risk' ? onBadge : undefined} style={{ flexShrink: 0, cursor: stage === 'At Risk' ? 'pointer' : 'default' }}><Tag text={branch[0]} color={branch[1]} preventShrink /></span> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
// Chuỗi tự động áp cho khách (Q5): trạng thái Đang chạy / Chờ ký / Đã thu hồi / Hết hạn.
function chainOf(record) {
  const r = resolveRecord(record);
  const id = r && r.id;
  const base = id === 'c15' ? 'wait' : id === 'c16' ? 'run' : null;
  if (!base) return null;
  const st = id === 'c16' && MVP.chain ? MVP.chain : base;
  const owner = (r && r.owner) || '';
  return {
    name: id === 'c16' ? 'Nhắc giao dịch đầu tiên v1' : 'Nhắc nạp tiền v2', st, chainId: chForCust(id),
    label: { run: 'Đang chạy', wait: 'Chờ ký', revoked: 'Đã thu hồi', expired: 'Hết hạn' }[st],
    color: { run: 'green', wait: 'yellow', revoked: 'gray', expired: 'red' }[st],
    sub: { run: 'Ký bởi ' + owner + ' · hết hạn 27/12', wait: 'Phiên bản mới chưa ký · tin chưa gửi khách', revoked: 'Thu hồi 18/09 · tin chờ gửi đã huỷ', expired: 'Hết hạn 20/09 · tin kế tiếp không gửi' }[st],
  };
}

function C360Kpi({ label, value, sub, onClick }) {
  return (
    <div onClick={onClick} style={{ cursor: onClick ? 'pointer' : 'default', flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, padding: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', background: 'var(--t-background-secondary)' }}>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{label}</span>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-lg)', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }}>{value}</span>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{sub}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function C360LeftSection({ title, children, last, defaultOpen = true, meta }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen);
  const [hover, setHover] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', borderBottom: last ? 'none' : '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
      {title ? (
        <div onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
          style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', marginBottom: open ? 'var(--t-spacing-1)' : 0, cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }}>
          <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 'var(--t-font-weight-medium)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }}>{title}</span>
          {meta ? <span style={{ flexShrink: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{meta}</span> : null}
          <Icon name={open ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'} size={16} color={hover ? 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-light)'} />
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {title && !open ? null : children}
    </div>
  );
}

// L2–L6 của cột trái Customer 360, dùng chung cho cả side panel và trang chi tiết
// (doc wire/c360.txt · C1): hành vi thực tế, quick actions + rule SMS, nhịp liên hệ,
// key facts, counts + data health. Panel và detail render CÙNG list này nên không lệch.
function CustomerInfoSections({ record, hideQuickActions, hideCounts, onNavigate, collapsed, onAction }) {
  const ch = isFull() ? chainOf(record) : null;
  const qa = (k) => onAction ? () => onAction(k) : undefined;
  const fp = recordFlags(record).fundingPending;
  const demo = !!record && record.id !== 'c1' && !fp;
  const mc = mvpCust(record);
  const noData = demo && !mc.nav;
  const lightTxt = (t) => <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>{t}</span>;
  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      {hideQuickActions ? null : <C360LeftSection title="Hành động nhanh">
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>
          <DSButton title="Gọi" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="phone" disabled={!onAction} onClick={qa('call')} />
          <DSButton title="Zalo" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="message-circle" disabled={!onAction} onClick={qa('message')} />
          <DSButton title="Email" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="mail" disabled={!onAction} onClick={qa('email')} />
          <DSButton title="SMS" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="message" disabled />
          <DSButton title="Tạo việc" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="checkbox" disabled={!onAction} onClick={qa('task')} />
          <DSButton title="Ghi chú" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="notes" disabled={!onAction} onClick={qa('note')} />
          <DSIconButton Icon="dots-vertical" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="More" />
        </div>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>SMS tắt: khách từ chối từ 02/09. Tin bạn gửi tay được gửi ngay cả ngoài giờ liên hệ, vẫn ghi contact ledger.</span>
      </C360LeftSection>}
      <C360LeftSection title="Liên hệ gần đây" defaultOpen={!collapsed}>
        <KVRow label="Tự động" Icon="repeat" value={<HugValue>{fp ? 'Chuỗi nhắc nạp tiền · 2/3' : !record || record.id === 'c1' ? '1/2 tuần · 3/5 tháng' : mvpCust(record).last[1] === 'none' ? <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Chưa có</span> : '0/2 tuần · 1/5 tháng'}</HugValue>} />
        <KVRow label="Broker" Icon="headset" value={<HugValue>{fp ? '1 lần / 9 ngày' : !record || record.id === 'c1' ? '2 lần / 30 ngày' : mvpCust(record).last[1] === 'none' ? <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Chưa có</span> : (mvpCust(record).last[2] ? '0 lần / 30 ngày' : '1 lần / 30 ngày')}</HugValue>} />
        <KVRow label="Có ý nghĩa gần nhất" Icon="message-circle-check" value={<HugValue>{mvpCust(record).meaningful || 'Chưa có'}</HugValue>} />
        <KVRow label="Nhịp giao dịch" Icon="calendar-repeat" value={<HugValue>{mvpCust(record).interval || '—'}</HugValue>} />
{/* dẫn xuất từ lịch sử tương tác */}
        <KVRow label="Lần cuối" Icon="history" value={mvpLastCell(record)} />
        <KVRow label="Tự động kế tiếp" Icon="calendar-time" value={<EditableValue kind="date" initial={demo ? '' : '16 Sep, 2026 10:00'} placeholder="Chưa lên lịch" /*lịch gửi tự động: RM đổi/hoãn được*/ />} />
        <KVRow label="Chuỗi tự động" Icon="route" value={ch ? <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, flexWrap: 'wrap', minWidth: 0 }}><span>{ch.name}</span><Tag text={ch.label} color={ch.color} preventShrink /></span> : lightTxt('Không có chuỗi đang áp')} />
        {ch ? <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>{ch.sub}</span>
          <span style={{ display: 'flex' }}><LightButton title="Mở ở Approvals" Icon="arrow-up-right" accent="tertiary" onClick={() => window.__goAp(ch.st === 'wait' ? 'ap-sign' : 'ap-signed', ch.chainId)} /></span>
        </div> : null}
      </C360LeftSection>
      <C360LeftSection title="Key facts" defaultOpen={!collapsed}>
        <KVRow label="Điện thoại" Icon="phone" value={<MaskedValue kind="phone" value={record ? record.phone : '+84 901 234 567'}><EditableValue kind="pill" format="phone" initial={record ? record.phone : '+84 901 234 567'} placeholder="Nhập số điện thoại" /></MaskedValue>} />
        <KVRow label="Email" Icon="mail" value={<MaskedValue kind="email" value={record ? record.email : 'anh.nguyen@example.com'}><EditableValue kind="pill" initial={record ? record.email : 'anh.nguyen@example.com'} placeholder="Nhập email" /></MaskedValue>} />
        <KVRow label="Kênh ưu tiên" Icon="message-circle" value={<EditableValue kind="select" initial="Zalo" options={[{ value: 'Zalo', color: 'purple' }, { value: 'Email', color: 'blue' }, { value: 'Gọi', color: 'green' }]} />} />
        {/* dữ liệu hệ thống / dẫn xuất — chỉ hover, không sửa */}
        <KVRow label="Mở tài khoản" Icon="calendar" value={<HugValue>{fp ? '05/09/2026' : '12/03/2024'}</HugValue>} />
        <KVRow label="Giao dịch gần nhất" Icon="arrows-exchange" value={<HugValue>{fp || noData ? lightTxt('Chưa có giao dịch') : demo ? mc.lastTrade : '06/09/2026'}</HugValue>} />
        <KVRow label="Mục tiêu" Icon="target" value={<EditableValue kind="select" initial={fp || noData ? 'Chưa khai báo' : 'Tăng trưởng 5+ năm'} options={[{ value: 'Chưa khai báo', color: 'gray' }, { value: 'Tăng trưởng 5+ năm', color: 'green' }, { value: 'Tăng trưởng 1–3 năm', color: 'turquoise' }, { value: 'Bảo toàn vốn', color: 'blue' }, { value: 'Thu nhập đều', color: 'yellow' }]} />} />
      </C360LeftSection>
      {hideCounts ? null : <C360LeftSection last>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>
          <DSButton title={'Attention · ' + mvpOpen(record ? record.id : 'c1').length} variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => onNavigate && onNavigate('attention')} />
          <DSButton title={demo ? 'Case mở · ' + mvpCaseCount(record) : fp ? 'Case mở · 1' : 'Case mở · 3'} variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => onNavigate && onNavigate('cases')} />
          <DSButton title={demo ? 'Việc cần làm · ' + ((mc.openTasks || 0) + ((MVP.tasks && MVP.tasks[record.id]) || []).length) : fp ? 'Việc cần làm · 1' : 'Việc cần làm · 2'} variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => onNavigate && onNavigate('tasks')} />
          <DSButton title="Hội thoại" variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => onNavigate && onNavigate('inter')} />
          <DSButton title={demo ? 'Tài liệu' : fp ? 'Tài liệu · 2' : 'Tài liệu · 5'} variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => onNavigate && onNavigate('kyc')} />
        </div>
        {demo && mc.health === 'ok' ? null : <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-tag-text-yellow)' }}>
          <Icon name="alert-triangle" size={14} />
          <span>{fp ? 'Chưa có dữ liệu giao dịch · 3 trường hồ sơ trống' : demo ? (mc.health === 'stale' ? '1 nguồn quá hạn · tương tác' : mc.health === 'missing' ? 'Thiếu giá thị trường · danh mục' : 'Chưa có dữ liệu giao dịch') : '1 nguồn quá hạn · 2 thiếu dữ liệu'}</span>
        </div>}
      </C360LeftSection>}
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

// Quick actions (L2) chuyển vào dropdown "Hành động" ở header; rule SMS hiện dạng
// tooltip khi hover mục SMS thay vì một đoạn note chiếm chỗ trong cột trái.
function ActionsMenu({ onPick, compact, disabled, disabledNote, withAssistant }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [tip, setTip] = React.useState(null);
  const [note, setNote] = React.useState(false);
  const ref = useDismiss(open, React.useCallback(() => { setOpen(false); setTip(null); }, []));
  const btnRef = React.useRef(null);
  const [at, setAt] = React.useState(null);
  const toggle = () => {
    if (open) { setOpen(false); return; }
    const r = btnRef.current && btnRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r) setAt({ top: r.bottom + 4, right: window.innerWidth - r.right });
    setOpen(true);
  };
  if (disabled) {
    return (
      <span style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex' }} onMouseEnter={() => setNote(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setNote(false)}>
        {compact
          ? <DSIconButton Icon="bolt" variant="secondary" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Hành động" disabled />
          : <DSButton title="Hành động" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="chevron-down" disabled />}
        {note && disabledNote ? (
          <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 'calc(100% + 6px)', right: 0, zIndex: 60, width: 232, padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', background: 'rgba(48,48,48,.92)', color: '#fff', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', lineHeight: 1.4, pointerEvents: 'none' }}>{disabledNote}</span>
        ) : null}
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span ref={ref} style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex' }}>
      <span ref={btnRef} style={{ display: 'inline-flex' }}>
        {compact
          ? <DSIconButton Icon="bolt" variant="secondary" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Hành động" onClick={toggle} />
          : <DSButton title="Hành động" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="chevron-down" onClick={toggle} />}
      </span>
      {open ? (
          <React.Fragment>
            <span onClick={() => setOpen(false)} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 40 }} />
            <DS.DropdownMenu width={240} style={{ position: 'fixed', top: at ? at.top : 52, right: at ? at.right : 12, zIndex: 41, maxWidth: 'none' }}>
              {withAssistant ? <DS.MenuItem text="Hỏi Trợ lý" LeftIcon="sparkles" onClick={() => { setOpen(false); onPick && onPick('ai'); }} /> : null}
              {withAssistant ? <DS.MenuItemSeparator /> : null}
              <DS.MenuItem text="Gọi" LeftIcon="phone" onClick={() => { setOpen(false); onPick && onPick('call'); }} />
              <DS.MenuItem text="Zalo (ưu tiên)" LeftIcon="message-circle" onClick={() => { setOpen(false); onPick && onPick('message'); }} />
              <DS.MenuItem text="Email" LeftIcon="mail" onClick={() => { setOpen(false); onPick && onPick('email'); }} />
              <div onMouseEnter={(e) => { const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(); setTip({ top: r.top + r.height / 2, left: r.left }); }} onMouseLeave={() => setTip(null)}>
                <DS.MenuItem text="SMS" LeftIcon="message" iconColor="var(--t-font-color-extra-light)" disabled />
              </div>
              <DS.MenuItemSeparator />
              <DS.MenuItem text="Tạo việc" LeftIcon="checkbox" onClick={() => { setOpen(false); onPick && onPick('task'); }} />
              <DS.MenuItem text="Tạo case" LeftIcon="briefcase" onClick={() => { setOpen(false); onPick && onPick('case'); }} />
              <DS.MenuItem text="Ghi chú" LeftIcon="notes" onClick={() => { setOpen(false); onPick && onPick('note'); }} />
              <DS.MenuItemSeparator />
              <DS.MenuItem text="Mở hội thoại trong Inbox" LeftIcon="arrow-up-right" onClick={() => { setOpen(false); onPick && onPick('inbox'); }} />
            </DS.DropdownMenu>
          {tip ? (
            <span style={{ position: 'fixed', top: tip.top, left: tip.left - 12, transform: 'translate(-100%, -50%)', zIndex: 60, width: 240, padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', background: 'rgba(48,48,48,.92)', color: '#fff', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', lineHeight: 1.4, pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
              Khách từ chối SMS từ 02/09. Tin bạn gửi tay được gửi ngay cả ngoài giờ liên hệ, vẫn ghi contact ledger.
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </React.Fragment>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
}

        <C360Block span={11} title="Lịch sử liên hệ" meta="30 ngày: Zalo 4 · Gọi 2 · Email 1 · 1 bị chặn">
          <C360Table head={[{ label: 'Khi', w: 0.7 }, { label: 'Kênh', w: 0.9 }, { label: 'Người gửi', w: 1.1 }, { label: 'Mẫu tin', w: 1.2 }, { label: 'Chữ ký / người duyệt', w: 1.3 }, { label: 'Trạng thái', w: 1 }, { label: 'Tóm tắt', w: 1.8 }]}
            rows={[
              { ...rp('interaction', 'i1'), cells: ['06/09', <Tag text="Zalo ↑" color="purple" preventShrink />, 'Broker', <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>—</span>, (record && record.owner || '') + ' · gửi tay', <Tag text="Đã trả lời" color="green" preventShrink />, 'Hỏi kế hoạch với tiền chờ'] },
              { ...rp('interaction', 'blocked'), cells: ['04/09', <Tag text="SMS ↑" color="gray" preventShrink />, 'Tự động', 'Nhắc đáo hạn · v2', (record && record.owner || '') + ' · chuỗi Nhắc đáo hạn v2', <Tag text="Bị chặn" color="red" preventShrink />, 'Khách đã từ chối SMS'] },
              ...((VIEWER_ROLE === 'ops' || VIEWER_ROLE === 'compliance') ? [{ cells: ['03/09', <Tag text="Zalo ↑" color="purple" preventShrink />, 'Tự động', 'Nhắc nhịp chăm sóc · v1', <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>—</span>, <Tag text="Thử nghiệm" color="gray" preventShrink />, 'Đáng lẽ đã gửi · automation P3 đang Log-only'] }] : []),

              { ...rp('interaction', 'i3'), cells: ['01/09', <Tag text="Email ↑" color="blue" preventShrink />, 'Tự động', 'Sao kê tháng · v1', (record && record.owner || '') + ' · chuỗi Sao kê tháng v1', <Tag text="Đã gửi" color="gray" preventShrink />, 'Sao kê tháng 8 — không phản hồi'] },

// Banner cấp record (layout §3 · P30.banner): ưu tiên lệnh dừng gửi → mất quyền →
// P5/tạm giữ → dữ liệu cũ → thử nghiệm → backfill; mở tối đa hai, còn lại gộp một dòng.
const BANNER_TONE = {
  block: ['alert-triangle', 'var(--t-tag-text-red)', 'var(--t-tag-background-red)'],
  warn: ['alert-triangle', 'var(--t-tag-text-yellow)', 'var(--t-tag-background-yellow)'],
  info: ['info-circle', 'var(--t-tag-text-blue)', 'var(--t-tag-background-blue)'],
};
function RecordBanners({ items, pad }) {
  const [more, setMore] = React.useState(false);
  if (!items || !items.length) return null;
  const shown = more ? items : items.slice(0, 2);
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', padding: pad || 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-3) 0' }}>
      {shown.map((b, i) => {
        const tone = BANNER_TONE[b.tone] || BANNER_TONE.info;
        return (
          <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', minHeight: 28, padding: '2px var(--t-spacing-2)', boxSizing: 'border-box', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: tone[2], fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }}>
            <Icon name={tone[0]} size={14} color={tone[1]} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
            <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>{b.text}</span>
            {b.action ? <span style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}><LightButton title={b.action} accent="tertiary" onClick={b.onAction} /></span> : null}
          </div>
        );
      })}
      {items.length > 2 ? <span style={{ display: 'flex' }}><LightButton title={more ? 'Thu gọn cảnh báo' : 'Còn ' + (items.length - 2) + ' cảnh báo'} Icon={more ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'} accent="tertiary" onClick={() => setMore((m) => !m)} /></span> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

                    rows={DH.map((d) => ({ active: d[3] === 'stale', onClick: d[4] ? () => openRow('datahealth', d[4]) : undefined, selected: d[4] ? isRow('datahealth', d[4]) : false, cells: [d[0], d[1], d[2], <Tag text={d[3] === 'stale' ? 'Quá hạn' : 'Đạt'} color={d[3] === 'stale' ? 'yellow' : 'green'} preventShrink />] }))} />
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', fontWeight: 'var(--t-font-weight-medium)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', marginTop: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>Dữ liệu còn thiếu</span>
                  <KVRow label="Hồ sơ" Icon="file-alert" value="Thiếu thời hạn đầu tư" />
                </React.Fragment>
              </C360Block>); })()}
            </div>}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        </div>
        {signal ? <SignalDetailPanel id={signal.id} record={record} onClose={() => setSignal(null)} onAction={openAction} onOpenRow={openRow} onInvalid={() => { setSignal(null); setFeedback('invalid'); }} /> : null}
        {row && row.kind === 'case' && CASES.some((k) => k.id === caseRef(row.id)) ? <CasePanel key={'cp' + row.id} caseId={caseRef(row.id)} onClose={() => setRow(null)} onOpenCust={() => {}}
          onOpenCase={(id) => setRow({ kind: 'case', id, tab: row.tab, prev: row.id, fromAtt: row.fromAtt })}
          onBack={row.prev ? () => setRow({ kind: 'case', id: row.prev, tab: row.tab, fromAtt: row.fromAtt }) : row.fromAtt ? () => { const a = row.fromAtt; setRow(null); setMvpAtt(a); } : undefined} />
          : row ? <C360RowPanel detail={row} record={record} onClose={() => setRow(null)} onAction={openAction} /> : null}
        {closeDialog ? <CaseOutcomeDialog k={CASES.find((x) => x.id === 'cs1')} to={CASE_PIPES.P4.stages.findIndex((s) => s[0] === 'No Longer Relevant')} reason="INVALID_SIGNAL"
          onClose={() => setCloseDialog(false)}
          onDone={(r) => { setCloseProposal(false); setNba(null); setStagePending(r); }} /> : null}
        {reassign ? <ReassignDialog record={record} onClose={() => setReassign(false)} /> : null}
        {feedback ? <FeedbackDialog kind={feedback} onClose={() => setFeedback(null)}
          onDone={(r) => { setFeedback(null); setNba(r); setNbaHidden(false); if (r.kind === 'invalid') setCloseProposal(true); }} /> : null}
        {reqPanel ? (isFull() && reqPanel.ref && apFind(reqPanel.ref) ? <ApRequestPanel id={reqPanel.ref} inline onClose={() => setReqPanel(null)} /> : <ApprovalRequestPanel req={reqPanel} record={record} onClose={() => setReqPanel(null)} />) : null}
        {attDlg}
        {attDlgPanel}
        {mvpAtt && !attDlgPanel ? <MvpAttentionPanel record={record} attId={mvpAtt} caughtUp={attDone} callPrompt={callPrompt} onCallPrompt={setCallPrompt}
          onClose={() => { setMvpAtt(null); setAttDone(false); setCallPrompt(false); }} onSelect={openAtt} openDlg={openAttDlg} onFull={openAction} onOpenCase={(id) => { const a = mvpAtt; setMvpAtt(null); setAction(null); setSignal(null); setRow({ kind: 'case', id, tab, fromAtt: a }); }} /> : null}
        {action ? <PanelActionPage kind={action} record={record} onClose={() => setAction(null)} hideBack readOnly={flags.noAccess} onOpenRequest={(r) => { setAction(null); setReqPanel(r); }} onSubmitted={(r) => { if (r.state === 'pending') setApproval(r); }} /> : null}
        </div>
      </PagePanel>
    </PageBody>
  );
}

const CHIP_SEED = { 'Chi nhánh Đà Nẵng': 'Đà Nẵng', 'Chi nhánh HCM': 'HCM', 'Chi nhánh Hà Nội': 'Hà Nội', 'Chi nhánh Cần Thơ': 'Cần Thơ', 'Phòng ban A': 'A', 'Phòng ban B': 'B', 'Phòng ban C': 'C', 'Phòng ban D': 'D' };

// Chip whose avatar letter comes from the distinguishing token, not the whole label.
function SeedChip({ label, variant = 'highlighted' }) {
  return <Chip label={label} variant={variant} leftComponent={<Avatar placeholder={CHIP_SEED[label] || label} type="rounded" size="md" />} />;
}

function contactCell(r, c) {
  if (c.id.indexOf('mvp_') === 0) return mvpCell(r, c);
  if (c.id === 'name') return <Chip label={r.name} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" />;
  if (c.id === 'email' || c.id === 'phone' || c.id === 'ref') return <ValuePill text={r[c.id]} />;
  if (c.id === 'subsidiary' || c.id === 'department') return <SeedChip label={r[c.id]} />;
  if (c.id === 'owner') return r.owner ? <Chip label={r.owner} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" /> : <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Chưa có broker</span>;
  if (c.id === 'lifecycle') return <Tag text={lc9(r)} color={LC9_COLOR[lc9(r)] || 'gray'} />;
  return r[c.id];
}

// twenty-front ui/layout/dropdown (OverlayContainer + DropdownContent +
// DropdownMenuItemsContainer + DropdownMenuHeader) và twenty-ui MenuItem, dựng lại
// theo đúng số đo gốc: nền mờ trong suốt, item content-box 32px, group padding 4px.
function DdSurface({ width, children }) {
  return <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', width, boxSizing: 'border-box', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-primary)', backdropFilter: 'var(--t-blur-medium)', WebkitBackdropFilter: 'var(--t-blur-medium)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)', overflow: 'hidden', fontFamily: 'var(--t-font-family)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 400 }}>{children}</div>;
}
function DdScroll({ children }) {
  return <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', maxHeight: 420, overflowY: 'auto', overflowX: 'hidden' }}>{children}</div>;
}
function DdGroup({ children }) {
  return <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, alignItems: 'flex-start', boxSizing: 'border-box', flexShrink: 0, width: '100%', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>{children}</div>;
}
function DdItem({ text, Icon: name, RightIcon, right, rightText, hasSubMenu, selected, tickOnly, disabled, onClick }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = React.useState(false);
  const color = disabled ? 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)';
  return <div onClick={disabled ? undefined : onClick} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
    style={{ boxSizing: 'content-box', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', flexShrink: 0,
      height: 'calc(32px - 2 * var(--t-spacing-2))', width: 'calc(100% - 2 * var(--t-spacing-1))', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-1)',
      borderRadius: 'calc(var(--t-border-radius-md) - var(--t-spacing-1))', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color,
      background: (hover && !disabled) || (selected && !tickOnly) ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', transition: 'background 0.1s ease', cursor: disabled ? 'default' : 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' }}>
    <span style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', minWidth: 0, width: '100%' }}>
      {name ? <Icon name={name} size={16} color="currentColor" /> : null}
      <span style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 400, overflow: 'hidden', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>{text}</span>
      {rightText ? <span style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', paddingLeft: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{rightText}</span> : null}
    </span>
    <span style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
      {right}
      {RightIcon ? <Icon name={RightIcon} size={16} color="currentColor" /> : null}
      {selected ? <Icon name="check" size={16} color="currentColor" /> : null}
      {hasSubMenu ? <Icon name="chevron-right" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-light)" /> : null}
    </span>
  </div>;
}
function DdLabel({ label }) {
  return <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flexShrink: 0, boxSizing: 'border-box', minHeight: 20, width: '100%', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-lighter)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-xxs)', userSelect: 'none' }}>{label}</div>;
}
function DdSep() {
  return <div style={{ minHeight: 1, flexShrink: 0, width: '100%', background: 'var(--t-border-color-light)' }} />;
}
function DdSearch({ value, onChange, bordered, placeholder }) {
  return <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flexShrink: 0, boxSizing: 'content-box', minHeight: bordered ? 19 : 20, padding: bordered ? 'var(--t-spacing-2)' : 'var(--t-spacing-2) 0', borderBottom: bordered ? '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' : 'none' }}>
    <input autoFocus value={value} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} placeholder={placeholder || 'Search fields'} style={{ border: 'none', outline: 'none', background: 'transparent', width: '100%', padding: bordered ? 0 : '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', fontFamily: 'inherit', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }} />
  </div>;
}
function DdHeader({ icon, label, onClick }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = React.useState(false);
  return <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flexShrink: 0, boxSizing: 'content-box', height: 24, padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500, userSelect: 'none' }}>
    <span onClick={onClick} onMouseEnter={() => setHover(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
      style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', width: 24, height: 24, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', background: hover ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
      <Icon name={icon} size={16} color="currentColor" />
    </span>
    <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{label}</span>
  </div>;
}
function DdEye({ name }) {
  return <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', cursor: 'pointer' }}><Icon name={name} size={16} color="currentColor" /></span>;
}

const TEXT_OPS = [['contains', 'Chứa'], ['notContains', 'Không chứa'], ['empty', 'Là trống'], ['notEmpty', 'Không trống']];
// Áp toán tử lọc chữ lên một giá trị (dùng chung cho các màn có trường text).
function rmTextMatch(val, q, op, norm) {
  const n = norm || ((x) => String(x || '').trim().toLowerCase());
  const v = n(val);
  if (op === 'empty') return !v;
  if (op === 'notEmpty') return !!v;
  if (!q) return true;
  const hit = v.indexOf(n(q)) >= 0;
  return op === 'notContains' ? !hit : hit;
}
// Lọc theo từng cột cho các bảng Full dùng dữ liệu tĩnh: cột chữ → ô nhập + toán tử, cột khác → chọn giá trị có sẵn.
function useColFilter(columns, rows, textIds, labelOf) {
  const [flt, setFlt] = React.useState({});
  const isText = (c) => c.type === 'text' || (textIds || []).indexOf(c.id) >= 0;
  const fields = columns.map((c) => isText(c)
    ? { id: c.id, col: c.id, label: c.label, Icon: c.Icon || 'typography', text: true }
    : { id: c.id, col: c.id, label: c.label, Icon: c.Icon || 'list', options: Array.from(new Set(rows.map((r) => r[c.id]).filter((v) => v != null && v !== ''))).map((v) => [String(v), labelOf ? labelOf(c.id, v) : String(v)]) });
  const out = rows.filter((r) => fields.every((f) => f.text
    ? (!(flt[f.id] || flt[f.id + '__op']) || rmTextMatch(r[f.id], flt[f.id], flt[f.id + '__op'] || 'contains'))
    : (!flt[f.id] || String(r[f.id]) === flt[f.id])));
  const spec = { fields, value: flt, onChange: (id, v) => setFlt((f) => Object.assign({}, f, { [id]: v })), onReset: () => setFlt({}) };
  return [out, spec];
}
function RmViewBar({ viewName, viewIcon, count, fields, hiddenFields = [], onViewChange, views, filterSpec, sortSpec, fieldSpec, noAddView, actions: barActions, pre, leftExtra }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(null);
  const [fPage, setFPage] = React.useState(null);
  const [fldQ, setFldQ] = React.useState('');
  const [optQ, setOptQ] = React.useState('');
  const [opOpen, setOpOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [view, setView0] = React.useState(viewName);
  React.useEffect(() => { setView0(viewName); }, [viewName]);
  const setView = (n) => { setView0(n); onViewChange && onViewChange(n); };
  const VIEWS = views || CUSTOMER_VIEWS;
  const [filterQ, setFilterQ] = React.useState('');
  const [sortQ, setSortQ] = React.useState('');
  const [fieldQ, setFieldQ] = React.useState('');
  const [dir, setDir] = React.useState('Ascending');
  const [dirOpen, setDirOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [optPage, setOptPage] = React.useState('menu');
  const ref = React.useRef(null);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const h = (e) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) setOpen(null); };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', h);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h);
  }, [open]);
  const toggle = (id) => setOpen((o) => {
    const n = o === id ? null : id;
    if (n === 'Options') setOptPage('menu');
    if (n === 'Sort') { setDirOpen(false); setDir('Ascending'); }
    if (n === 'Filter') setFPage(null);
    return n;
  });
  const hit = (q) => (f) => !q || f.label.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase());
  const pop = (children, extra) => <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 40, zIndex: 60, ...extra }}>{children}</div>;
  const sortRight = () => null;
  const fieldItem = (f, onClick, right) => <DdItem key={f.id} text={f.label} Icon={f.Icon || (DS.FIELD_TYPE_ICONS && DS.FIELD_TYPE_ICONS[f.type]) || 'typography'} onClick={onClick} right={right} />;

  const viewsMenu = <DdSurface width={200}>
    <DdGroup>
      {VIEWS.map((v) => <DdItem key={v.id} text={v.name} Icon={v.icon} selected={v.name === view} onClick={() => { setView(v.name); setOpen(null); }} />)}
    </DdGroup>
    {noAddView ? null : <React.Fragment><DdSep />
    <DdGroup><DdItem text="Add view" Icon="plus" onClick={() => setOpen(null)} /></DdGroup></React.Fragment>}
  </DdSurface>;

  const visible = fields.filter(hit(filterQ));
  const hiddenF = hiddenFields.filter(hit(filterQ));
  const filterMenu = <DdSurface width={320}>
    <DdHeader icon="x" label="Filter" onClick={() => setOpen(null)} />
    <DdScroll>
      <DdSearch value={filterQ} onChange={setFilterQ} bordered />
      {visible.length ? <React.Fragment><DdLabel label="Visible fields" /><DdGroup>{visible.map((f) => fieldItem(f, () => setOpen(null)))}</DdGroup></React.Fragment> : null}
      {visible.length && hiddenF.length ? <DdSep /> : null}
      {hiddenF.length ? <React.Fragment><DdLabel label="Hidden fields" /><DdGroup>{hiddenF.map((f) => fieldItem(f, () => setOpen(null)))}</DdGroup></React.Fragment> : null}
      <DdSep />
      <DdGroup>
        <DdItem text="Search records" Icon="search" onClick={() => setOpen(null)} />
        <DdItem text="Advanced filter" Icon="filter" onClick={() => setOpen(null)} />
      </DdGroup>
    </DdScroll>
  </DdSurface>;

  const FS = filterSpec;
  const fsField = FS && fPage ? FS.fields.find((f) => f.id === fPage) : null;
  // Twenty: menu gốc = danh sách trường (ô tìm lọc tên trường) + "Search"; bấm trường → trang con có ô tìm giá trị; "Search" → trang nhập từ khoá tìm bản ghi.
  // Twenty: menu gốc liệt kê từng trường (nhóm Visible / Hidden theo cột bảng); ô trên cùng chỉ tìm tên trường.
  // Bấm trường → trang con: trường chữ hiện ô nhập, trường chọn hiện danh sách giá trị có ô tìm.
  const allF = FS ? (FS.search ? [{ id: '__search', label: FS.search.label || 'Keyword', Icon: FS.search.Icon || 'search', col: FS.search.col, text: true }] : []).concat(FS.fields) : [];
  const hitF = (f) => !fldQ.trim() || f.label.toLowerCase().indexOf(fldQ.trim().toLowerCase()) >= 0;
  const visIds = (fields || []).map((c) => c.id);
  const grouped = visIds.length > 0;
  const visF = allF.filter((f) => hitF(f) && (!grouped || (f.col && visIds.indexOf(f.col) >= 0)));
  const hidF = grouped ? allF.filter((f) => hitF(f) && !(f.col && visIds.indexOf(f.col) >= 0)) : [];
  const fsOpts = fsField && !fsField.text ? fsField.options.filter(([, l]) => !optQ.trim() || String(l).toLowerCase().indexOf(optQ.trim().toLowerCase()) >= 0) : [];
  const closeF = () => { setOpen(null); setFPage(null); setFldQ(''); setOptQ(''); };
  const fItem = (f) => <DdItem key={f.id} text={f.label} Icon={f.Icon} onClick={() => { setFPage(f.id); setOptQ(''); }} />;
  const specMenu = FS ? (fPage === '__search' && FS.search
    ? <DdSurface width={260}>
        <DdHeader icon="chevron-left" label={FS.search.label || 'Keyword'} onClick={() => setFPage(null)} />
        <DdSearch value={FS.search.value} onChange={FS.search.onChange} bordered placeholder={FS.search.placeholder} />
      </DdSurface>
    : fsField && fsField.text
    ? (() => {
        // Twenty text filter: toán tử Chứa / Không chứa / Là trống / Không trống; hai toán tử cuối không cần nhập giá trị.
        const opK = fsField.id + '__op';
        const op = FS.value[opK] || 'contains';
        const noVal = op === 'empty' || op === 'notEmpty';
        return <DdSurface width={260}>
          <DdHeader icon="chevron-left" label={fsField.label} onClick={() => { setFPage(null); setOpOpen(false); }} />
          <div>
            <div onClick={() => setOpOpen((o) => !o)} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', height: 32, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', margin: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }}>
              <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{TEXT_OPS.find(([k]) => k === op)[1]}</span><Icon name={opOpen ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'} size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" />
            </div>
          </div>
          {opOpen ? <React.Fragment><DdSep /><DdGroup>
            {TEXT_OPS.map(([k, l]) => <DdItem key={k} text={l} tickOnly selected={op === k} onClick={() => { FS.onChange(opK, k === 'contains' ? null : k); if (k === 'empty' || k === 'notEmpty') FS.onChange(fsField.id, null); setOpOpen(false); }} />)}
          </DdGroup></React.Fragment> : null}
          {noVal || opOpen ? null : <DdSearch value={FS.value[fsField.id] || ''} onChange={(v) => FS.onChange(fsField.id, v || null)} bordered placeholder={'Nhập ' + fsField.label.toLowerCase() + '…'} />}
        </DdSurface>;
      })()
    : fsField
    ? <DdSurface width={240}>
        <DdHeader icon="chevron-left" label={fsField.label} onClick={() => { setFPage(null); setOptQ(''); }} />
        <DdSearch value={optQ} onChange={setOptQ} bordered placeholder="Search" />
        <DdScroll><DdGroup>
          {fsOpts.length ? fsOpts.map(([v, l]) => <DdItem key={v} text={l} tickOnly selected={FS.value[fsField.id] === v} onClick={() => { FS.onChange(fsField.id, FS.value[fsField.id] === v ? null : v); closeF(); }} />) : <DdItem text="No results" disabled />}
        </DdGroup></DdScroll>
      </DdSurface>
    : <DdSurface width={260}>
        <DdHeader icon="x" label="Filter" onClick={closeF} />
        <DdSearch value={fldQ} onChange={setFldQ} bordered placeholder="Search fields" />
        <DdScroll>
          {visF.length ? <React.Fragment>{grouped ? <DdLabel label="Visible fields" /> : null}<DdGroup>{visF.map(fItem)}</DdGroup></React.Fragment> : null}
          {visF.length && hidF.length ? <DdSep /> : null}
          {hidF.length ? <React.Fragment><DdLabel label="Hidden fields" /><DdGroup>{hidF.map(fItem)}</DdGroup></React.Fragment> : null}
          {!visF.length && !hidF.length ? <DdGroup><DdItem text="No results" disabled /></DdGroup> : null}
        </DdScroll>
      </DdSurface>) : null;
  const activeF = FS ? FS.fields.filter((f) => FS.value[f.id] || (f.text && FS.value[f.id + '__op'] && FS.value[f.id + '__op'] !== 'contains' && (FS.value[f.id + '__op'] === 'empty' || FS.value[f.id + '__op'] === 'notEmpty'))) : [];
  const qOn = FS && FS.search && FS.search.value.trim();
  // Twenty SortOrFilterChip: 24px, accent-quaternary / accent-tertiary, chữ xanh sm; key medium, value filter regular / sort medium.
  const fchip = { display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', columnGap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', height: 24, padding: '2px 2px 2px var(--t-spacing-1)', boxSizing: 'border-box', flexShrink: 0, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: 'var(--t-accent-quaternary)', border: '1px solid var(--t-accent-tertiary)', color: 'var(--t-color-blue)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', fontWeight: 500, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none' };
  const chipX = (label, onClick) => <span role="button" aria-label={label} onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); }} style={{ width: 20, height: 20, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', cursor: 'pointer' }} className="chip-x"><Icon name="x" size={14} color="currentColor" /></span>;
  const vsep = <span style={{ alignSelf: 'stretch', display: 'flex', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-1)' }}><span style={{ width: 1, background: 'var(--t-background-quaternary)' }} /></span>;
  const sortF = sortSpec && sortSpec.value ? fields.concat(hiddenFields).find((f) => f.id === sortSpec.value.id) : null;
  const chipBar = FS && (activeF.length || qOn || sortF) ? (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', minHeight: 32, padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1) var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-1) 0', boxSizing: 'border-box', borderTop: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', minWidth: 0, overflowX: 'hidden' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
          {sortF ? <span style={fchip} title="Bấm để đổi chiều sắp xếp" onClick={() => sortSpec.onChange({ id: sortSpec.value.id, dir: sortSpec.value.dir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc' })}>
            <Icon name={sortSpec.value.dir === 'desc' ? 'arrow-down' : 'arrow-up'} size={14} color="currentColor" />
            <span>{sortF.label}</span>
            {chipX('Bỏ sắp xếp', () => sortSpec.onChange(null))}
          </span> : null}
          {sortF && (activeF.length || qOn) ? vsep : null}
          {qOn ? <span style={fchip}><Icon name="search" size={14} color="currentColor" /><span style={{ fontWeight: 400 }}>{FS.search.value.trim()}</span>{chipX('Bỏ tìm', () => FS.search.onChange(''))}</span> : null}
          {activeF.map((f) => {
            const tOp = f.text ? (FS.value[f.id + '__op'] || 'contains') : null;
            const o = f.text ? [0, (tOp === 'empty' ? 'là trống' : tOp === 'notEmpty' ? 'không trống' : (tOp === 'notContains' ? 'không chứa ' : '') + FS.value[f.id])] : f.options.find(([v]) => v === FS.value[f.id]);
            return (
              <span key={f.id} style={fchip}>
                <Icon name={f.Icon} size={14} color="currentColor" />
                <span style={{ display: 'flex' }}><span>{f.label}:&nbsp;</span><span style={{ fontWeight: 400 }}>{o ? o[1] : ''}</span></span>
                {chipX('Bỏ lọc ' + f.label, () => { FS.onChange(f.id, null); if (f.text) FS.onChange(f.id + '__op', null); })}
              </span>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        <LightButton title="Add filter" Icon="plus" accent="tertiary" onClick={() => toggle('Filter')} />
      </div>
      <LightButton title="Reset" accent="tertiary" onClick={() => { FS.onReset(); if (sortSpec) sortSpec.onChange(null); }} />
    </div>
  ) : null;

  const sVisible = fields.filter(hit(sortQ));
  const sHidden = hiddenFields.filter(hit(sortQ));
  const pickSort = (f) => () => { if (sortSpec) sortSpec.onChange({ id: f.id, dir: dir === 'Ascending' ? 'asc' : 'desc' }); setOpen(null); };
  const sortMenu = <DdSurface width={320}>
    <DdHeader icon="x" label="Sort" onClick={() => setOpen(null)} />
    {<React.Fragment><div onClick={() => setDirOpen((d) => !d)} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', height: 28, flexShrink: 0, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', fontWeight: 500, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
      <span>{dir}</span>
      <Icon name="chevron-down" size={14} color="currentColor" />
    </div>
    {dirOpen ? <DdGroup>{['Ascending', 'Descending'].map((d) => <DdItem key={d} text={d} selected={d === dir} onClick={() => { setDir(d); setDirOpen(false); }} />)}</DdGroup> : null}</React.Fragment>}
    <DdSep />
    <DdScroll>
      <DdSearch value={sortQ} onChange={setSortQ} />
      {sVisible.length ? <React.Fragment><DdLabel label="Visible fields" /><DdGroup>{sVisible.map((f) => fieldItem(f, pickSort(f), sortRight(f)))}</DdGroup></React.Fragment> : null}
      {sVisible.length && sHidden.length ? <DdSep /> : null}
      {sHidden.length ? <React.Fragment><DdLabel label="Hidden fields" /><DdGroup>{sHidden.map((f) => fieldItem(f, pickSort(f), sortRight(f)))}</DdGroup></React.Fragment> : null}
    </DdScroll>
  </DdSurface>;

  const optionsMenu = optPage === 'fields' && fieldSpec
    ? <DdSurface width={220}>
        <DdHeader icon="chevron-left" label="Fields" onClick={() => setOptPage('menu')} />
        <DdSearch value={fieldQ} onChange={setFieldQ} />
        <DdSep />
        <DdScroll>
          <DdLabel label="Visible fields" />
          <DdGroup>{fields.filter(hit(fieldQ)).map((f) => fieldItem(f, () => { if (!f.locked) fieldSpec.onToggle(f.id); }, f.locked ? <DdEye name="lock" /> : <DdEye name="eye-off" />))}</DdGroup>
          {hiddenFields.filter(hit(fieldQ)).length ? <React.Fragment><DdSep /><DdLabel label="Hidden fields" />
            <DdGroup>{hiddenFields.filter(hit(fieldQ)).map((f) => fieldItem(f, () => fieldSpec.onToggle(f.id), <DdEye name="eye" />))}</DdGroup></React.Fragment> : null}
        </DdScroll>
      </DdSurface>
    : optPage === 'fields'
    ? <DdSurface width={200}>
        <DdHeader icon="chevron-left" label="Fields" onClick={() => setOptPage('menu')} />
        <DdSearch value={fieldQ} onChange={setFieldQ} />
        <DdSep />
        <DdScroll>
          <DdGroup>{fields.filter(hit(fieldQ)).map((f) => fieldItem(f, () => {}, <DdEye name="eye-off" />))}</DdGroup>
          <DdSep />
          <DdGroup><DdItem text="Hidden Fields" Icon="eye-off" hasSubMenu onClick={() => {}} /></DdGroup>
        </DdScroll>
      </DdSurface>
    : <DdSurface width={200}>
        <DdGroup><DdItem text="Default View" Icon={viewIcon} RightIcon="lock" disabled /></DdGroup>
        <DdSep />
        <DdGroup><DdItem text="Fields" Icon="list-details" rightText={`${fields.length} shown`} hasSubMenu onClick={() => setOptPage('fields')} /></DdGroup>
        <DdSep />
        <DdGroup>
          <DdItem text="Copy link to view" Icon="copy" onClick={() => setOpen(null)} />
          <DdItem text="Create custom view" Icon="layout" onClick={() => setOpen(null)} />
        </DdGroup>
      </DdSurface>;

  const menus = { Filter: specMenu || filterMenu, Sort: sortMenu, Options: optionsMenu };
  return (
    <div ref={ref} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', marginLeft: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', fontFamily: 'var(--t-font-family)' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', height: 39, boxSizing: 'border-box', paddingRight: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)', fontWeight: 500 }}>
        <div style={{ position: 'relative', flex: '0 1 auto', minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <span className="vp-shrink" onClick={() => toggle('views')} style={{ display: 'flex', minWidth: 110, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}><ViewPicker name={view} icon={viewIcon} count={count} /></span>
          {open === 'views' ? pop(viewsMenu, { left: 0 }) : null}
          {leftExtra || null}
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, fontWeight: 400, flexShrink: 0 }}>
          {(pre || []).map((p) => p.node ? <div key={p.label} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', marginRight: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>{p.node}</div> : (
            <div key={p.label} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
              <ViewBarButton label={p.label} active={!!p.open} onClick={p.onClick} />
              {p.open ? <React.Fragment><span onClick={p.onClose} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 30 }} /><span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 'calc(100% + 4px)', right: 0, zIndex: 31 }}>{p.menu}</span></React.Fragment> : null}
            </div>
          ))}
          {(barActions || ['Filter', 'Sort', 'Options']).map((a) => (
            <div key={a} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
              <ViewBarButton label={a} active={open === a} onClick={() => toggle(a)} />
              {open === a ? pop(menus[a], { right: 0 }) : null}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {chipBar}
    </div>
  );
}

const CONTACT_OPTIONS = {
  lifecycle: { type: 'tag', options: ['New', 'Active', 'At Risk'] },
  subsidiary: { type: 'seed', options: ['Chi nhánh Hà Nội', 'Chi nhánh HCM', 'Chi nhánh Đà Nẵng', 'Chi nhánh Cần Thơ'] },
  department: { type: 'seed', options: ['Phòng ban A', 'Phòng ban B', 'Phòng ban C', 'Phòng ban D'] },
  // Đổi broker đi qua Chuyển khách (§4D.17), không sửa inline.
  tags: { type: 'tag', multi: true, options: ['Quan tâm ngân hàng', 'Sự kiện tháng 9', 'Ưu tiên cao', 'Chờ hồ sơ'] },
};

function ContactsScreen({ onOpen, record, onCloseRecord, sidePanel, onExpand }) {
  const [sel, setSel] = React.useState([]);
  const [vals, setVals] = React.useState({});
  const [cellMenu, setCellMenu] = React.useState(null);
  const [cellQ, setCellQ] = React.useState('');
  const menuRef = React.useRef(null);
  const defCols = RM_APP_DATA.contacts.columns.map((c, i) => (i === 0 ? Object.assign({}, c, { locked: true }) : c));
  const optCols = CUSTOMER_OPT_COLS;
  const [hide, setHide] = React.useState([]);
  const [show, setShow] = React.useState([]);
  const columns = defCols.filter((c) => hide.indexOf(c.id) < 0).concat(optCols.filter((c) => show.indexOf(c.id) >= 0));
  const hiddenCols = defCols.filter((c) => hide.indexOf(c.id) >= 0).concat(optCols.filter((c) => show.indexOf(c.id) < 0));
  const toggleCol = (id) => { const isOpt = optCols.some((c) => c.id === id); const [lst, set] = isOpt ? [show, setShow] : [hide, setHide]; set(lst.indexOf(id) >= 0 ? lst.filter((x) => x !== id) : lst.concat([id])); };
  useMvp();
  const isSup = mvpIsSup();
  const views = CUSTOMER_VIEWS.filter((v) => isSup ? v.id !== 'mine' : v.id !== 'team');
  const [viewName, setViewName] = React.useState(views[0].name);
  React.useEffect(() => { setViewName(views[0].name); }, [isSup]);
  const viewId = (views.find((v) => v.name === viewName) || views[0]).id;
  const rowsAll = mvpRows(viewId);
  const [flt, setFlt] = React.useState({});
  const [q, setQ] = React.useState('');
  const has = (v, t) => String(v || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(String(t).trim().toLowerCase()) >= 0;
  const navB = (r) => { const n = mvpNavNum(mvpCust(r).nav); return !n ? 'none' : n < 500 ? 'lt500' : n <= 1000 ? 'lt1b' : 'gt1b'; };
  const TEXT_F = ['name', 'ref', 'email', 'phone', 'subsidiary', 'department', 'tags'];
  const rows = rowsAll.filter((r) => {
    const dig = (x) => String(x || '').replace(/\D/g, '').replace(/^(84|0)/, '');
    for (const k of TEXT_F) if ((flt[k] || flt[k + '__op']) && !rmTextMatch(r[k], flt[k], flt[k + '__op'] || 'contains', k === 'phone' ? dig : null)) return false;
    if (flt.owner && r.owner !== flt.owner) return false;
    if (flt.lifecycle && lc9(r) !== flt.lifecycle) return false;
    if (flt.nav && navB(r) !== flt.nav) return false;
    if (flt.mvp_att && (flt.mvp_att === 'yes') !== (mvpOpen(r.id).length > 0)) return false;
    if (flt.mvp_last && !mvpLastBucket(mvpLastDays(r), flt.mvp_last)) return false;
    if (flt.mvp_health && mvpCust(r).health !== flt.mvp_health) return false;
    return true;
  });
  const opt = (k) => Array.from(new Set(rowsAll.map((r) => r[k]).filter(Boolean))).sort().map((x) => [x, x]);
  const filterSpec = {
    fields: [
      { id: 'name', col: 'name', label: 'Customer', Icon: 'user', text: true },
      { id: 'owner', col: 'owner', label: 'Broker', Icon: 'user-circle', options: opt('owner') },
      { id: 'lifecycle', col: 'lifecycle', label: 'Lifecycle', Icon: 'route', options: LC9.map((x) => [x, x]) },
      { id: 'nav', col: 'mvp_nav', label: 'NAV', Icon: 'coin', options: [['lt500', 'Dưới 500 tr'], ['lt1b', '500 tr – 1 tỷ'], ['gt1b', 'Trên 1 tỷ'], ['none', 'Chưa có']] },
      { id: 'mvp_att', col: 'mvp_att', label: 'Open Attention', Icon: 'bell', options: [['yes', 'Có Attention đang mở'], ['no', 'Không có']] },
      { id: 'mvp_last', col: 'mvp_last', label: 'Last Interaction', Icon: 'message-circle', options: [['le7', 'Trong 7 ngày'], ['le14', '8–14 ngày'], ['gt14', 'Hơn 14 ngày']] },
      { id: 'mvp_health', col: 'mvp_health', label: 'Data Health', Icon: 'heart-rate-monitor', options: [['ok', 'Tốt'], ['stale', 'Tương tác cũ'], ['missing', 'Thiếu dữ liệu'], ['na', 'Chưa đánh giá']] },
      { id: 'ref', col: 'ref', label: 'Master Customer ID', Icon: 'id', text: true },
      { id: 'email', col: 'email', label: 'Email', Icon: 'mail', text: true },
      { id: 'phone', col: 'phone', label: 'Phone', Icon: 'phone', text: true },
      { id: 'subsidiary', col: 'subsidiary', label: 'Subsidiary', Icon: 'building-skyscraper', options: opt('subsidiary') },
      { id: 'department', col: 'department', label: 'Department', Icon: 'sitemap', options: opt('department') },
      { id: 'tags', col: 'tags', label: 'Tags', Icon: 'tag', text: true },
    ].filter((f) => columns.concat(hiddenCols).some((c) => c.id === f.col)),
    value: flt, onChange: (id, v) => { setFlt((f) => Object.assign({}, f, { [id]: v })); setSel([]); },
    onReset: () => { setFlt({}); setQ(''); },
  };
  // §4E.14–4E.16: danh sách khách có Đang tải (không hiện trống sớm) · Chưa có · Lỗi tải (giữ view/bộ lọc). Không có 403 ở cấp danh sách: list đã giới hạn theo người phụ trách (§5E).
  const [lErr, lLoad, lRetry] = useRetry(DEMO_BLOCK_STATE === 'error');
  const lLoading = DEMO_BLOCK_STATE === 'loading' || lLoad;
  const count = rows.length;
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!cellMenu) return;
    const h = (e) => { if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(e.target)) { setCellMenu(null); setCellQ(''); } };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', h);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', h);
  }, [cellMenu]);
  const val = (r, k) => (vals[r.id] || {})[k] !== undefined ? vals[r.id][k] : r[k];
  const setVal = (r, k, v) => setVals((s2) => ({ ...s2, [r.id]: { ...(s2[r.id] || {}), [k]: v } }));
  const rowOf = (id) => rows.find((x) => x.id === id);
  const cellOptions = () => {
    if (!cellMenu) return null;
    const row = rowOf(cellMenu.id);
    const conf = CONTACT_OPTIONS[cellMenu.col];
    if (!row || !conf) return null;
    const current = val(row, cellMenu.col) || '';
    const picked = conf.multi ? String(current).split(',').map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [];
    const hit = conf.options.filter((o) => !cellQ || o.toLowerCase().includes(cellQ.toLowerCase()));
    const pick = (o) => {
      if (conf.multi) setVal(row, cellMenu.col, (picked.includes(o) ? picked.filter((x) => x !== o) : picked.concat(o)).join(', '));
      else { setVal(row, cellMenu.col, o); setCellMenu(null); setCellQ(''); }
    };
    return (
      <span ref={menuRef} style={{ position: 'fixed', top: cellMenu.y, left: Math.max(8, cellMenu.x - 200), zIndex: 200 }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <DdSurface width={200}>
          <DdSearch value={cellQ} onChange={setCellQ} placeholder="Search" />
          <DdSep />
          <DdScroll><DdGroup>
            {conf.empty ? <DdItem text={conf.empty} Icon="circle-off" selected={!current} tickOnly onClick={() => { setVal(row, cellMenu.col, ''); setCellMenu(null); setCellQ(''); }} /> : null}
            {hit.map((o) => <DdItem key={o} tickOnly selected={conf.multi ? picked.includes(o) : o === current} onClick={() => pick(o)}
              text={conf.type === 'person' ? <Chip label={o} avatarType="rounded" variant="transparent" />
                : conf.type === 'seed' ? <SeedChip label={o} variant="transparent" />
                : <Tag text={o} color={(cellMenu.col === 'lifecycle' ? LIFECYCLE_COLOR[o] : null) || 'gray'} preventShrink />} />)}
          </DdGroup></DdScroll>
        </DdSurface>
      </span>
    );
  };
  const editBehaviour = (r, c) => CONTACT_OPTIONS[c.id] && c.id !== 'lifecycle'
    ? { onEditClick: (e) => { const b = e && e.currentTarget ? e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect() : { right: 300, bottom: 200 }; setCellMenu({ id: r.id, col: c.id, x: b.right, y: b.bottom + 4 }); } }
    : c.id === 'activity' ? { noAction: true } : {};
  return (
    <Page title="Customers" icon={<span style={{ width: 16, height: 16, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: 'var(--t-object-tile-purple)', border: '1px solid var(--t-object-tile-border-purple)', boxSizing: 'border-box', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}><DS.Icon name="user" size={14} color="var(--t-tag-text-purple)" /></span>} iconColor="var(--t-tag-text-purple)" rightPanel={sidePanel ? sidePanel : record ? <RecordSidePanel record={record} onClose={onCloseRecord} onExpand={onExpand} /> : null}
      actions={<React.Fragment><DSButton title="New Customer" accent="blue" size="small" Icon="plus" /><DSIconButton Icon="dots-vertical" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="More" /></React.Fragment>}>
      <RmViewBar viewName={viewName} views={views} onViewChange={setViewName} viewIcon="list" count={lLoading || lErr ? undefined : count} fields={columns} hiddenFields={hiddenCols} fieldSpec={{ onToggle: toggleCol }} filterSpec={filterSpec} />
      {cellOptions()}
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', flex: 1, minHeight: 0, display: 'flex' }}>
        <div className="no-agg" style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'auto', paddingLeft: 'var(--t-spacing-3)' }}>
          {lLoading ? <div>{[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((i) => (
            <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-6)', height: 32, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-3) 0 40px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
              {[180, 150, 90, 110, 220, 120].map((w, j) => <span key={j} style={{ height: 10, width: w - ((i * 17 + j * 11) % 50), borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-xs)', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' }} />)}
            </div>))}</div>
          : lErr ? <DS.EmptyState Icon="alert-triangle" title="Không tải được danh sách khách." subtitle="View và bộ lọc hiện tại vẫn được giữ." actionLabel="Thử lại" onAction={lRetry} />
          : rowsAll.length && rows.length === 0 ? <div style={{ padding: '96px var(--t-spacing-4)' }}><DS.EmptyState Icon="filter-off" title="Không có khách nào khớp bộ lọc." subtitle="Thử bỏ bớt điều kiện lọc." actionLabel="Xoá bộ lọc" onAction={filterSpec.onReset} /></div>
          : rows.length === 0 ? (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: '96px var(--t-spacing-4)', textAlign: 'center' }}>
              <Icon name={viewId === 'need' ? 'bell-off' : 'users'} size={32} color="var(--t-font-color-light)" />
              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-lg)', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }}>{viewId === 'need' ? 'Không có khách nào cần chú ý' : mvpIsSup() ? 'Team chưa có khách nào' : 'Chưa có khách nào được giao cho bạn'}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', maxWidth: 360, textWrap: 'pretty' }}>{viewId === 'need' ? 'Hiện không có mục nào từ các tín hiệu đang theo dõi.' : 'Khi khách được gán cho bạn, họ sẽ hiện ở đây.'}</div>
              {viewId === 'need' ? (() => { const all = views.find((v) => v.id === (isSup ? 'team' : 'mine')) || views[0]; return <DSButton title={'Xem ' + all.name} variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={() => setViewName(all.name)} />; })() : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {lLoading || lErr || rows.length === 0 ? null : <RecordTable columns={columns} rows={rows} selectedIds={sel} onSelectionChange={setSel} onRowClick={onOpen}
            renderCell={(r, c) => { const rv = Object.assign({}, r, vals[r.id] || {}); return (
              <CellShell isFirst={c.id === columns[0].id} noAction={c.id.indexOf('mvp_') === 0 || c.id === 'owner' || c.id === 'lifecycle'} hasCopy={c.id === 'email' || c.id === 'phone' || c.id === 'ref'} format={c.id === 'phone' ? 'phone' : undefined}
                isActive={record && record.id === r.id} text={typeof rv[c.id] === 'string' ? rv[c.id] : ''}
                render={(v) => <span onClick={() => onOpen(r)} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flex: 1, minWidth: 0, alignSelf: 'stretch', cursor: 'pointer' }}>{contactCell(Object.assign({}, rv, { [c.id]: v }), c)}</span>} onOpen={() => onExpand && onExpand(r)} {...editBehaviour(r, c)}><span onClick={() => onOpen(r)} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flex: 1, minWidth: 0, alignSelf: 'stretch', cursor: 'pointer' }}>{contactCell(rv, c)}</span></CellShell>
            ); }} />}
        </div>
        <SelectionActionBar count={sel.length} onClear={() => setSel([])} />
      </div>
    </Page>
  );
}
Object.assign(window, { SegmentsScreen, PipelineScreen, RecordSidePanel, ContactsScreen, Customer360Screen });
