function mvpTaskRows(viewId) {
  if (MVP.taskEmpty) return [];
  const me = mvpMe();
  let l = (MVP.tlist || []).filter((t) => (viewId === 'all' ? true : viewId === 'team' ? MVP_TEAM_BROKERS.indexOf(t.who) >= 0 : viewId === 'given' ? t.by === me && t.who !== me : viewId === 'qops' ? t.who === 'Hàng đợi Ops' : viewId === 'qcmp' ? t.who === 'Hàng đợi Compliance' : viewId === 'cancelled' ? t.who === me || t.by === me || t.cancelBy === me : t.who === me)); // E09-S15: My Tasks chỉ gồm việc tôi phải làm; Việc tôi giao tách riêng // Team Tasks = việc của các broker trong team; Full: My Tasks gồm cả việc tôi giao đi
  l = viewId === 'done' ? l.filter((t) => t.status === 'done') : viewId === 'cancelled' ? l.filter((t) => t.status === 'cancelled') : l.filter((t) => t.status === 'open');
  if (viewId === 'follow') l = l.filter((t) => t.att);
  return l.slice().sort((a, b) => (viewId === 'done' ? (b.doneIso || '').localeCompare(a.doneIso || '') : a.due.localeCompare(b.due)));
}

function MvpCustPicker({ value, onChange }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(!value);
  const [q, setQ] = React.useState('');
  const list = mvpRows('all').filter((r) => !q || r.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase()) >= 0);
  const cur = value ? mvpCustOf(value) : null;
  if (!open && cur) {
    return (
      <span onClick={() => setOpen(true)} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
        <Chip label={cur.name} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" />
        <Icon name="chevron-down" size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-light)" />
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      <input autoFocus value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} placeholder="Tìm khách của bạn" style={Object.assign({}, MVP_INPUT, { width: '100%', border: 'none', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', borderRadius: 0 })} />
      <div style={{ maxHeight: 168, overflowY: 'auto', overflowX: 'hidden', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>
        {list.length ? list.map((r) => (
          <PanelOptionItem key={r.id} selected={r.id === value} onPick={() => { onChange(r.id); setOpen(false); setQ(''); }}>
            <Chip label={r.name} avatarType="rounded" variant="transparent" />
          </PanelOptionItem>
        )) : <span style={{ display: 'block', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Không tìm thấy khách.</span>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MvpTaskTile({ size = 16 }) {
  return (
    <span style={{ width: size, height: size, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: 'var(--t-object-tile-orange)', border: '1px solid var(--t-object-tile-border-orange)', boxSizing: 'border-box', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
      <Icon name="checkbox" size={size - 2} color="var(--t-tag-text-orange)" />
    </span>
  );
}

function MvpTypeTag({ type }) {
  const T = MVP_TT[type];
  return <Tag text={T[0]} Icon={T[1]} color={T[2]} preventShrink />;
}

function MvpDueText({ t }) {
  const [rel, col] = mvpDue(t);
  return (
    <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>
      <span>{mvpFmt(t.due)}</span>
      {rel ? <span style={{ color: col === 'red' ? 'var(--t-tag-text-red)' : col === 'blue' ? 'var(--t-tag-text-blue)' : 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>· {rel}</span> : null}
    </span>
  );
}

function MvpDateInline({ value, onChange }) {
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <span onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
      style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, height: 24, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
      {mvpFmt(value)}
      <Icon name="chevron-down" size={12} color="var(--t-font-color-light)" />
      <input type="date" value={value} onClick={(e) => { try { e.currentTarget.showPicker && e.currentTarget.showPicker(); } catch (x) {} }} onChange={(e) => e.target.value && onChange(e.target.value)}
        style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', opacity: 0, cursor: 'pointer', border: 'none', padding: 0 }} />
    </span>
  );
}

// Ô tên việc: không đặt ô tick thứ hai cạnh checkbox chọn dòng — hoàn thành qua nút hiện khi hover.
function MvpTaskTitleCell({ t }) {
  const isDone = t.status === 'done';
  return (
    <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
      {isDone ? <Icon name="circle-check" size={14} color="var(--t-tag-text-green)" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} /> : null}
      <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', textDecoration: isDone ? 'line-through' : 'none', color: isDone ? 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }}>{t.title}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

function TaskGroupBar({ label, color, count, open, onToggle }) {
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <div onClick={onToggle} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
      style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 32, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', boxSizing: 'border-box', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-lighter)' : 'transparent' }}>
      <Icon name={open ? 'chevron-down' : 'chevron-right'} size={14} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" />
      <Tag text={label} color={color} preventShrink />
      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>{count}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

// Task side panel (§5F route /tasks/:taskId): cùng khung 400px, cùng section với panel khách.
function MvpTaskPanel({ taskId, onClose, onOpenCust, onOpenAtt, onComplete, onDelete }) {
  const m = useMvp();
  const [menu, setMenu] = React.useState(false);
  const menuRef = useDismiss(menu, React.useCallback(() => setMenu(false), []));
  const t = (m.tlist || []).find((x) => x.id === taskId);
  const shell = { width: 400, flexShrink: 0, height: '100%', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', borderLeft: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', boxSizing: 'border-box', overflow: 'hidden' };
  if (!t) {
    return (
      <div style={shell}>
        <DS.EmptyState Icon="checkbox" title="Việc này không còn tồn tại." subtitle="Việc có thể đã bị xoá." actionLabel="Đóng" onAction={onClose} />
      </div>
    );
  }
  const cust = mvpCustOf(t.cid);
  const ro = mvpTaskRO(t);
  const isDone = t.status === 'done';
  const isCancelled = t.status === 'cancelled';
  const editable = !ro && !isDone && !isCancelled;
  const a = t.att ? mvpAtt(MVP_ATT.find((x) => x.id === t.att)) : null;
  const [rel, relCol] = mvpDue(t);
  const reassigned = MVP.demo === 'reassigned' && !ro && !isDone;
  const st = isCancelled ? ['Đã huỷ', 'gray'] : isDone ? ['Đã xong', 'green'] : relCol === 'red' ? ['Quá hạn', 'red'] : ['Đang mở', 'blue'];
  const banner = (bg, color, kids) => <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-3)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', background: bg, color, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', lineHeight: 1.45 }}>{kids}</div>;
  const typeOpts = Object.keys(MVP_TT).map((k) => ({ value: k }));
  return (
    <div style={shell}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 48, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2) 0 var(--t-spacing-3)', boxSizing: 'border-box', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <MvpTaskTile />
        <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', overflow: 'hidden', marginLeft: editable ? -8 : 0 }} title={t.title}>
          {editable ? <InlineTitle placeholder="Tên việc" value={t.title} onChange={(v) => v.trim() && mvpPatchTask(t.id, { title: v.trim() })} />
            : <span style={{ minWidth: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', textDecoration: isDone ? 'line-through' : 'none', color: isDone ? 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }}>{t.title}</span>}
        </span>
        {ro && !mvpCanClaim(t) && !mvpGiverCanEdit(t) ? <Tag text="Chỉ xem" color="gray" preventShrink /> : null}
        <DSIconButton Icon="link" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Sao chép link việc" onClick={() => { const u = window.location.href.split('#')[0] + '#task=' + encodeURIComponent(t.id); try { navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText(u); } catch (e) {} mvpToast('Đã sao chép link việc'); }} />
        <DSIconButton Icon="x" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Đóng" onClick={onClose} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflowY: 'auto', paddingBottom: 'var(--t-spacing-6)' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
          {reassigned ? banner('var(--t-tag-background-orange)', 'var(--t-tag-text-orange)', <React.Fragment>
            <span style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>Khách này đã được chuyển cho {MVP_CHAU}.</span>
            <span>Việc hiện có không chuyển theo — việc vẫn thuộc bạn. Hoàn thành lúc này sẽ không tính là tương tác của khách, vì bạn không còn phụ trách khách.{isFull() ? ' Huỷ việc nếu không còn cần.' : ''}</span>
          </React.Fragment>) : null}
          <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}>
            <Tag text={st[0]} color={st[1]} preventShrink />
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>{isCancelled ? 'Huỷ ' + mvpFmt(t.cancelIso) : isDone ? 'Hoàn thành ' + mvpFmt(t.doneIso) : 'Hạn ' + mvpFmt(t.due) + (rel ? ' · ' + rel.toLowerCase() : '')}</span>
          </span>
          {ro ? <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>{MVP_QUEUE_ROLE[t.who] && t.status === 'open' ? 'Việc đang ở ' + t.who + ', chưa ai nhận. Người trong vai trò ' + MVP_QUEUE_ROLE[t.who][1] + ' sẽ nhận và hoàn thành.' : t.by === mvpMe() ? 'Việc bạn giao cho ' + t.who + (t.claimedFrom ? ' (đã nhận từ ' + t.claimedFrom + ')' : '') + '. Người nhận là người hoàn thành; bạn chỉ xem.' : 'Việc của ' + t.who + '. Bạn chỉ xem — người được giao là người hoàn thành việc.'}</span> : null}
          {mvpCanClaim(t) ? <span style={{ display: 'flex' }}><DSButton title="Nhận việc" accent="blue" size="small" Icon="hand-grab" onClick={() => mvpClaimTask(t)} /></span> : null}
          {mvpGiverCanEdit(t) ? <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}><span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>Giao lại</span><MvpAssigneeSelect value={t.who} onChange={(v) => { if (v === t.who) return; mvpPatchTask(t.id, { who: v }); mvpToast('Đã giao lại cho ' + mvpMeLabel(v)); }} /><span style={{ flex: 1 }} /><DSButton title="Huỷ việc" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="circle-off" onClick={() => onDelete(t)} /></span> : null}
        </div>
        {isDone ? (
          <C360LeftSection title="Kết quả">
            <KVRow label="Kết quả" Icon="circle-check" value={<Tag text={MVP_TRES[t.result][0]} color={MVP_TRES[t.result][1]} preventShrink />} />
            <KVRow label="Hoàn thành" Icon="calendar-check" value={mvpFmt(t.doneIso) + ' · ' + mvpMeLabel(t.who)} />
            {t.doneNote ? <KVRow multiline label="Ghi chú kết quả" Icon="file-text" value={t.doneNote} /> : null}
            {t.type !== 'todo' ? (
              <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: t.result === 'ok' || t.result === 'met' ? 'var(--t-tag-text-green)' : 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
                <Icon name={t.result === 'ok' || t.result === 'met' ? 'check' : 'minus'} size={12} color="currentColor" />
                {t.result === 'ok' || t.result === 'met' ? 'Đã ghi vào Hoạt động · Tương tác có ý nghĩa' : 'Đã ghi vào Hoạt động · không tính là tương tác có ý nghĩa'}
              </span>
            ) : null}
          </C360LeftSection>
        ) : null}
        {isCancelled ? (
          <C360LeftSection title="Đã huỷ">
            <KVRow label="Lý do" Icon="circle-off" value={t.cancelReason || '—'} />
            <KVRow label="Người huỷ" Icon="user-circle" value={<MvpWhoChip who={t.cancelBy || t.who} />} />
            <KVRow label="Ngày huỷ" Icon="calendar-x" value={mvpFmt(t.cancelIso)} />
          </C360LeftSection>
        ) : null}
        <C360LeftSection title="Chi tiết">
          <KVRow label="Loại" Icon="category" value={editable ? <InlineSelect options={typeOpts} value={t.type} onChange={(v) => mvpPatchTask(t.id, { type: v })} render={(o) => <MvpTypeTag type={o.value} />} /> : <MvpTypeTag type={t.type} />} />
          <KVRow label="Hạn" Icon="calendar-event" value={editable ? <MvpDateInline value={t.due} onChange={(v) => mvpPatchTask(t.id, { due: v })} /> : mvpFmt(t.due)} />
          <KVRow label="Khách" Icon="user" value={<span onClick={() => onOpenCust(t.cid)} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', cursor: 'pointer' }}><Chip label={cust ? cust.name : '—'} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" /></span>} />
          {t.claimedFrom ? <KVRow label="Nhận từ" Icon="inbox" value={t.claimedFrom + ' · ' + mvpFmt(t.claimedIso)} /> : null}
            <KVRow label="Giao cho" Icon="user-circle" value={editable && isFull() && !t.att && !mvpSelfOnly() ? <MvpAssigneeSelect value={t.who} onChange={(v) => { mvpPatchTask(t.id, { who: v }); mvpToast('Đã giao cho ' + mvpMeLabel(v)); }} /> : <MvpWhoChip who={t.who} />} />
          <KVRow label="Tạo bởi" Icon="user-plus" value={mvpMeLabel(t.by) + ' · ' + t.created} />
          <KVRow label="Nguồn" Icon="transform" value={t.att ? 'Từ Attention' : 'Tạo tay'} />
        </C360LeftSection>
        {a ? (
          <C360LeftSection title="Attention liên quan">
            <MvpAttLine a={a} onClick={() => onOpenAtt(a.id)} />
            <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>
              <Tag text={MVP_STA[a.status][0]} color={MVP_STA[a.status][1]} preventShrink />
              <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>{a.date ? a.date + ' · ' : ''}{a.detail || a.action}</span>
            </span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', lineHeight: 1.4 }}>Hoàn thành việc không mở lại hay thay đổi Attention.</span>
          </C360LeftSection>
        ) : null}
        <C360LeftSection key={'n' + t.id} title="Ghi chú" last>
          {editable ? (
            <span onBlur={(e) => { const ed = e.currentTarget.querySelector('[contenteditable="true"]'); const v = ed ? (ed.innerText || '').trim() : ''; if (v !== (t.note || '')) mvpPatchTask(t.id, { note: v }); }} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <RichTextArea placeholder="Type '/' for commands, '@' for mentions" minHeight={80} initialHtml={t.note ? '<div>' + t.note.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;') + '</div>' : undefined} />
            </span>
          )
            : <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', lineHeight: 1.45, color: t.note ? 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>{t.note || 'Không có ghi chú.'}</span>}
        </C360LeftSection>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 40, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1) var(--t-spacing-2)', borderTop: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        {!ro && !isCancelled ? (
          <span ref={menuRef} style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex' }}>
            <DSIconButton Icon="dots-vertical" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Thêm" onClick={() => setMenu((o) => !o)} />
            {menu ? (
              <DS.DropdownMenu width={200} style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 0, bottom: 'calc(100% + 4px)', zIndex: 41, maxWidth: 'none' }}>
                <DS.MenuItem text="Huỷ việc" LeftIcon="x" onClick={() => { setMenu(false); onDelete(t); }} />
              </DS.DropdownMenu>
            ) : null}
          </span>
        ) : null}
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        {isDone ? <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Đã hoàn thành {mvpFmt(t.doneIso)}</span> : null}
        {isCancelled ? <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Đã huỷ {mvpFmt(t.cancelIso)}</span> : null}
        {editable ? <DSButton title="Hoàn thành" accent="blue" size="small" Icon="check" onClick={() => onComplete(t)} /> : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Chọn khách trong panel tạo việc: cùng dropdown (DdSurface) như ô chọn ở list Customers.
function MvpCustSelect({ value, onChange }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [q, setQ] = React.useState('');
  const [at, setAt] = React.useState(null);
  const ref = React.useRef(null);
  const cur = value ? mvpCustOf(value) : null;
  const list = mvpRows('all').filter((r) => !q || r.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase()) >= 0);
  const toggle = () => {
    if (!open && ref.current) { const r = ref.current.getBoundingClientRect(); setAt({ top: r.bottom + 4, right: window.innerWidth - r.right }); }
    setOpen((o) => !o);
  };
  return (
    <span ref={ref} style={{ display: 'inline-flex' }}>
      <span onClick={toggle} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
        <HugValue>{cur ? <Chip label={cur.name} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" /> : <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Chọn khách</span>}</HugValue>
      </span>
      {open ? (
        <React.Fragment>
          <span onClick={() => { setOpen(false); setQ(''); }} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 40 }} />
          <span style={{ position: 'fixed', top: at ? at.top : 100, right: at ? at.right : 12, zIndex: 41 }}>
            <DdSurface width={240}>
              <DdSearch value={q} onChange={setQ} placeholder="Tìm khách" />
              <DdSep />
              <DdScroll><DdGroup>
                {list.length ? list.map((r) => <DdItem key={r.id} tickOnly selected={r.id === value} onClick={() => { onChange(r.id); setOpen(false); setQ(''); }} text={<Chip label={r.name} avatarType="rounded" variant="transparent" />} />)
                  : <DdItem text="Không tìm thấy khách" disabled />}
              </DdGroup></DdScroll>
            </DdSurface>
          </span>
        </React.Fragment>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
}

// Tạo việc ở side panel — cùng khung "Tạo việc" của trang Customers (PanelActionPage):
// tiêu đề inline ở header, Details / Assignment, Note, footer Hủy · Tạo việc.
const MVP_TYPE_OPTS = [{ value: 'Gọi', color: 'blue', key: 'call' }, { value: 'Gặp', color: 'purple', key: 'meeting' }, { value: 'Việc cần làm', color: 'gray', key: 'todo' }];
function mvpIsoOf(dp) { const p = dpParse(dp); if (!p) return null; const d = p.date; return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); }
function MvpTaskCreatePanel({ onClose, onCreated }) {
  const [title, setTitle] = React.useState('');
  const [who, setWho] = React.useState(mvpMe());
  const [cid, setCid] = React.useState(null);
  const [type, setType] = React.useState('Việc cần làm');
  const [due, setDue] = React.useState(() => { const d = new Date(MVP_TODAY + 'T00:00:00'); d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1); return dpFmt(d); }); // portal: customer360Tomorrow()
  const noteRef = React.useRef('');
  const dueIso = mvpIsoOf(due);
  const ok = !!(title.trim() && cid && dueIso);
  const create = () => {
    const t = title.trim();
    const id = mvpAddTaskT({ title: t, type: (MVP_TYPE_OPTS.find((o) => o.value === type) || MVP_TYPE_OPTS[2]).key, cid, due: dueIso, note: noteRef.current, who });
    mvpAddAct(cid, { icon: 'checkbox', title: 'Việc được tạo', date: 'Hôm nay', body: t + ' · hạn ' + mvpFmt(dueIso) });
    mvpToast('Đã tạo việc');
    onCreated(id);
  };
  return (
    <div style={{ width: 400, minWidth: 400, flexShrink: 0, height: '100%', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', borderLeft: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', height: 48, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2) 0 var(--t-spacing-1)', boxSizing: 'border-box', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <InlineTitle placeholder="Tên việc" value={title} onChange={setTitle} />
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        <DSIconButton Icon="x" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Đóng" onClick={onClose} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflowY: 'auto', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-4) var(--t-spacing-3) var(--t-spacing-6) var(--t-spacing-3)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-3)' }}>
        <FieldGroup title="Details">
          <EditFieldRow label="Hạn" Icon="calendar-event"><InlineDate placeholder="Chọn hạn" value={due} onChange={(v) => { const p = dpParse(v); setDue(p ? dpFmt(p.date) : ''); }} /></EditFieldRow>
          <EditFieldRow label="Loại" Icon="list-details"><InlineSelect value={type} onChange={setType} options={MVP_TYPE_OPTS} /></EditFieldRow>
          <EditFieldRow label="Nguồn" Icon="transform"><HugValue><Tag text="Tạo tay" color="gray" preventShrink /></HugValue></EditFieldRow>
        </FieldGroup>
        <FieldGroup title="Assigned">
          <EditFieldRow label="Giao cho" Icon="user-circle">{isFull() && !mvpSelfOnly() ? <MvpAssigneeSelect value={who} onChange={setWho} /> : mvpSelfOnly() ? <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)' }}><HugValue><Chip label="Tôi" avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" /></HugValue><span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>Việc của bạn</span></span> : <span title="MVP+: việc chỉ giao cho chính bạn" style={{ display: 'inline-flex' }}><HugValue><Chip label="Tôi" avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" /></HugValue></span>}</EditFieldRow>
          <EditFieldRow label="Liên quan" Icon="arrow-up-right"><MvpCustSelect value={cid} onChange={setCid} /></EditFieldRow>
        </FieldGroup>
        <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', margin: 'var(--t-spacing-2) 0 0', paddingTop: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-3)' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500 }}>Note</div>
          <span onInput={(e) => { const ed = e.currentTarget.querySelector('[contenteditable="true"]'); noteRef.current = ed ? (ed.innerText || '').trim() : ''; }} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <RichTextArea placeholder="Việc cần làm và lý do" />
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 40, boxSizing: 'border-box', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-1) var(--t-spacing-2)', borderTop: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        <DSButton title="Hủy" variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={onClose} />
        <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        <DSButton title="Tạo việc" accent="blue" size="small" disabled={!ok} onClick={create} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Attention mở từ Task = panel Attention chuẩn (§4E.13: không dựng bản tóm tắt thứ hai).
function MvpTaskAttPanel({ attId, onClose, onOpenTask, onOpenCustomer }) {
  const raw = MVP_ATT.find((x) => x.id === attId);
  const record = mvpCustOf(raw.cid);
  const [sel, setSel] = React.useState(attId);
  const [openDlg, dlg] = useMvpDialog(record);
  return <React.Fragment>{dlg}<MvpAttentionPanel record={record} attId={sel} onClose={onClose} onSelect={setSel} openDlg={openDlg} onOpenTask={onOpenTask} onOpenCustomer={onOpenCustomer ? () => onOpenCustomer(record.id) : undefined} /></React.Fragment>;
}

function MvpTasksScreen({ onExpand, sidePanel }) {
  const m = useMvp();
  const isSup = mvpIsSup();
  const isComp = VIEWER_ROLE === 'compliance';
  const isOps = VIEWER_ROLE === 'ops';
  const views = isComp ? TASK_VIEWS_C : isOps ? TASK_VIEWS_OPS : (isFull() ? [TASK_VIEWS_B[0], TASK_VIEW_GIVEN].concat((isSup ? TASK_VIEWS_S : TASK_VIEWS_B).slice(1)) : (isSup ? TASK_VIEWS_S : TASK_VIEWS_B)).concat(isFull() ? [TASK_VIEW_CANCEL] : []); // §3E.3: Supervisor xem Tasks trong phạm vi team (việc của broker khác chỉ xem)
  const [viewId, setViewId] = React.useState(() => (MVP.taskFocus && MVP.taskFocus.view) || views[0].id);
  const [panel, setPanel] = React.useState(() => {
    const m = /[#&]task=([^&]+)/.exec(window.location.hash || '');
    if (m && mvpTaskById(decodeURIComponent(m[1]))) return { kind: 'task', id: decodeURIComponent(m[1]) };
    return MVP.taskFocus && MVP.taskFocus.id ? { kind: 'task', id: MVP.taskFocus.id } : null;
  });
  // Link riêng cho panel việc (Step 5 §5F): #task=<id> — mở link là vào Tasks với panel việc mở sẵn.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const h = panel && panel.kind === 'task' ? '#task=' + encodeURIComponent(panel.id) : '';
      if ((window.location.hash || '') !== h) window.history.replaceState(null, '', window.location.pathname + window.location.search + h);
    } catch (e) {}
  }, [panel]);
  React.useEffect(() => { window.__mvpOpenTask = (id) => setPanel({ kind: 'task', id }); return () => { window.__mvpOpenTask = null; }; }, []);
  const [sel, setSel] = React.useState([]);
  const [closed, setClosed] = React.useState({});
  const [dlg, setDlg] = React.useState(null);
  const focusN = m.taskFocus ? m.taskFocus.n : 0;
  React.useEffect(() => { const f = MVP.taskFocus; if (!f) return; setViewId(f.view || 'mine'); setPanel(f.id ? { kind: 'task', id: f.id } : null); setSel([]); }, [focusN]);
  const view = views.find((v) => v.id === viewId) || views[0];
  const rowsAll = mvpTaskRows(view.id);
  const done = view.id === 'done';
  const [flt, setFlt] = React.useState({});
  const [q, setQ] = React.useState('');
  React.useEffect(() => { setFlt({}); }, [view.id]);
  const rows = rowsAll.filter((t) => {
    if (flt.type && t.type !== flt.type) return false;
    if (flt.cid && t.cid !== flt.cid) return false;
    if (flt.rel && (flt.rel === 'att') !== !!t.att) return false;
    if (flt.who && t.who !== flt.who) return false;
    if (flt.due) { const d = mvpDays(t.due); if (flt.due === 'over' ? d >= 0 : flt.due === 'today' ? d !== 0 : flt.due === 'week' ? (d < 1 || d > 7) : d <= 7) return false; }
    const nq = q.trim().toLowerCase(); const c = mvpCustOf(t.cid);
    if (nq && ![t.title, c && c.name].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(nq)) return false;
    return true;
  });
  const filterSpec = {
    search: { value: q, onChange: setQ, placeholder: 'Nhập tên việc…', label: 'Task', Icon: 'checkbox', col: 'title' },
    fields: [
      { id: 'type', col: 'type', label: 'Type', Icon: 'category', options: Object.keys(MVP_TT).map((k) => [k, MVP_TT[k][0]]) },
    ].concat(done ? [] : [{ id: 'due', col: 'due', label: 'Due Date', Icon: 'calendar-event', options: [['over', 'Quá hạn'], ['today', 'Hôm nay'], ['week', '7 ngày tới'], ['later', 'Sau 7 ngày']] }]).concat([
      { id: 'cid', col: 'cust', label: 'Customer', Icon: 'user', options: Array.from(new Set(rowsAll.map((t) => t.cid))).map((id) => { const c = mvpCustOf(id); return [id, c ? c.name : id]; }) },
      { id: 'rel', col: 'rel', label: 'Related To', Icon: 'arrow-up-right', options: [['att', 'Theo dõi Attention'], ['none', 'Không gắn Attention']] },
    ]).concat(view.id === 'team' || (done && isSup) ? [{ id: 'who', col: 'who', label: 'Assignee', Icon: 'user-circle', options: Array.from(new Set(rowsAll.map((t) => t.who))).map((x) => [x, x]) }] : []),
    value: flt, onChange: (id, v) => { setFlt((f) => Object.assign({}, f, { [id]: v })); setSel([]); },
    onReset: () => { setFlt({}); setQ(''); },
  };
  const C = {
    title: { id: 'title', label: 'Task', Icon: 'checkbox', width: 320, locked: true },
    cust: { id: 'cust', label: 'Customer', Icon: 'user', width: 190 },
    type: { id: 'type', label: 'Type', Icon: 'category', width: 140 },
    due: { id: 'due', label: 'Due Date', Icon: 'calendar-event', width: 180 },
    rel: { id: 'rel', label: 'Related To', Icon: 'arrow-up-right', width: 170 },
    who: { id: 'who', label: 'Assignee', Icon: 'user-circle', width: 170 },
    created: { id: 'created', label: 'Created', Icon: 'calendar', width: 110 },
    result: { id: 'result', label: 'Result', Icon: 'circle-check', width: 150 },
    doneAt: { id: 'doneAt', label: 'Completed', Icon: 'calendar-check', width: 120 },
    note: { id: 'note', label: 'Note', Icon: 'file-text', width: 240 },
    createdBy: { id: 'createdBy', label: 'Created By', Icon: 'user-circle', width: 170 },
    source: { id: 'source', label: 'Created From', Icon: 'transform', width: 150 },
    reason: { id: 'reason', label: 'Lý do huỷ', Icon: 'circle-off', width: 220 },
    cancelAt: { id: 'cancelAt', label: 'Ngày huỷ', Icon: 'calendar-x', width: 120 },
  };
  const defCols = done ? [C.title, C.cust, C.type, C.result, C.doneAt, C.rel].concat(isSup ? [C.who] : [])
    : view.id === 'cancelled' ? [C.title, C.cust, C.type, C.reason, C.cancelAt, C.who]
    : [C.title, C.cust, C.type, C.due, C.rel].concat(view.id === 'team' || view.id === 'all' || isFull() ? [C.who] : []).concat([C.created]);
  const optCols = [C.note, C.createdBy, C.source];
  const [hide, setHide] = React.useState([]);
  const [show, setShow] = React.useState([]);
  const cols = defCols.filter((c) => hide.indexOf(c.id) < 0).concat(optCols.filter((c) => show.indexOf(c.id) >= 0));
  const hiddenCols = defCols.filter((c) => hide.indexOf(c.id) >= 0).concat(optCols.filter((c) => show.indexOf(c.id) < 0));
  const toggleCol = (id) => { const isOpt = optCols.some((c) => c.id === id); const [lst, set] = isOpt ? [show, setShow] : [hide, setHide]; set(lst.indexOf(id) >= 0 ? lst.filter((x) => x !== id) : lst.concat([id])); };
  const openTask = (id) => setPanel({ kind: 'task', id });
  const openCust = (cid) => { const r = mvpCustOf(cid); if (r && onExpand) onExpand(r); }; // §4E.13: Task → Customer Record
  const openAtt = (attId, taskId) => setPanel({ kind: 'att', attId, taskId });
  const complete = (t) => {
    if (t.type === 'todo' && MVP.demo !== 'conflict') { mvpTaskDone(t); mvpToast('Đã hoàn thành việc'); return; }
    setDlg({ kind: 'taskdone', t });
  };
  const stop = (fn) => (e) => { if (e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation(); fn(); };
  const cell = (t, c) => {
    if (c.id === 'title') return <MvpTaskTitleCell t={t} />;
    if (c.id === 'cust') { const r = mvpCustOf(t.cid); return <span onClick={stop(() => openCust(t.cid))} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', minWidth: 0, cursor: 'pointer' }}><Chip label={r ? r.name : '—'} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" /></span>; }
    if (c.id === 'type') return <MvpTypeTag type={t.type} />;
    if (c.id === 'due') return <MvpDueText t={t} />;
    if (c.id === 'rel') {
      if (!t.att) return <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>—</span>;
      const a = mvpAtt(MVP_ATT.find((x) => x.id === t.att));
      return (
        <span onClick={stop(() => openAtt(a.id, null))} title={'Attention · ' + mvpHeadline(a)} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, flex: 1, minWidth: 0, alignSelf: 'stretch', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
          <Icon name="bell" size={14} color="var(--t-tag-text-red)" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
          <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{mvpHeadline(a)}</span>
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (c.id === 'who') return <MvpWhoChip who={t.who} />;
    if (c.id === 'reason') return <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{t.cancelReason || '—'}</span>;
    if (c.id === 'cancelAt') return mvpFmt(t.cancelIso);
    if (c.id === 'created') return <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>{t.created}</span>;
    if (c.id === 'result') return <Tag text={MVP_TRES[t.result][0]} color={MVP_TRES[t.result][1]} preventShrink />;
    if (c.id === 'doneAt') return mvpFmt(t.doneIso);
    if (c.id === 'note') return t.note ? <span style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{t.note}</span> : <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>—</span>;
    if (c.id === 'createdBy') return <Chip label={mvpMeLabel(t.by)} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" />;
    if (c.id === 'source') return <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>{t.att ? 'Từ Attention' : 'Tạo tay'}</span>;
    return null;
  };
  const table = (list, hideHead, key) => (
    <div key={key} className={hideHead ? 'no-agg no-add no-head' : key === 'all' && view.id === 'mine' ? 'no-agg' : 'no-agg no-add'}>
      <RecordTable columns={cols} rows={list} selectedIds={sel} onSelectionChange={(ids) => setSel((p) => p.filter((id) => !list.some((r) => r.id === id)).concat(ids))}
        onRowClick={(t) => openTask(t.id)} onAddNew={view.id === 'mine' || view.id === 'given' ? () => setPanel({ kind: 'create', n: Date.now() }) : undefined}
        renderCell={(t, c) => <CellShell isFirst={c.id === 'title'} noAction={c.id !== 'title'} extraAction={c.id === 'title' && mvpCanClaim(t) ? { icon: 'hand-grab', label: 'Nhận việc', onClick: () => mvpClaimTask(t) } : c.id === 'title' && t.status === 'open' && !mvpTaskRO(t) ? { icon: 'check', label: 'Hoàn thành', onClick: () => complete(t) } : null} isActive={!!panel && panel.kind === 'task' && panel.id === t.id} onOpen={() => openTask(t.id)}><span onClick={() => openTask(t.id)} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flex: 1, minWidth: 0, alignSelf: 'stretch', cursor: 'pointer' }}>{cell(t, c)}</span></CellShell>} />
    </div>
  );
  const loading = DEMO_BLOCK_STATE === 'loading';
  const err = DEMO_BLOCK_STATE === 'error';
  let content;
  if (loading) {
    content = <React.Fragment>{table([], false, 'head')}{[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
      <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-6)', height: 32, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-3) 0 40px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
        {[240, 140, 80, 110, 180].map((w, j) => <span key={j} style={{ height: 10, width: w - ((i * 17 + j * 11) % 50), borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-xs)', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' }} />)}
      </div>
    ))}</React.Fragment>;
  } else if (err) {
    content = <DS.EmptyState Icon="alert-triangle" title="Không tải được danh sách việc." subtitle="Việc của bạn không bị mất. Thử lại sau ít phút." actionLabel="Thử lại" onAction={() => { DEMO_BLOCK_STATE = null; try { window.localStorage.setItem('rm-mvp-blockstate', ''); } catch (e) {} mvpSet(() => {}); }} />;
  } else if (rowsAll.length && !rows.length) {
    content = <DS.EmptyState Icon="filter-off" title="Không có việc nào khớp bộ lọc." subtitle="Thử bỏ bớt điều kiện lọc." actionLabel="Xoá bộ lọc" onAction={filterSpec.onReset} />;
  } else if (!rows.length) {
    const E = TASK_EMPTY[view.id];
    content = <DS.EmptyState Icon={E[0]} title={E[1]} subtitle={E[2]} actionLabel={view.id === 'mine' ? 'New Task' : undefined} onAction={view.id === 'mine' ? () => setPanel({ kind: 'create', n: Date.now() }) : undefined} />;
  } else {
    // Danh sách phẳng như bảng hiện tại, sắp theo hạn; mức gấp chỉ thể hiện ở ô Due Date.
    content = table(rows, false, 'all');
  }
  const rightPanel = sidePanel ? sidePanel : !panel ? null
    : panel.kind === 'task' ? <MvpTaskPanel key={panel.id} taskId={panel.id} onClose={() => setPanel(null)} onOpenCust={openCust} onOpenAtt={(attId) => openAtt(attId, panel.id)} onComplete={complete} onDelete={(t) => setDlg({ kind: 'taskdelete', t })} />
    : panel.kind === 'create' ? <MvpTaskCreatePanel key={'c' + panel.n} onClose={() => setPanel(null)} onCreated={(id) => { if (view.id === 'done') setViewId('mine'); setPanel({ kind: 'task', id }); }} />
    : panel.kind === 'att' ? <MvpTaskAttPanel key={panel.attId} attId={panel.attId} onClose={() => setPanel(panel.taskId ? { kind: 'task', id: panel.taskId } : null)} onOpenTask={openTask} onOpenCustomer={openCust} />
    : <RecordSidePanel key={panel.id} record={mvpCustOf(panel.id)} onClose={() => setPanel(null)} onExpand={(r, t) => onExpand && onExpand(r || mvpCustOf(panel.id), t)} />;
  return (
    <Page title="Tasks" icon={<MvpTaskTile />} iconColor="var(--t-tag-text-orange)" rightPanel={rightPanel}
      actions={view.id === 'all' ? <Tag text="Chỉ xem" color="gray" Icon="eye" preventShrink /> : <React.Fragment><DSButton title="New Task" accent="blue" size="small" Icon="plus" onClick={() => setPanel({ kind: 'create', n: Date.now() })} /><DSIconButton Icon="dots-vertical" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="More" /></React.Fragment>}>
      {dlg ? <MvpDialog key={dlg.kind} kind={dlg.kind} record={dlg.t ? mvpCustOf(dlg.t.cid) : null} att={null}
        init={dlg.t ? { taskId: dlg.t.id } : { type: 'todo', due: mvpPlus3() }} onClose={() => setDlg(null)}
        onDone={(r) => { setDlg(null); if (r.toast) mvpToast(r.toast); if (r.closePanel) setPanel(null); if (r.taskId) { setPanel({ kind: 'task', id: r.taskId }); if (view.id === 'done') setViewId('mine'); } }} /> : null}
      <RmViewBar viewName={view.name} viewIcon="list" views={views} onViewChange={(n) => { const v = views.find((x) => x.name === n); if (v) setViewId(v.id); setSel([]); }} count={loading || err ? undefined : rows.length} fields={cols} hiddenFields={hiddenCols} fieldSpec={{ onToggle: toggleCol }} filterSpec={filterSpec} />
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', flex: 1, minHeight: 0, display: 'flex' }}>
        <div style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'auto', paddingLeft: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
          <div style={{ minWidth: rows.length && !err ? 'max-content' : 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', flex: !rows.length || err ? 1 : 'none' }}>{content}</div>
        </div>
        <SelectionActionBar count={sel.length} onClear={() => setSel([])} />
      </div>
    </Page>
  );
}


// Search trong side panel (giống Twenty SidePanelSearchRecordsPage), không mở popup.
const mvpFold = (s) => String(s || '').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/đ/g, 'd').replace(/Đ/g, 'D').toLowerCase();
const ATT_COMMANDS = [
  { id: 'search', label: 'Search', icon: 'search', key: '/' },
];
function MvpCmdRow({ c, onClick }) {
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <div onClick={onClick} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)}
      style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 32, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)' }}>
      <span style={{ width: 24, height: 24, flexShrink: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' }}><Icon name={c.icon} size={16} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" /></span>
      <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{c.label}</span>
      {c.key ? <span style={{ width: 16, height: 16, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-strong)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-lighter)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-xs)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>{c.key}</span> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
// Twenty SidePanelSearchRecordsPage: Search đổi trang ngay trong side panel (có nút Back), không mở popup (§4E.23–4E.24).
function MvpCommandMenuPanel({ onClose, onOpenAtt, onOpenCust, onOpenTask, scopeView, initialPage }) {
  const [page, setPage] = React.useState('search');
  const [q, setQ] = React.useState('');
  const inputRef = React.useRef(null);
  React.useEffect(() => { inputRef.current && inputRef.current.focus(); }, [page]);
  const list = ATT_COMMANDS.filter((c) => !q || mvpFold(c.label).indexOf(mvpFold(q)) >= 0);
  const goSearch = () => { setPage('search'); };
  const s = mvpFold(q.trim());
  const tickersOf = (a) => ((a.why + ' ' + a.based).match(/\b[A-Z]{3}\b/g) || []).join(' ').toLowerCase();
  const atts = s ? mvpAttRows(scopeView === 'team' ? 'team' : 'mine').concat(mvpAttRows('snoozed')).filter((a) => { const r = mvpCustOf(a.cid); return mvpFold([r && r.name, r && r.id, r && r.email, tickersOf(a)].filter(Boolean).join(' ')).indexOf(s) >= 0; }) : [];
  const qd = s.replace(/\D/g, ''); const phoneKeys = (p) => { const d = String(p || '').replace(/\D/g, ''); return d.indexOf('84') === 0 ? [d, '0' + d.slice(2)] : [d]; };
  const custs = s ? mvpRows('all').filter((r) => mvpFold([r.name, r.id, r.email, r.phone].filter(Boolean).join(' ')).indexOf(s) >= 0 || (qd.length >= 3 && qd.length === s.replace(/[\s+.-]/g, '').length && phoneKeys(r.phone).some((k) => k.indexOf(qd) >= 0))).slice(0, 8) : [];
  const me = mvpMe();
  const tasks = s ? (MVP.tlist || []).filter((t) => t.status !== 'cancelled' && (scopeView === 'team' ? MVP_TEAM.indexOf(t.who) >= 0 : t.who === me) && mvpFold([t.title, (mvpCustOf(t.cid) || {}).name].join(' ')).indexOf(s) >= 0).slice(0, 8) : [];
  const head = (t) => <div style={{ height: 28, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-xs)', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)' }}>{t}</div>;
  const onKey = (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    if (page === 'menu' && e.key === '/' && !q) { e.preventDefault(); goSearch(); }
    if (page === 'menu' && e.key === 'Enter' && list[0] && !s) goSearch();
  };
  return (
    <div style={{ width: 400, minWidth: 400, flexShrink: 0, height: '100%', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', borderLeft: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 48, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2) 0 ' + (page === 'search' ? 'var(--t-spacing-2)' : 'var(--t-spacing-3)'), boxSizing: 'border-box', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0, background: 'var(--t-background-secondary)' }}>
        <Icon name="search" size={16} color="var(--t-font-color-light)" />
        <input ref={inputRef} value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={onKey} placeholder="Tìm khách, Attention, việc…"
          style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, border: 'none', outline: 'none', background: 'transparent', fontFamily: 'var(--t-font-family)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' }} />
        <DSIconButton Icon="x" variant="secondary" size="small" ariaLabel="Đóng" onClick={onClose} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflowY: 'auto', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
        {page === 'menu' && !s ? <React.Fragment>
          {head('Khác')}
          {list.map((c) => <MvpCmdRow key={c.id} c={c} onClick={goSearch} />)}
        </React.Fragment>
        : !s ? <span style={{ padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-1)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', lineHeight: 1.45 }}>Tìm khách (tên, mã khách, điện thoại, email), Attention (tên khách, mã khách, mã CK — vd. FPT) và việc (tên việc).</span>
        : !atts.length && !custs.length && !tasks.length && !(page === 'menu' && list.length) ? <span style={{ padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-1)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-light)', lineHeight: 1.45 }}>Không tìm thấy “{q.trim()}”. Chỉ hiện khách, Attention và việc trong phạm vi của bạn.</span>
        : <React.Fragment>
          {page === 'menu' && list.length ? <React.Fragment>{head('Khác')}{list.map((c) => <MvpCmdRow key={c.id} c={c} onClick={goSearch} />)}</React.Fragment> : null}
          {atts.length ? <React.Fragment>{head('Attention')}{atts.map((a) => { const r = mvpCustOf(a.cid); return <MvpSearchResultRow key={a.id} tile={<span style={{ width: 24, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}><MvpAttTile /></span>} title={r ? r.name : '—'} sub={mvpHeadline(a)} right={<Tag text={MVP_PRI[a.pri][0]} color={MVP_PRI[a.pri][1]} preventShrink />} onClick={() => onOpenAtt(a.id)} />; })}</React.Fragment> : null}
          {custs.length ? <React.Fragment>{head('Khách')}{custs.map((r) => <MvpSearchResultRow key={r.id} tile={<span style={{ width: 24, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}><Avatar placeholder={r.name} size="md" type="rounded" /></span>} title={r.name} sub={r.phone} onClick={() => onOpenCust(r.id)} />)}</React.Fragment> : null}
          {tasks.length ? <React.Fragment>{head('Việc')}{tasks.map((t) => <MvpSearchResultRow key={t.id} tile={<span style={{ width: 24, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}><MvpTaskTile /></span>} title={t.title} sub={(mvpCustOf(t.cid) || {}).name} right={t.status === 'done' ? <Tag text="Đã xong" color="green" preventShrink /> : <span style={{ flexShrink: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>Hạn {mvpFmt(t.due)}</span>} onClick={() => onOpenTask(t.id)} />)}</React.Fragment> : null}
        </React.Fragment>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
function MvpSearchResultRow({ icon, tile, title, sub, right, onClick }) {
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <div onClick={onClick} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)} title={sub}
      style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', minHeight: 32, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>
      {tile || <span style={{ width: 24, height: 24, flexShrink: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}><Icon name={icon} size={16} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" /></span>}
      <span style={{ flexShrink: 0, color: 'var(--t-font-color-primary)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{title}</span>
      {sub ? <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>{sub}</span> : <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />}
      {right}
    </div>
  );
}

// Màn hiện tại có trong menu của vai trò không (theo roles trong nav).
function roleCanScreen(id) {
  const walk = (items) => { for (const x of items || []) { if (x.id === id) return !x.roles || x.roles.indexOf(VIEWER_ROLE) >= 0; const r = walk(x.children); if (r !== null) return r; } return null; };
  for (const s of (RM_APP_DATA.nav || [])) { const r = walk(s.items); if (r !== null) return r; }
  return true;
}

    : <DS.AppLayout drawer={<Drawer key={'nav'+roleTick} active={screen==='pipeline'?'leads':screen} onNavigate={go} onSearch={()=>{setThread(null);setCmd(true);}} aiTab={aiTab} onTabChange={(t)=>{ if(t==='ai-chat'){setRecord(null);setThread(SAMPLE_THREAD);} else setThread(null); }} onNewChat={()=>{setRecord(null);setThread([]);}} onOpenThread={()=>{setRecord(null);setThread(SAMPLE_THREAD);}} />}>
        {/^ap-/.test(screen) ? <ApprovalsScreen key={'ap'+roleTick} view={screen} onGo={go} sidePanel={ai} onExpand={(r,tb)=>{setCmd(false);setThread(null);if(r&&r.name)setRecord(r);setC360Tab(tb||'overview');setBackTo('dashboard');setScreen('c360');}} /> : screen==='st-governance' ? <GovernanceScreen key={'gov'+roleTick} sidePanel={ai} /> : screen==='st-audit' ? <AuditLogScreen key={'aud'+roleTick} sidePanel={ai} /> : screen==='inbox' && isFull() ? <ConversationsScreen key={'cv'+roleTick} sidePanel={ai} onExpand={(r,t)=>{setCmd(false);setThread(null);if(r&&r.name)setRecord(r);setC360Tab(t||'overview');setBackTo('inbox');setScreen('c360');}} /> : screen==='dashboard' ? <MvpDashboardScreen key={'dash'+roleTick} sidePanel={ai} onGo={go} onExpand={(r,t)=>{setCmd(false);setThread(null);if(r&&r.name)setRecord(r);setC360Tab(t||'overview');setBackTo('dashboard');setScreen('c360');}} /> : screen==='fav-team' ? (teamDrill ? <MvpAttentionListScreen key={'drill'+roleTick+teamDrill} broker={teamDrill} onBackTeam={()=>setTeamDrill(null)} sidePanel={ai} onExpand={(r,t)=>{setCmd(false);setThread(null);if(r&&r.name)setRecord(r);setC360Tab(t||'overview');setBackTo('fav-team');setScreen('c360');}} /> : <MvpTeamScreen sidePanel={ai} onDrill={(b)=>{ mvpSet((m)=>{ m.attFocus={view:'mine'}; if(m.attUi){ m.attUi=Object.assign({},m.attUi); delete m.attUi[b]; } }); try { history.replaceState(null,'','#fav-team'); } catch(e){} setTeamDrill(b); }} />) : screen==='fav-att' ? <MvpAttentionListScreen key={'att'+roleTick} sidePanel={ai} onGoCustomers={()=>go('contacts')} onExpand={(r,t)=>{setCmd(false);setThread(null);if(r&&r.name)setRecord(r);setC360Tab(t||'overview');setBackTo('fav-att');setScreen('c360');}} /> : screen==='cases' ? <CasesScreen key={'cases'+roleTick} sidePanel={ai} onExpand={(r,t)=>{setCmd(false);setThread(null);if(r&&r.name)setRecord(r);setC360Tab(t||'overview');setBackTo('cases');setScreen('c360');}} /> : screen==='tasks' ? (<MvpTasksScreen key={'tasks'+roleTick} sidePanel={ai} onExpand={(r,t)=>{setCmd(false);setThread(null);if(r&&r.name)setRecord(r);setC360Tab(t||'overview');setBackTo('tasks');setScreen('c360');}} />) : screen==='c360' ? (isFull() ? <Customer360Screen key={'role'+roleTick+(record?record.id:'')} record={record} onBack={()=>{setCmd(false);setThread(null);setScreen(backTo);setBackTo('contacts');}} onCustomers={()=>{setCmd(false);setThread(null);setScreen('contacts');setBackTo('contacts');}} initialTab={c360Tab} backLabel={backLbl} /> : <MvpCustomer360Screen key={'mvp'+roleTick+(record?record.id:'')} record={record} onBack={()=>{setCmd(false);setThread(null);setScreen(backTo);setBackTo('contacts');}} onCustomers={()=>{setCmd(false);setThread(null);setScreen('contacts');setBackTo('contacts');}} initialTab={c360Tab} backLabel={backLbl} />) : screen==='contacts' ? <ContactsScreen onOpen={(r)=>{setThread(null);setRecord(r);}} record={record} onCloseRecord={()=>setRecord(null)} sidePanel={ai} onExpand={(r,t)=>{setCmd(false);setThread(null);if(r&&r.name)setRecord(r);setC360Tab(t||'overview');setScreen('c360');}} /> : screen==='pipeline' ? <PipelineScreen onOpen={(r)=>{setThread(null);setRecord(r);}} record={record} onCloseRecord={()=>setRecord(null)} sidePanel={ai} /> : <SegmentsScreen onOpen={(r)=>{setThread(null);setRecord(r);}} record={record} onCloseRecord={()=>setRecord(null)} sidePanel={ai} />}
      </DS.AppLayout>;
  return (<React.Fragment>
    {body}
    {null /* Full dùng chung ô tìm kiếm side panel với MVP */}
    {searchPanel && thread===null && screen==='c360' ? <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, zIndex: 45, display: 'flex', boxShadow: 'var(--t-box-shadow-strong)' }}>{searchPanel}</div> : null}
    <MvpToast /><CaseDialogHost />
    <DemoSwitcher key={roleTick}
      listRec={screen==='contacts'&&record?record.id:null}
      caseId={/^ap-/.test(screen)?'approvals':screen==='st-governance'?'gov':screen==='st-audit'?'audit':screen==='inbox'&&isFull()?'inbox':screen==='dashboard'?'dash':screen==='tasks'?'tasks':screen==='c360'&&record?record.id:screen==='segments'?'segments':screen==='cases'?'cases':screen==='fav-att'?'att-list':screen==='fav-team'?(teamDrill?'team-drill':'team'):'list'}
      go={goDemo} />
  </React.Fragment>);
}

}

function MvpDashLink({ label, onClick }) {
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <span onClick={onClick} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2, height: 24, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-1) 0 var(--t-spacing-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', cursor: 'pointer', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', transition: 'background .1s' }}>
      {label}<Icon name="chevron-right" size={14} color="currentColor" />
    </span>
  );
}
function MvpDashCard({ icon, title, count, linkLabel, onLink, children, grow, extra, col, ord }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ flex: grow || '1 1 320px', gridColumn: col, order: ord, minWidth: 0, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', border: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-medium)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 40, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2) 0 var(--t-spacing-3)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        {icon}
        <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontWeight: 500, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>{title}{count != null ? <span style={{ color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', fontWeight: 400 }}>{' · ' + count}</span> : null}</span>
        {extra || null}
        {onLink ? <LightButton title={linkLabel} Icon="arrow-up-right" accent="tertiary" onClick={onLink} /> : null}
      </div>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
function MvpDashRow({ on, onClick, children }) {
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <div onClick={onClick} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', minHeight: 44, padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-3)', boxSizing: 'border-box', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', cursor: 'pointer', background: on ? 'var(--t-accent-quaternary)' : h ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', transition: 'background .1s' }}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
function MvpDashState({ st, skel, emptyIcon, emptyTitle, emptySub, emptyCta, onEmptyCta, errTitle, onRetry }) {
  const ES = DS.EmptyState;
  if (st === 'loading') return <div>{Array.from({ length: skel }).map((_, i) => (
    <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', height: 44, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-3)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
      <span style={{ width: 36, height: 14, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-xs)', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' }} />
      <span style={{ width: 120 - (i * 13) % 40, height: 10, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-xs)', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' }} />
      <span style={{ flex: 1, maxWidth: 260 - (i * 29) % 90, height: 10, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-xs)', background: 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' }} />
    </div>))}</div>;
  const box = (el) => <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-8) var(--t-spacing-4)' }}>{el}</div>;
  if (st === 'error') return box(<ES Icon="alert-triangle" title={errTitle} actionLabel="Thử lại" onAction={onRetry} />);
  return box(<ES Icon={emptyIcon} title={emptyTitle} subtitle={emptySub} actionLabel={emptyCta} onAction={onEmptyCta} />);
}

function DashRowMenu({ items, up, width }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <span onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ position: 'relative', flexShrink: 0, display: 'flex', alignSelf: 'center' }}>
      <DSIconButton Icon="dots" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Thêm" onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)} />
      {open ? <React.Fragment>
        <span onClick={() => setOpen(false)} style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 30 }} />
        <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: up ? 'auto' : 'calc(100% + 4px)', bottom: up ? 'calc(100% + 4px)' : 'auto', right: up ? 'auto' : 0, left: up ? 0 : 'auto', zIndex: 31 }}>
          <DdSurface width={width || 180}><DdGroup>{items.map(([t, ic, fn]) => <DdItem key={t} text={t} Icon={ic} onClick={() => { setOpen(false); fn(); }} />)}</DdGroup></DdSurface>
        </span>
      </React.Fragment> : null}
    </span>
  );
}
function MvpDashboardScreen({ onExpand, onGo, sidePanel }) {
  useMvp();
  const isSup = mvpIsSup();
  const [panel, setPanel] = React.useState(null);
  const [dlg, setDlg] = React.useState(null);
  const [attDlg, setAttDlg] = React.useState(null);
  const [scope, setScope] = React.useState('mine');
  const [wk, setWk] = React.useState(DASH_WEEKS.length - 1);
  // Lưới 3 cột, các card cùng hàng cao bằng nhau; khung hẹp thì xếp 1 cột.
  const [wide, setWide] = React.useState(true);
  const roRef = React.useRef(null);
  const gridRef = React.useCallback((el) => {
    if (roRef.current) { roRef.current.disconnect(); roRef.current = null; }
    if (!el) return;
    setWide(el.clientWidth >= 860);
    if (window.ResizeObserver) { const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => setWide(el.clientWidth >= 860)); ro.observe(el); roRef.current = ro; }
  }, []);
  const span = (n) => (wide ? 'span ' + n : '1 / -1');
  const attView = isSup && scope === 'team' ? 'team' : 'mine';
  const retry = (k) => { mvpSet((m) => { m[k] = 'loading'; }); setTimeout(() => mvpSet((m) => { m[k] = null; }), 1000); };
  // Khối nào lỗi thì chỉ khối đó lỗi (W1).
  const stA = MVP.dashA || null, stT = MVP.dashT || null, stG = MVP.dashG || null;
  const queue = stA ? [] : (() => { const l = mvpAttRows(attView); const p5 = (a) => dashPipe(a)[0] === 'P5'; return l.filter(p5).concat(l.filter((a) => !p5(a))); })();
  const top = queue.slice(0, MVP_DASH_TOP);
  const tasks = stT ? [] : mvpTaskRows('mine').filter((t) => { const k = mvpDue(t)[2]; return k === 'over' || k === 'today'; }); // quá hạn trước, rồi hôm nay
  const openAtt = (id) => setPanel({ kind: 'att', id });
  // §4E.2: quyết định xong tự sang mục kế tiếp trong cả hàng đợi, không dừng ở các mục đang hiện.
  // Thứ tự hàng đợi chụp lúc render (trước khi lưu quyết định) → mở đúng mục ngay sau mục vừa quyết.
  const orderRef = React.useRef([]);
  orderRef.current = mvpAttRows(attView).map((x) => x.id);
  const advance = (fromId) => {
    const before = orderRef.current;
    const open = new Set(mvpAttRows(attView).map((x) => x.id));
    const idx = before.indexOf(fromId);
    const after = idx >= 0 ? before.slice(idx + 1).concat(before.slice(0, idx)) : before;
    const nextId = after.find((id) => id !== fromId && open.has(id)) || mvpAttRows(attView).map((x) => x.id).find((id) => id !== fromId);
    setPanel(nextId ? { kind: 'att', id: nextId } : { kind: 'att', id: fromId, caughtUp: true });
  };
  const complete = (t) => {
    if (t.type === 'todo' && MVP.demo !== 'conflict') { mvpTaskDone(t); mvpToast('Đã hoàn thành việc'); return; }
    setDlg({ kind: 'taskdone', t });
  };
  const openCust = (cid) => { const r = mvpCustOf(cid); if (r && onExpand) onExpand(r, 'overview'); };
  const rightPanel = sidePanel ? sidePanel : !panel ? null
    : panel.kind === 'cust' ? <RecordSidePanel key={'c' + panel.id} record={mvpCustOf(panel.id)} onClose={() => setPanel(null)} onExpand={(r, t) => onExpand && onExpand(r, t || 'overview')} />
    : panel.kind === 'task' ? <MvpTaskPanel key={panel.id} taskId={panel.id} onClose={() => setPanel(null)} onOpenCust={openCust} onOpenAtt={(attId) => openAtt(attId)} onComplete={complete} onDelete={(t) => setDlg({ kind: 'taskdelete', t })} />
    : <MvpAttQueuePanel key={'q' + panel.id} attId={panel.id} queue={mvpAttRows(attView)} caughtUp={!!panel.caughtUp} onSelect={openAtt} onClose={() => setPanel(null)} onAdvance={advance} onOpenCustomer={(r) => onExpand && onExpand(r, 'overview')} />;
  const teams = isSup ? MVP_TEAMS.map((t) => { const st = t.brokers.map((b) => mvpTeamStats(b)); return { id: t.id, name: t.name, n: t.brokers.length, open: st.reduce((x, y) => x + y.open, 0), sla: st.reduce((x, y) => x + y.sla, 0) }; }) : [];
  const stamp = <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>Dữ liệu tính đến 23/09 07:30</span>;
  // Như các màn khác: panel đẩy header, còn nội dung nằm yên bên dưới panel (không co lại).
  const overlay = rightPanel ? <div style={{ position: 'relative', zIndex: 6, display: 'flex', flexShrink: 0 }}>{rightPanel}</div> : null;

            <MvpDashCard col={span(isSup ? 2 : 2)} ord={7} icon={<DashTile icon="chart-bar" hue="orange" />} title="KPI của tôi">

// Id cũ của trang khách / Attention → case trong CASES (một nguồn dữ liệu case).
const CASE_ALIAS = { idle: 'cs1', bond: 'cs2', review: 'cs3', onboarding: 'cs6', p5: 'cs15' };
const caseRef = (id) => CASE_ALIAS[id] || id;
// §O4: P5 trước, rồi theo điểm ưu tiên.
const casesOf = (cid) => CASES.filter((k) => k.cid === cid).sort((a, b) => (b.pipe === 'P5') - (a.pipe === 'P5') || b.pri - a.pri);
// Dòng case dùng chung cho Customer panel (§4D.3 O4).
function CaseItemRow({ k, onClick }) {
  const st = caseStatus(k);
  const right = k.late ? <Tag text="Quá SLA" color="red" preventShrink /> : k.paused ? <Tag text="Tạm dừng" color="gray" preventShrink /> : k.pending ? <Tag text="Chờ duyệt" color="yellow" preventShrink /> : <Tag text={st[0]} color={st[1]} preventShrink />;
  return <ItemRow onClick={onClick} title={k.pipe + ' · ' + k.name} sub={caseStage(k)[0] + ' ' + caseStep(k) + ' · ' + caseSla(k) + ' · ' + caseOwner(k)} right={right} />;
}
// Bảng case dùng chung cho trang khách (Tổng quan O4, tab Case).
const caseTableRows = (list, rp) => list.map((k) => { const st = caseStatus(k); return { ...rp('case', k.id), cells: [k.pipe, k.name, <span>{caseStage(k)[0]} <span style={{ display: 'inline-block', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>{caseStep(k)}</span>{k.paused ? <Tag text="Tạm dừng" color="gray" preventShrink /> : null}{k.pending ? <Tag text="Chờ duyệt" color="yellow" preventShrink /> : null}</span>, <Tag text={st[0]} color={st[1]} preventShrink />, String(k.pri), <span style={{ color: k.late ? 'var(--t-tag-text-red)' : 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)' }}>{caseSla(k)}</span>, caseOwner(k)] }; });
const CASE_TABLE_HEAD = [{ label: 'Pipeline', w: 0.6 }, { label: 'Case', w: 1.4 }, { label: 'Stage', w: 1.5 }, { label: 'Trạng thái', w: 0.8 }, { label: 'Ưu tiên', w: 0.6 }, { label: 'SLA', w: 0.9 }, { label: 'Phụ trách', w: 1 }];
function CaseTabBlocks({ record, rp, openAction }) {
  const all = casesOf(record.id);
  const open = all.filter((k) => !k.closed);
  const closed = all.filter((k) => k.closed);
  const need = open.filter((k) => k.late || k.pending || k.pri >= 80);
  return <React.Fragment>
    <C360Block span={7} title="Cần hành động" meta={String(need.length)} state={need.length ? undefined : 'empty'} stateNote="Không có case cần hành động.">
      {need.length ? <C360Table head={[{ label: 'Case', w: 1.5 }, { label: 'Vì sao', w: 1.6 }, { label: 'SLA', w: 1 }]} rows={need.map((k) => ({ ...rp('case', k.id), cells: [k.pipe + ' · ' + k.name, k.late ? 'Quá SLA ở ' + caseStage(k)[0] : k.pending ? 'Chờ duyệt chuyển stage' : 'Ưu tiên ' + k.pri, <span style={{ color: k.late ? 'var(--t-tag-text-red)' : 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)' }}>{caseSla(k)}</span>] }))} /> : null}
    </C360Block>
    <C360Block span={4} title="Kết quả 90 ngày">
      <KVRow label="Case đã đóng" Icon="check" value={String(closed.length)} />
      <KVRow label="Success" Icon="trending-up" value={closed.length ? closed.filter((k) => k.closed === 'success').length + ' / ' + closed.length : '—'} />
      <KVRow label="Giá trị mang lại" Icon="cash" value={closed.filter((k) => k.value).map((k) => k.value).join(' · ') || '—'} />
    </C360Block>
    <C360Block span={11} title="Case đang mở" meta={String(open.length)} state={open.length ? undefined : 'empty'} stateNote="Không có case đang mở cho khách này.">
      {open.length ? <C360Table head={CASE_TABLE_HEAD} rows={caseTableRows(open, rp)} /> : null}
      <span style={{ display: 'flex', marginTop: 'var(--t-spacing-1)' }}>
        <DSButton title="Tạo case" variant="secondary" size="small" Icon="plus" onClick={() => openAction && openAction('case')} />
      </span>
    </C360Block>
    <C360Block span={11} title="Tất cả case" meta={String(all.length) + ' · kể cả đã đóng'} state={all.length ? undefined : 'empty'} stateNote="Khách chưa có case nào.">
      {all.length ? <C360Table head={[{ label: 'Case', w: 1.4 }, { label: 'Stage', w: 1.3 }, { label: 'Kết quả', w: 1.4 }, { label: 'Signal gốc', w: 1 }]}
        rows={all.map((k) => { const t = caseStage(k)[1]; const last = k.history[k.history.length - 1]; const tt = t === 'S' ? ['Success', 'green'] : t === 'F' ? ['Failed', 'red'] : t === 'W' ? ['Waiting', 'yellow'] : ['Active', 'blue']; const sub = { fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }; return { ...rp('case', k.id), cells: [
          <span style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, minWidth: 0 }}><span>{k.pipe + ' · ' + k.name}</span><span style={sub}>{'Lịch sử: ' + k.history.length + ' bước · ' + last[0]}</span></span>,
          <span style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, minWidth: 0 }}><span>{caseStage(k)[0]}</span><Tag text={tt[0]} color={tt[1]} preventShrink /></span>,
          <span style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, minWidth: 0 }}><span>{k.opened + ' → ' + (k.closed ? k.closedAt.split(' ')[0] : 'đang mở') + (k.outcome ? ' · ' + k.outcome.split(' · ')[0] : '')}</span>{k.reason ? <span style={sub}>{k.reason.split(' · ')[0]}</span> : null}</span>,
          CASE_SIG[k.signals[0]] || k.signals[0]] }; })} /> : null}
    </C360Block>
  </React.Fragment>;
}
const caseOwner = (k) => (k.owner || (k.other ? 'Đỗ Thu Hằng' : MVP_ME));
// Phạm vi: Compliance thấy tất cả; Của đội = case trong đội (bỏ case ngoài đội); còn lại = case của người đang xem.
const caseInScope = (k, viewId) => (VIEWER_ROLE === 'compliance' ? true : viewId === 'team' ? !k.other : caseOwner(k) === mvpMe());
// §4E.7: "SLA còn 2 ngày" / "Quá SLA 1 ngày"; SLA dừng khi tạm dừng.
const caseSla = (k) => (k.closed ? 'Đóng ' + k.closedAt.split(' ')[0] : k.paused ? 'SLA dừng · tạm dừng' : k.late ? 'Quá SLA ' + k.sla : 'SLA ' + k.sla);
const caseStage = (k) => CASE_PIPES[k.pipe].stages[k.stage];
const caseLinear = (pipe) => CASE_PIPES[pipe].stages.filter((s) => s[1] !== 'F');
const caseStatus = (k) => (k.closed === 'success' ? ['Success', 'green'] : k.closed === 'failed' ? ['Failed', 'red'] : caseStage(k)[1] === 'W' ? ['Waiting', 'yellow'] : ['Active', 'blue']);
const caseStep = (k) => { const L = caseLinear(k.pipe); const i = L.findIndex((s) => s[0] === caseStage(k)[0]); return i >= 0 ? (i + 1) + '/' + L.length : '—'; };
const caseRO = (k) => VIEWER_ROLE === 'compliance' || VIEWER_ROLE === 'ops' || !!k.other || !!k.closed;
const CASE_VIEWS_B = [
  { id: 'mine', name: 'Case của tôi', icon: 'briefcase' },
  { id: 'late', name: 'Quá SLA', icon: 'alarm' },
  { id: 'pending', name: 'Chờ duyệt chuyển stage', icon: 'hourglass' },
  { id: 'paused', name: 'Tạm dừng', icon: 'player-pause' },
  { id: 'new7', name: 'Mới 7 ngày', icon: 'sparkles' },
  { id: 'closed', name: 'Đã đóng 90 ngày', icon: 'archive' },
];
const CASE_VIEW_TEAM = { id: 'team', name: 'Của đội', icon: 'users' };
function caseRows(viewId) {
  const all = CASES.filter((k) => caseInScope(k, viewId));
  if (viewId === 'closed') return all.filter((k) => k.closed);
  const open = all.filter((k) => !k.closed);
  if (viewId === 'late') return open.filter((k) => k.late);
  if (viewId === 'pending') return open.filter((k) => k.pending);
  if (viewId === 'paused') return open.filter((k) => k.paused);
  if (viewId === 'new7') return open.filter((k) => mvpDays(k.openedIso) >= -7);
  return open;
}
function CaseTile({ size = 16 }) {
  return <span style={{ width: size, height: size, borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', background: 'var(--t-object-tile-purple)', border: '1px solid var(--t-object-tile-border-purple)', boxSizing: 'border-box', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}><Icon name="layout-kanban" size={size - 2} color="var(--t-tag-text-purple)" /></span>;
}
// Badge vị trí cố định (§4E.2): Quá SLA · Chờ duyệt chuyển stage · Tạm dừng · Chưa xác nhận backfill.
function CaseBadges({ k }) {
  const b = [k.late ? ['Quá SLA', 'red'] : null, k.pending ? ['Chờ duyệt → ' + CASE_PIPES[k.pipe].stages[k.pending.to][0], 'yellow'] : null, k.paused ? ['Tạm dừng · ' + k.paused, 'gray'] : null, k.backfill ? ['Chưa xác nhận backfill', 'orange'] : null].filter(Boolean);
  return b.length ? <span style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>{b.map(([t, c]) => <Tag key={t} text={t} color={c} preventShrink />)}</span> : null;
}
function CaseSigChips({ k }) {
  return <span style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>{k.signals.slice(0, 2).map((s) => <Tag key={s} text={CASE_SIG[s] || s} color="transparent" variant="border" preventShrink />)}{k.signals.length > 2 ? <Tag text={'+' + (k.signals.length - 2)} color="gray" preventShrink /> : null}</span>;
}
function CaseCard({ k, on, onClick }) {
  const c = mvpCustOf(k.cid);
  const [h, setH] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <div onClick={onClick} onMouseEnter={() => setH(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setH(false)} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-1)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-2) var(--t-spacing-3)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-md)', cursor: 'pointer', background: on ? 'var(--t-accent-quaternary)' : k.paused ? 'var(--t-background-secondary)' : 'var(--t-background-primary)', border: (k.late ? '1.5px solid var(--t-tag-text-red)' : '1px solid ' + (h ? 'var(--t-border-color-strong)' : 'var(--t-border-color-medium)')), boxSizing: 'border-box', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)' }}>
      <span style={{ fontWeight: 500, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{k.pipe + ' · ' + k.name}</span>
      <span style={{ display: 'flex' }}><Chip label={c ? c.name : ''} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" /></span>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)', lineHeight: 1.4, display: '-webkit-box', WebkitLineClamp: 2, WebkitBoxOrient: 'vertical', overflow: 'hidden' }}>{k.why}</span>
      <CaseSigChips k={k} />
      <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>{caseOwner(k) + ' · ' + caseSla(k) + (k.tasks && k.tasks.length ? ' · ' + k.tasks.length + ' việc' : '')}</span>
      <CaseBadges k={k} />
    </div>
  );
}
function CaseSection({ title, meta, children }) {
  return <C360LeftSection title={title} meta={meta}>{children}</C360LeftSection>;
}
function CaseStageBar({ k }) {
  const L = caseLinear(k.pipe);
  const cur = L.findIndex((s) => s[0] === caseStage(k)[0]);
  const pend = k.pending ? L.findIndex((s) => s[0] === CASE_PIPES[k.pipe].stages[k.pending.to][0]) : -1;
  const failed = k.closed === 'failed';
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>
      {L.map((s, i) => {
        const done = !failed && cur >= 0 && i < cur; const now = i === cur; const isPend = i === pend;
        return <span key={s[0]} title={s[1] === 'W' ? 'Stage chờ khách' : undefined} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, height: 22, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', border: isPend ? '1px dashed var(--t-tag-text-yellow)' : '1px solid ' + (now ? 'var(--t-color-blue)' : 'var(--t-border-color-medium)'), background: now ? 'var(--t-accent-quaternary)' : done ? 'var(--t-background-transparent-light)' : 'transparent', color: now ? 'var(--t-font-color-primary)' : done ? 'var(--t-font-color-secondary)' : 'var(--t-font-color-light)', fontWeight: now ? 500 : 400 }}>
          {done ? <Icon name="check" size={12} color="var(--t-font-color-tertiary)" /> : s[1] === 'W' ? <Icon name="clock" size={12} color="currentColor" /> : null}{s[0]}
        </span>;
      })}
      {k.pending && CASE_PIPES[k.pipe].stages[k.pending.to][1] === 'F' ? <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', height: 22, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', border: '1px dashed var(--t-tag-text-red)', color: 'var(--t-tag-text-red)' }}>{'→ ' + CASE_PIPES[k.pipe].stages[k.pending.to][0]}</span> : null}
      {failed ? <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', height: 22, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--t-border-radius-sm)', fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', border: '1px solid var(--t-tag-text-red)', color: 'var(--t-tag-text-red)', fontWeight: 500 }}>{caseStage(k)[0]}</span> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
function CasePanel({ caseId, onClose, onOpenCust, onOpenCase, onBack }) {
  useMvp();
  const k = CASES.find((x) => x.id === caseId);
  const shell = { width: 400, flexShrink: 0, height: '100%', background: 'var(--t-background-primary)', borderLeft: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', boxSizing: 'border-box', overflow: 'hidden' };
  if (!k) return <div style={shell}><DS.EmptyState Icon="briefcase" title="Case này không còn tồn tại." actionLabel="Đóng" onAction={onClose} /></div>;
  const c = mvpCustOf(k.cid);
  const ro = caseRO(k);
  const st = caseStatus(k);
  const sm = { fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' };
  const others = CASES.filter((x) => x.cid === k.cid && x.id !== k.id);
  const icon = { v: ['check', 'var(--t-tag-text-green)'], o: ['circle-half-2', 'var(--t-tag-text-yellow)'], x: ['x', 'var(--t-tag-text-red)'] };
  return (
    <div style={shell}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', height: 48, padding: '0 var(--t-spacing-2) 0 var(--t-spacing-3)', boxSizing: 'border-box', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        {onBack ? <DSIconButton Icon="arrow-left" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Quay lại" onClick={onBack} /> : null}
        <CaseTile />
        <span title={k.pipe + ' · ' + k.name} style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-md)', fontWeight: 500, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{k.pipe + ' · ' + k.name}</span>
        {ro ? <Tag text="Chỉ xem" color="gray" preventShrink /> : null}
        <DSIconButton Icon="arrow-up-right" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Mở trang case" onClick={() => mvpToast('Trang case làm ở đợt sau')} />
        <DSIconButton Icon="x" variant="light" accent="tertiary" size="small" ariaLabel="Đóng" onClick={onClose} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', padding: 'var(--t-spacing-3)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--t-border-color-light)' }}>
          <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--t-spacing-2)', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <Tag text={st[0]} color={st[1]} preventShrink />
            <span style={sm}>{k.closed ? 'Đóng ' + k.closedAt : caseStage(k)[0] + ' · ' + caseStep(k)}</span>
            {k.closed ? null : <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: k.late ? 'var(--t-tag-text-red)' : 'var(--t-font-color-tertiary)' }}>{'· ' + caseSla(k)}</span>}
          </span>
          <CaseBadges k={k} />
          {k.paused ? <span style={sm}>Case giữ nguyên stage, SLA dừng tới khi case P5 của khách đóng. Không gửi bù.</span> : null}
          {k.backfill ? <span style={sm}>Stage suy từ dữ liệu · sửa được trong 14 ngày.</span> : null}
          {ro && k.other ? <span style={sm}>Case của {caseOwner(k)} (ngoài đội của bạn). Bạn chỉ xem được.</span> : null}
        </div>
        <CaseSection title="Chi tiết">
          <KVRow label="Khách" Icon="user" value={<span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}><span onClick={() => onOpenCust(k.cid, k.id)} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', cursor: 'pointer' }}><Chip label={c ? c.name : ''} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" /></span><Tag text={lc9(c)} color={LC9_COLOR[lc9(c)] || 'gray'} preventShrink /></span>} />
          <KVRow label="Pipeline" Icon="route" value={CASE_PIPES[k.pipe].name} />
          <KVRow label="Mã case" Icon="hash" value={<ValuePill text={k.code} />} />
          {k.aum ? <KVRow label="AUM at risk" Icon="coin" value={<Tag text={k.aum} color="red" preventShrink />} /> : null}
          <KVRow label="Ưu tiên" Icon="flag" value={String(k.pri)} />
          <KVRow label="Phụ trách" Icon="user-circle" value={<Chip label={caseOwner(k)} avatarType="rounded" variant="highlighted" />} />
          <KVRow label="Mở" Icon="calendar" value={k.opened + ' · ' + k.by} />
        </CaseSection>
        <CaseSection title="Stage">
          <CaseStageBar k={k} />
          {k.pending ? <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--t-font-size-sm)', color: 'var(--t-tag-text-yellow)' }}>{'Đề nghị chuyển sang ' + CASE_PIPES[k.pipe].stages[k.pending.to][0] + ' · cần ' + k.pending.who + ' duyệt · ' + k.pending.due + '. Case giữ ở ' + caseStage(k)[0] + ' tới khi được duyệt.'}</span> : null}
          {k.pipe === 'P5' && !k.closed ? <span style={sm}>Đóng Lost cần người duyệt thứ hai (ô "Đóng case Failed" · P5).</span> : null}
